items.description_en: Sacred Wood Perfume by Kilian launched in 2014. A simple scent of only two notes, sandalwood and milk, it is light and clean, with a hint of spice, and the very essence of sandalwood. The fragrance is simultaneously simple and mysterious, an oriental woody perfume that suggests sensuality.

items.title: Kilian Love Don't Be Shy — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Repuesto) para mujer
items.title_en: Kilian Love Don't Be Shy by Kilian Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2007 by Kilian, Kilian Love Don't Be Shy captures the blush of first love in a feminine fragrance. This oriental blend begins with citrusy top notes of neroli, bergamot, and coriander. Pink pepper adds a touch of spice and is then mellowed by the floral scents of rose, iris and jasmine.

items.title_en: Bad Boy by Carolina Herrera Eau De Toilette Refill 6.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Spicy and sweet elements fuse with fresh aromatic herbs and cacao in Bad Boy, a spicy oriental fragrance for men. The opening is a piquant effusion of white and black pepper mingled with bright, green tones of Italian bergamot. Heart notes are clean and masculine, merging crisp clary sage and cedar.

items.title: Acqua Di Gio Profondo — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Repuesto) para hombre
items.title_en: Acqua Di Gio Profondo by Giorgio Armani Eau De Parfum Spray Refillable 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Inspired by the mystery of the deep blue sea is Acqua Di Gio Profondo, a masculine fragrance introduced in 2020 by Italian fashion designer Giorgio Armani. This luxury men's scent brings the depth and complexity of the ocean to life with top notes of marine accord, bergamot, and green mandarin. The heart notes of rosemary, lavender, and cypress add freshness, and the base notes of amber, patchouli, musk, and mineral accord finish on a strong, memorable note.

items.title: Diafana Skin — Eau de Parfum en spray 41 ml (1.4 oz) (Repuesto) para mujer
items.title_en: Diafana Skin by Alyson Oldoini  Eau De Parfum Spray Refill  1.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally launched in 2016, Alyson Oldoini Diafana Skin is a smooth, sweetly embracing floral woody musk for women. The opening is bright and tranquil with tones of aloe vera and aldehydes merged with tart-sweet notes of pomegranate and passionfruit and softened with accords of chamomile, mimosa and almond blossom. Sensual florals bloom next, mingling tuberose, jasmine sambac and shimmering iris with Bulgarian rose, red poppy and green hints of Indian hemp.

items.title: Alyson Oldoini Crystal Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 20 ml (.67 oz) (Repuesto) para hombre
items.title_en: Alyson Oldoini Crystal Oud by Alyson Oldoini Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray .67 oz for Men
items.description_en: First launched in 2014, Alyson Oldoini Crystal Oud is a warm, masculine woody aromatic scent illuminated by citrus and spice. The opening is bright and brisk with accords of tart-sweet rhubarb and Italian lemon spiced with piquant nuances of black pepper. Powdery poppy and earthy tones of patchouli, white truffle and incense emerge as the scent settles.

items.title: Good Girl Gone Bad Extreme — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Repuesto) para mujer
items.title_en: Good Girl Gone Bad Extreme by Kilian Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Good Girl Gone Bad Extreme Perfume was created by the house of Kilian with perfumer Alberto Morillas and released in 2017.  It is an exciting floral woodsy fragrance with a musky side.  A complex blend of notes that come together in a way to be celebrated.

items.description_en: An empowering new scent for a new decade, H24 launched in 2021. This modern men's fragrance is from iconic French luxury goods designer Hermes, and it is bold, unique, and memorable. This masculine scent features a blend of four accords to create a decidedly modern aromatic, taking its direction from fresh, herbal clary sage.

items.title: 100 Bon Carvi & Jardin De Figuier — Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Repuesto) para hombre
items.title_en: 100 Bon Carvi & Jardin De Figuier by 100 Bon Concentree De Parfum Spray (Unisex Refillable) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Originally released in 2017, 100 Bon Carvi & Jardin De Figuier is a fruity-sweet and soft, alluring fragrance enhanced by powdery florals, bright citrus, clean wood and creamy suede. Opening notes are an uplifting expression of fig and raspberry mingled with tart-sweet hints of mandarin and blood orange. Soft floral tones bloom next, merging violet, jasmine and rose with herbal nuances of caraway.

items.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu — Eau de Parfum en spray 200 ml (6.7 oz) (Repuesto) para hombre
items.title_en: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray with Refillable Atomizer 6.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition cologne has an energetic, uplifting open that gradually transitions to spicy wood and earth tones. The top starts with a burst of cheerful lemon and piquant peppermint. Warm pink peppercorns and bitter grapefruit keep the scent dynamic and lively.

items.title: Burberry Hero — Parfum 200 ml (6.7 oz) (Repuesto) para hombre
items.title_en: Burberry Hero by Burberry Parfum Intense Refill 6.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Climb the highest mountains and wander through the greenest valleys inbetween whenever you spritz on the revitalizing Burberry Hero, a 2021 fragrance from Burberry. This simple yet elegant cologne offers spicy, earthy, citrus and woody accords for a stunningly crisp, clean result. Elements of sparkling bergamot meet with fresh juniper and bold black pepper for a riveting effect.

items.title: Kilian Roses On Ice — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Repuesto) para mujer
items.title_en: Kilian Roses On Ice by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray Refillable 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Roses on Ice, launched by Kilian in 2020, is an aromatic fragrance perfect for daily wear during spring and summer. It was designed by perfumer Frank Voelkl for both women and men. Fresh, green top notes open the fragrance with juniper berries, cucumber and lime.

items.title: Angel Nova — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Repuesto) para mujer
items.title_en: Angel Nova by Thierry Mugler Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumers Louise Turner, Sonia Constant and Quentin Bisch, Angel Nova is a sweet and fresh, fruity tropical scent for women. Top notes are an irresistible blend of ripest raspberry mingled with sweet, succulent litchi fruit. Lovely damask rose and crisp nuances of violet embrace the heart, followed by a sensual, lingering base of richly woody Akigalawood, patchouli and benzoin.

items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Jacques Bogart Club 75 fragrance for men offers fruity and spicy top notes of orange, lemon and cinnamon that give way to fresh heart notes of pungent lavender and crisp apple. Citrus and a singular spice and floral are tempered by rich, bracing and exotic foundational notes of cedar, sandalwood and musk. Jacques Bogart is a family-run and independent concern based in Paris that produces fragrances and skincare for a discerning male clientele.

items.title: Prada L'homme Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Prada L'homme Intense by Prada Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: L'homme Intense Prada launched in 2017 as a more dynamic version of the men’s L’Homme scent from Prada. The creation of perfumer Daniela (Roche) Andrier, this masculine fragrance begins with captivating top notes of amber and iris. Masculine leather and patchouli notes fill out the heart of this alluring scent, as tonka bean and sandalwood provide the exotic base notes.

items.title: Supremacy Silver — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Supremacy Silver by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Supremacy Silver is a woody-floral-musk men’s scent that launched in 2013 from the Afnan Perfumes brand. This refreshing fragrance shows off your sensual, masculine side the moment you enter a room, without overpowering those present. Citrusy top notes include luscious apple, blackcurrant, pineapple and bergamot.

items.title: Dis Lui — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Dis Lui by YZY Perfume Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Dis Lui Cologne by YZY Perfume

items.title: Entebaa — Eau de Parfum en spray 98 ml (3.33 oz) (Sin caja) para hombre
items.title_en: Entebaa by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3.33 oz for Men
items.description_en: Entebaa is a masculine cologne that has a balance of notes that make it just as ideal for wearing at night as it is during the day. It was introduced by Rasasi, a company established in Dubai, in 1979. The opening notes are refreshing and consist of citrus and lavender.

items.title: Supremacy Noir — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Supremacy Noir by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Supremacy Noir is an Oriental-spicy men’s fragrance by Afnan. Designed for wearing during the daytime, this alluring scent struts its stuff best during the energetic days of spring and summer. A mild longevity and moderate sillage ensure you’ll garner attention without overstaying your welcome.

items.title: Modest Pour Homme Une — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Modest Pour Homme Une by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Modest Pour Homme Une Cologne by Afnan

items.title: Al Wisam Day Born To Win — Eau de Parfum en spray 98 ml (3.33 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Al Wisam Day Born To Win by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 3.33 oz for Men
items.description_en: Al Wisam Day Born To Win is a men’s oriental fougere fragrance released by United Arab Emirates perfume label Rasasi. This scent opens with a trio of bergamot, lavender and geranium in the top notes before revealing a herbal, woody and floral center of clary sage, cedarwood, sandalwood and rose. The fragrance ends solidly with base notes of musk, amber, oakmoss and oud, a rich resin with a woody and nutty aroma.

items.title: Jo Malone Tobacco & Mandarin — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) (Sin caja) para hombre
items.title_en: Jo Malone Tobacco & Mandarin by Jo Malone Cologne Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 1 oz for Men
items.description_en: Jo Malone Tobacco & Mandarin Cologne by U.K. luxury perfumer Jo Malone is designed to be enjoyed by men and women alike.

items.title: Oscent — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Oscent by Alexandre J Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Oscent is a natural oriental cologne perfectly suited for the colder weather of fall into winter. After opening on the nose with ginger, its heart develops with woody scents, including cedarwood, white woods and patchouli. The cologne dries down to base notes of vanilla, leathery musk and labdanum.

items.title: Hawas — Eau de Parfum en spray 98 ml (3.33 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Hawas by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 3.33 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2015, Hawas Cologne by Rasasi has established itself as the preeminent scent for men. Spicy yet refreshing cinnamon, bergamot and lemon top notes are blended beautifully with more sweetly mild and smooth base notes such as melon, vanilla and violet to create an aquatic yet masculine bouquet that is perfect for everyday use on those endlessly warm summer days. This perfect combination of freshness and spice is a must-have essence for men this summer.

items.title: Armaf Italiano Nero — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Italiano Nero by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Armaf, Italiano Nero is a bold, woody cologne. Citrusy top notes of lemon and bergamot provide a bright opening to the fragrance. At the heart of the cologne, the note of lavender adds a touch of sweetness to the cologne and balances out the citrusy top notes while cypress gives the blend a warm, masculine quality.

items.title: Armaf Tag Him Prestige — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Tag Him Prestige by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Tag Him Prestige is distinctive cologne for men who refuse to blend in. This full-bodied cologne greets the senses with zesty, clean top notes of bergamot, mint and grapefruit. Underneath lies a robust middle marked by the spiciness of cinnamon and pepper, the richness of blood orange and an unexpected hint of lavender.

items.title: Armaf Niche Platinum — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Niche Platinum by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Niche Platinum is a blend of woody and spicy accords. It is bright and earthy, resulting in a fragrance that works well in casual and formal occasions, both day and night. It opens with an intense mix of spicy notes that piques the senses.

items.title: Armaf Niche Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Niche Oud by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Niche Oud is a sophisticated fragrance that is perfectly blended to suit both men and women. The scent transcends a variety of occasions and can be worn during the busy day or during an exciting nighttime outing. This cologne opens with notes of caraway, sage, spice and bergamot zest.

items.title: Armaf Derby Blanche White — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Derby Blanche White by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A unique fragrance for men, Armaf Derby Blanche White by Armaf is a refreshing cologne for the determined, spirited and confident man. The top notes of bergamot and orange broadcast an oceanic feel before the more distinctive scents of green tea and blackcurrant amaze and impress. The fragrance finishes with the classic masculine notes of galbanum, musk and sandalwood for an experience that manages to surprise while remaining traditional, ensuring it will not be soon forgotten.

items.title: Armaf Shades — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Shades by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Shades is a blend of citrus and aromatic accords. It is polished, striking and dynamic, excellent for making an unforgettable impression. It opens with a fruity mix of lime, pineapple and plum, topped with spicy cardamom and fresh violet leaves.

items.title: Armaf Craze — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Craze by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Craze is a blend of gourmand and floral accords. It is spicy and sweet, making this an invigorating and intense fragrance. It opens with light floral notes of heliotrope and bergamot, layered with spicy cumin.

items.title: Armaf Hunter — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Hunter by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Hunter by Armaf is an invigorating and primal cologne designed for men. Belonging to the woody floral musk group of fragrances, the cologne brings out the best of the outdoors into one manly fragrance. The top notes for this blend consist of an herbal blend with rosemary and cardamom with refreshing grapefruit and rich cedar.

items.title: Armaf Tres Nuit — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Tres Nuit by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Combining the sultry warmth of a summer night with mysterious hints of dark florals and spice, Armaf Tres Nuit is a complex and alluring fragrance for men. Lemon verbena, iris, and citrusy lemon dazzle the senses in the top notes like a light breeze. In the base notes, this Armaf cologne takes a spicy, masculine turn with accords of sandalwood and ambergris.

items.title: Armaf Blue Homme — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Blue Homme by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Blue Homme is a blend of citrus and spicy accords. It is striking and spirited, yet also refreshing and clean. The fragrance opens with bright citrus notes of lemon, mandarin orange, lime, bergamot and neroli.

items.title: Ambergris Showers — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Ambergris Showers by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Rasasi Ambergris Showers was launched in 2016 as a classic yet modern Arabic cologne for men comfortable with their sexuality and confident in themselves. Leaving an intoxicating fragrance trail, the notes blend into an intricate and mysterious dance that’s at once deeply earthy yet sophisticated and versatile – much like natural ambergris. Bracing, bitter galbanum and citrusy tangerine join with metallic green violet leaves for an elegant, refined top.

items.title: Armaf Shades Wood — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Shades Wood by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Shades Wood is a blend of woody and floral accords, a modern take on a classic rose-oud fragrance. It is elegant, luxurious and exotic. It opens with bright and tart citrus, romantic rose, and rose-like geranium.

items.title: Armaf Voyage Brown — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Voyage Brown by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: When you're ready to set out on adventure, be sure to bring along Armaf Voyage Brown, an exotic cologne for men from Armaf. The overall impression of the fragrance is warm and spicy due to its profile of resinous cardamom, sweet and sensuous cinnamon, and mildly peppery sage. The tartness of grapefruit lends a citrusy tang to green aromatic notes of lavender and violet leaves.

items.title: Armaf Voyage Bleu — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Voyage Bleu by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Set off on a journey with Armaf Voyage Bleu. The fresh, tart, citrus notes of grapefruit, bergamot, and lemon are given a camphorous edge with sprightly mint. Piquant spicy notes include sharp ginger, sweet nutmeg, and a rose-like nuance of pink pepper.

items.title: Armaf Aura — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Aura by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Aura is a fruity-spicy men’s scent from Armaf. A moderate longevity and sillage combine in a fragrance that gets attention without overpowering your audience. The top notes feature the crisp, clean appeal of apple, lemon and black cardamom.

items.title: Armaf Signature Night — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Signature Night by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Signature Night is a blend of woody and leathery accords. It is powerful, enticing and masculine. As its name implies, it is excellent for evening use, but works well in the daytime.

items.title: Armaf Ventana — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Sin caja) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Ventana by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in approximately 2016 or 2017, Armaf Ventana is a fragrance for men with an overall woodsy-floral profile. Opening with citrus notes of lemon, grapefruit, and mandarin orange, the heart contains floral notes of herbaceous geranium and aromatic lavender that freshen the more earthy notes of patchouli and vetiver. Base notes give an overall balsamic effect as notes of precious wood blend with warm and powdery amber, as well as somber and austere cedar.

items.title: Armaf Ventana — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Ventana by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in approximately 2016 or 2017, Armaf Ventana is a fragrance for men with an overall woodsy-floral profile. Opening with citrus notes of lemon, grapefruit, and mandarin orange, the heart contains floral notes of herbaceous geranium and aromatic lavender that freshen the more earthy notes of patchouli and vetiver. Base notes give an overall balsamic effect as notes of precious wood blend with warm and powdery amber, as well as somber and austere cedar.

items.title: Armaf Shades Blue — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Shades Blue by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Shades Blue is a variation on the brand's popular Shades fragrance for men. This warm, aromatic cologne opens with bright citrus notes of grapefruit, lemon and bergamot orange paired with the exotic spice of cardamom. At the heart of this scent, you'll notice herbal, spicy notes of rosemary, sage, nutmeg, mint and ginger for a complex, intoxicating blend.

items.title: Club De Nuit Urban Man — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Club De Nuit Urban Man by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A spicy, woody cologne, Club de Nuit Urban Man was introduced by Armaf in 2017. Citrusy top notes of lemon and bergamot combine with spicy cardamom and fresh mint. At the heart of the blend, cedar, nutmeg and ginger give the fragrance a warm quality while the note of lavender amplifies the woody notes.

items.title: Club De Nuit Urban Man — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Sin caja) para hombre
items.title_en: Club De Nuit Urban Man by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A spicy, woody cologne, Club de Nuit Urban Man was introduced by Armaf in 2017. Citrusy top notes of lemon and bergamot combine with spicy cardamom and fresh mint. At the heart of the blend, cedar, nutmeg and ginger give the fragrance a warm quality while the note of lavender amplifies the woody notes.

items.title: Montblanc Legend Night — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Montblanc Legend Night by Mont Blanc Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Montblanc Legend Night cologne is a long-lasting, everyday fragrance for men, released by Mont Blanc in 2017. This unique fragrance starts with top notes of clary sage, mint, bergamot and cardamom. Deep middle notes of apple, lavender, violet, fir resin and cedar come next.

items.title: Armaf Derby Club House — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Derby Club House by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A rugged scent designed for the rugged man, Armaf Derby Club House by Armaf is a spicy and woody cologne sure to evoke pure masculinity. The top notes of bergamot and lavender slowly fade into the more sullen middle notes of cedarwood, blackwood and patchouli. The bottom notes round out the fragrance with scents of vanilla, amber and Tonka bean, producing an intense and smoky aroma that is as unique and innovative as it is manly.

items.title: Armaf The Warrior — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf The Warrior by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Built upon hearty middle notes of cedar, Armaf The Warrior combines the traditional with the unexpected to create a fragrance for men that is unmatched in strength and distinction. Bright citrus and vetiver mix with a pop of zesty pink pepper in the top notes, creating a playful opening gives way to a potent, woodsy center defined by labdanum, grapefruit and classic cedar. At its base, this Armaf cologne blends exotic frankincense with ginger and sandalwood to leave a warm and lasting impression.

items.title: Armaf Edition One — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Edition One by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced by Armaf, Edition One is an aromatic blend that combines citrusy and woody notes, resulting in a refined cologne. Giving the blend its bright opening, bergamot combines with citruses. The heart notes include sage, which brings a woodsy element to the cologne, and lavender, which adds a slightly sweet earthiness to the blend.

items.title: Yardley Equity — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Yardley Equity by Yardley London Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Yardley Equity is an energizing, sophisticated woody aromatic fragrance for men that layers citrus and herbal florals over a clean musk base. The opening is a bright and energetic blend of mandarin and fruity-aromatic bergamot. The subtle light wood tones of violet fuse with fresh jasmine at the heart notes.

items.title: Kenneth Cole Mankind Hero — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Kenneth Cole Mankind Hero by Kenneth Cole Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Kenneth Cole Mankind Hero is a wonderful earthy fragrance, perfect for the man who wants a fresh yet sensual scent. Oakmoss, white musk, amberwood, and coumarin form a sultry base to support the warm heart and invigorating top notes. The heart contains vanilla, lavender, plum wood, and clary sage.

items.title: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura — Eau de Cologne en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura by Acqua Di Parma Eau De Cologne Spray 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura Cologne by Acqua Di Parma

items.title: Stronger With You — Eau de Toilette en spray 151 ml (5.1 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Stronger With You by Giorgio Armani Eau De Toilette Spray 5.1 oz for Men
items.description_en: Stronger With You is a cologne for men that was introduced in 2017 by Emporio Armani. The spicy top notes of violet leaves, cardamom and pink pepper present an accord that is both delightful and sensual. Lending the fragrance its air of maturity is the heart of rich sage.

items.title: Stronger With You — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Stronger With You by Giorgio Armani Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Stronger With You is a cologne for men that was introduced in 2017 by Emporio Armani. The spicy top notes of violet leaves, cardamom and pink pepper present an accord that is both delightful and sensual. Lending the fragrance its air of maturity is the heart of rich sage.

items.title: Cambridge Knight — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Cambridge Knight by English Laundry Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Cambridge Knight is a traditional, warm men’s cologne released by English Laundry in 2015. Grapefruit, black currant and lily combine into a sweet, fruity opening, while musk and aquatic notes add a more masculine component. The heart notes are compelling and aromatic, with light jasmine, bay leaf and deep guaiac wood.

items.title: Windsor Pour Homme — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Windsor Pour Homme by English Laundry Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Old world meets new in Windsor Pour Homme, a subtly sweet aromatic fragrance for men that presents a classic cologne profile with a modern spice twist. The opening is an effusive sweet citrus blend of sparkling grapefruit, bergamot and apple. A bold spice accord emerges at the heart, fusing warm cinnamon tones with clove and peppercorn.

items.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal by Jean Paul Gaultier Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Cologne by Jean Paul Gaultier

items.title: Ajmal Mystery — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Ajmal Mystery by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Ajmal Mystery is a men’s cologne from Ajmal, a complex and intriguing scent. Bergamot brings a sharp, clean opening note, and herbaceous thyme lies just below that sharpness. Patchouli as a middle note transitions the scent into more spicy, earthy tones.

items.title: Armaf El Cielo — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf El Cielo by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in September of the year 2016, El Cielo is a hot, energizing cologne for men by Armaf. The top features a citrusy blend of lemon and bergamot, a tart note of green apple coming in strong, softened by the cool, sweet aroma of fresh melon. The cologne then takes an herbal, aromatic turn, lavender and violet coming together in a relaxing blend, accented by the robust scent of cypress.

items.title: L'eau Kenzo — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: L'eau Kenzo by Kenzo Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 1999 by French fashion house Kenzo, L'eau Kenzo is a member of the aromatic aquatic group of fragrances. The cologne features energizing top notes of crisp yuzu, lemon and green pepper. Cool heart notes of lotus, green, water and water mint impart refreshment, while base notes of white musk and cedar give a woody finish reminiscent of many traditional aftershaves.

items.title: Lacoste L'homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Lacoste L'homme by Lacoste Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Lacoste L'homme is a versatile blend of fruity and woody accords. This smooth and refined fragrance, introduced in 2017, opens with fruity top notes. Rhubarb and orange stand out the most but are joined by mandarin orange and quince.

items.title: Yacht Man Victory — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Yacht Man Victory by Myrurgia Eau DE Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Yacht Man Victory Cologne by Myrurgia

items.title: Yacht Man Trillion — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Yacht Man Trillion by Myrurgia Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Yacht Man Trillion Cologne by Myrurgia

items.title: Guess 1981 — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Guess 1981 by Guess Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: The well-known high-fashion brand Guess launched Guess 1981 in 2017. The base notes of leather and olibanum (also known as frankincense) are topped with oakmoss and cedar, and bergamot and violet leaf round out the fragrance. The seductive scent is encased in a sleek glass bottle.

items.title: Halloween Man Beware of Yourself — Eau de Toilette en spray 200 ml (6.8 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Halloween Man Beware of Yourself by Jesus Del Pozo Eau De Toilette Spray 6.8 oz for Men
items.description_en: Halloween Man Beware of Yourself Cologne by Jesus Del Pozo

items.title: Amyris Homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 71 ml (2.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Amyris Homme by Maison Francis Kurkdjian Eau De Toilette Spray 2.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Amyris Homme by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is a woody cologne for the refined gentleman. Delicate layers of spices, sweetness, florals and woods combine in this irresistible scent. Invigorating top notes of herbaceous rosemary and inviting mandarin orange are first to greet you before melting to an alluring heart accord of coffee, chocolate, amyris and iris.

items.title: Tobacco Blaze — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Tobacco Blaze by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Tobacco Blaze is a bold blend of leathery and fruity accords. This Rasasi fragrance, introduced in 2013, opens with confidence and intensity with heady white floral notes of lily-of-the-valley and neroli, and rich, warm saffron as well. The heart of the cologne features several myriad notes, most notably the soft sweetness of apricot.

items.title: Pure Essence — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Pure Essence by Pascal Morabito Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Pure Essence is a spicy and masculine cologne that is ideal for wearing every day. The top notes will entice you and consist of green apple, citrus and geranium. The heart note of cinnamon gives the scent a warmth and the base notes consist of sandalwood and cedar to ensure depth and longevity.

items.title: Black Granit — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Black Granit by Pascal Morabito Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Black Granit is a refreshing and masculine cologne that was introduced in 2013. It was created by Pascal Morabito, the French label founded by the designer of the same name. The top notes are an exciting mix of fruits and flowers with bergamot, sweet green apple and marigold.

items.title: Black Granit — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Sin caja) para hombre
items.title_en: Black Granit by Pascal Morabito Eau De Toilette Spray (Unboxed) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Black Granit is a refreshing and masculine cologne that was introduced in 2013. It was created by Pascal Morabito, the French label founded by the designer of the same name. The top notes are an exciting mix of fruits and flowers with bergamot, sweet green apple and marigold.

items.title: Red Amber — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre

items.description_en: Red Amber Cologne by Pascal Morabito

items.description_en: From Italian luxury fashion house Benetton comes a masculine fragrance with a unique blend of notes for a one-of-a-kind aromatic experience. Released in 2018, Colors De Benetton Blue opens with top notes of lemon, birchwood, and tequila. The heart notes brings in watermelon and coriander for a sweet and spicy turn, before the base notes of vetiver, musk, and juniper add a long-lasting finish.

items.description_en: Created by Anna Flipo and Carlos Benaim, 212 Vip Black was launched by the Carolina Herrera line in 2017. The sweetly spicy, yet musky fragrance is sophisticated and masculine. Sweet top notes of Absinthe, anise and fennel blend seamlessly into the slight floral middle note of lavender.

items.title: Bois De Vetiver — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Bois De Vetiver by Karl Lagerfeld Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: For the modern gentleman looking for a refreshing, clean scent, Bois de Vetiver by Karl Lagerfeld is the perfect everyday scent that will take you from a day packed with meetings to a night on the town. The cologne begins with invigorating top notes of mint, grapefruit and blood orange. A floral heart accord of delicate rose, geranium and vetiver softens the citrus.

items.title: Armaf Craze Noir — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Armaf Craze Noir by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Armaf Craze Noir is a blend of aromatic and gourmand accords. This fragrance opens with heliotrope and bergamot notes, topped with cumin, creating a beginning that is warm with a bit of clean freshness. At the heart of the cologne are notes of almond, lavender, sage and jasmine.

items.title: Armaf Eternia — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) para hombre

items.title_en: Armaf Hunter Intense by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Armaf Hunter Intense is an aromatic, woody, and floral cologne designed by the United Arab Emirates-based perfume company Armaf. Opening notes for this fragrance consist of an invigorating blend of citruses: bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin orange, and lemon. The heart notes are an intoxicating bouquet of ylang ylang, lavender, tuberose, and geranium, accented by lightly spicy cardamom and more potently spicy black pepper.

items.title: Burning Barbershop — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Burning Barbershop by D.S. & Durga Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Men

items.title_en: Italian Citrus by D.S. & Durga Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Green undertones and sophisticated spice notes add warmth to the zesty fruits of Italian Citrus, a 2011 cologne by perfumer David Seth Moltz of the D.S. & Durga design house.

items.title: Rasasi LaYuqawam — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Rasasi LaYuqawam by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2012 by Rasasi, Rasasi La Yuqawam is a warm fragrance designed for men. Top notes of saffron and sage complement a vibrant raspberry scent. Threads of jasmine, artemisia and olibanum create an enticing floral effect, offsetting the fruity notes and leading into the woody finish.

items.title: Montale Wood & Spices — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre

items.description_en: Montale Wood & Spices for men and women is a sultry, delicious fragrance suitable for spraying no matter what season it is. This scent is layered with earth notes, including fragrant agarwood, pungent cardamom and warm pimento. Later, waves of sandalwood, frankincense, ebony wood and vetiver debut for a cool, soothing finish.

The fragrance features the dry, smoky scent of vetiver with highlights of tart, juicy grapefruit and sharp black pepper. The underlying woody scent comes from notes of cedar and balsam, with a hint of herbal green from patchouli.

items.description_en: Kenzo Homme Cologne is a masculine fragrance made with a tantalizing blend of woody and spicy accords. The sophisticated cologne builds upon base notes of vetiver, sandalwood, oak moss, cedar, labdanum, amber, vanilla and fir balsam to create a masculine woodsy overtone. The heart of the fragrance consists of sage, nutmeg, lily of the valley, caraway, jasmine, iris, juniper berry, pine and rose.

items.title: Bentley Momentum — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Bentley Momentum by Bentley Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2017 by Bentley, Momentum is a musky, aromatic cologne. Aquatic notes and violet leaf ground the blend at its open while notes of bergamot and nutmeg add liveliness to the cologne. At the heart of the cologne, the floral note of jasmine is accompanied with soft notes of cashmere wood and ambergris.

items.title: Pure XS — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2017, Pure Xs is a sexy, erotic men’s fragranc with sweet, vanilla and balsamic accords. The top notes are bergamot, grapefruit, ginger, thyme and a green accord. Sweet vanilla and crisp green apple combine with leather, cinnamon and liquor in the heart.

items.description_en: A man who enters a room wearing Vespero, a cologne from Jeroboam first released in 2017, instantly makes a strong impression. The overall profile of this fragrance is earthy, due to cedar and other woody notes, and animalic, due to notes of amber, leather, and musk. Patchouli at the base also adds an oriental flair.

items.description_en: A fragrance bursting with numerous scent notes, Layton Exclusif was launched in 2017 by the French perfumer Parfums De Marly. Coffee, vanilla, sandalwood, amber, and guaiac wood are the base notes of this fragrance, with rose, water lily, and gardenia forming the middle notes and giving a sweet antidote to the woodiness of the base tones. Top notes of almond, bergamot, and mandarin orange give a spicy citrus vibe to this cologne.

items.description_en: Introduced in 2017 by Azzaro, Azzaro Pour Homme Edition Noire is a bold, fresh cologne. Bright top notes of bitter orange and lemon combine with sage at the opening of the blend. Caraway adds a spicy quality to the blend while geranium and artemisia add an earthiness to the cologne.

items.title: Eternity Air — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Eternity Air by Calvin Klein Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: On those warm, sunny days, you want a cologne that will have you feeling like a man. Eternity Air from Calvin Klein fits the bill perfectly. It immediately became a hit when it came out in 2018.

items.description_en: Bentley Absolute is a woody-oriental fragrance that was designed for men. It was launched in 2014 by the house of Bentley. This intensely masculine fragrance opens with the spicy top notes of ginger and pink pepper.

items.description_en: Perry Ellis 2017 Men is a masculine cologne released by the fragrance and fashion brand Perry Ellis in 2017. It has a fresh, aromatic scent that hints at the outdoors. The top notes are herbaceous, with lavender, bergamot and zesty verbena.

It is for the man who wishes to take the best of the outdoors with him wherever he goes. A unique blend of Texas rhubarb, wild sage and earthy moss, the cologne provides a fresh, clean scent that is suitable for daytime and evening occasions.

items.title: Acqua Di Gio Absolu — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Acqua Di Gio Absolu by Giorgio Armani Eau De Parfum Spray 4.2 oz for Men

Acqua Di Gio Absolu Cologne by Giorgio Armani, launched in 2018, opens with an alluring aquatic and citrus blend of marine top notes, bergamot and grapefruit. The sense of a warm, watery breeze gently welcomes earthy scents of rosemary, lavender and geranium.

This fragrance also draws influence from the scents found in the hills at Xalapa, Mexico.

It can be classed as an oriental cologne due to notes of musk and patchouli at the base and the heart, respectively. However, it also displays some elements of a chypre with its inclusion of moss and birch.

The scent opens with a fresh, ozonic effusion of pomelo and grapefruit spiced with green almond and anise. Marine and herbal tones develop at the heart, merging hints of salt and cardamom with clean lavender.

items.title: Adnan Man — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre

Cashmere wood, sandalwood and amber combine with base notes of tonka bean, musk and honey which lend the fragrance a warm sweetness.

It has an exotic, outdoorsy fragrance that opens with top notes of rice water and bergamot, a mild scent and a bitter, citrusy scent. The heart features black lava rocks mixed with the fragrant, spicy notes of saffron and black pepper.

items.title: Ajmal Shadow — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Ajmal Shadow by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Fresh and invigorating, Ajmal Shadow by Ajmal delivers an aura that is irresistible and memorable. This bold cologne opens with clean and energizing orange sprinkled with salty aquatic notes. As the aroma conjures visions of seaside adventures, sweet and calming violet and vanilla begin to take hold.

items.title: Ajmal Kuro — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Ajmal Kuro by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2018, Ajmal's Ajmal Kuro cologne contains a blend of spices and florals that are perfect for both day and evening wear. Spicy and woody notes of ambergris, pepper, patchouli and vetiver add a natural, masculine scent to this fragrance, and the blend of geranium, lavender and bergamot keeps it sweet and fresh enough not to be overwhelming. Spritz this fragrance on before heading to the office in the morning and know the long-lasting scent will continue well into the night.

items.title: Nautica Blue Sail — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Nautica Blue Sail by Nautica Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Citrus and woody aromatic tones are blended to perfection in Nautica Blue Sail, a light, summery men’s fragrance that’s casual yet sophisticated. Bright citrus and herbal notes open the scent, fusing orange zest and bergamot with brisk nuances of rosemary. The heart notes are dominated by a well-rounded aromatic accord of cypress and juniper berry harmonized with clean lavender.

items.title: Chrome Under The Pole — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Chrome Under The Pole by Azzaro Eau De Toilette Spray (Alcohol Free) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Chrome Under The Pole by Azzaro is a fresh, revitalizing men’s fragrance modeled after the expedition bearing the same name. The brand is actively involved in this undertaking, which shines a light on unexplored oceans to both discover and document. Bergamot, lemon, rosemary, pineapple and neroli form the top notes of the scent.

items.title_en: Acqua Di Parisis Royale by Reyane Tradition Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men

items.title_en: Black Pepper & Sandalwood by Acca Kappa Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Black Pepper & Sandalwood is a 2014 fragrance by Acca Kappa, an Italian company that has been creating scents since the end of the 20th century. This unisex product blends woody and spicy notes for a complex, appealing effect. You’ll notice nutmeg, black pepper, saffron and clove notes at the opening of the fragrance.

items.title: Mercedes Benz Select — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Mercedes Benz Select by Mercedes Benz Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2018 by luxury automobile brand Mercedes Benz, Mercedes Benz Select is a cologne for the man who craves adventure. Created by legendary perfumer Olivier Cresp, this fragrance is fresh, green and fruity with a hint of spice. The scent journey begins with top notes of black currant and bergamot before shifting to a heart accord of apple and mint.

items.title: Mercedes Benz Private — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Mercedes Benz Private by Mercedes Benz Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Mercedes Benz Private is a unisex cologne that spotlights the sensuality of nature with refreshing simplicity. You’ll love the complex blend of earthy notes including spicy cardamom and patchouli, sweet herbal lavender and cypress, and sophisticated ambrox (a synthetic version of ambergris). Released in 2018, this scent is completely contemporary with a refined, classic character.

items.title: English Laundry London — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: English Laundry London by English Laundry Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Thanks to English Laundry London Cologne, you can travel to England without ever leaving your hometown. This scent from fashion company English Laundry is inspired by the U.K.

items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Man Blue by Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette Spray 1 oz for Men
items.description_en: Opening with notes of leather and black pepper, Jimmy Choo Man Blue is an unmistakably male scent which is elegant as well as strong. It closes on the nose with earthy and natural tones, including sandalwood and vanilla tones.    Already famous around the world for his designer shoes, Jimmy Choo began making fragrences in 2011.

items.title_en: Coach Platinum by Coach Eau De Parfum Spray 6.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2018 by Coach, Coach Platinum is a spicy, woodsy cologne. At the opening of the blend, the juicy note of pineapple is complemented notes of earthy juniper berries and black pepper. Heart notes of geranium, sage and cashmeran add a sweet, green quality to the cologne.

items.title: Nautica Voyage Heritage — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Nautica Voyage Heritage by Nautica Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Crisp and energetic, Nautica Voyage Heritage Cologne is a fresh aquatic fragrance that layers bright citrus and herbal accords over a smoky wood base. The scent opens with an invigorating accord of fruity-aromatic bergamot and fresh ginger, followed by cooling green herbal notes of peppermint, lavender and woody nuances of rosemary oil. Base notes of earthy, subtly bitter vetiver harmonize with smooth sandalwood for a clean finish that’s casual yet sophisticated.

items.title: Bentley Black Edition — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Bentley Black Edition by Bentley Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Bentley Black Edition is a woody-spicy fragrance that was designed for men. It was launched by the house of Bentley in 2018. This composition opens with top notes of pink pepper, tangerine, nutmeg, and violet.

items.title: Kaloo Les Amis — Fragancia en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Kaloo Les Amis by Kaloo Eau De Senteur Spray / Room Fragrance Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Kaloo Les Amis builds upon base notes of blackberry, musk and sandalwood to create a sweet, powdery fragrance for babies. The heart of the cologne is made up of green leaves and lemon blossom, while top notes of lavender, bergamot, mint, mandarin orange and grapefruit give the fragrance a sweet, citrusy overtone. The overall result is an aromatic accord with hints of floralcy.

items.description_en: Launched in 2018 by Al Haramain, L’Aventure Knight is an Oriental fragrance for gentlemen of discerning taste and quality. Accords of citrus, woods, powder and florals marry to create a well-balanced cologne suitable for everyday use whether you’re going to the office or a dinner date. Refreshing top notes of tea, lemon verbena and bergamot open the scent before blending with a floral heart accord of violet leaf and iris.

items.description_en: You will feel like a boss with Cuba Vip from Fragluxe. The scent is powerful enough to draw attention to yourself but isn't so strong that it will turn people away. This cologne also is designed to last throughout the day, so you can wear it to work and for a night out.

Still, thanks to the cool mint and citrus notes, this Fragluxe fragrance is versatile enough for any season.

items.description_en: Aqua Kenzo is a masculine fragrance with a variety of woody accords. Launched by Kenzo in 2018, this contemporary scent opens with a spicy and citrusy kick of pink pepper, bergamot and apple. The heart contains green and water notes, sesame and hazelnut.

items.description_en: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male is a men’s cologne released by the fashion brand Jean Paul Gaultier in 2015. It is a reimagining of their classic men’s scent, Le Male. It opens with the sweet and aromatic scents of lavender, black mint, bergamot and strong notes of pear, which fade away and lead into the next scents.

items.title_en: Original Penguin Iconic Blend by Original Penguin Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced by Original Penguin in 2017, Iconic Blend is a mesmerizing woody, spicy cologne. Earthy violet leaf combines with the citrusy note of bergamot at the opening of the cologne. The note of nutmeg at the heart of the blend adds spiciness to the cologne while clary sage, geranium and angelica temper the aromatic note of nutmeg by adding earthy sweetness to the cologne.

items.title: Azzaro Wanted — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Azzaro Wanted By Night by Azzaro Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Azzaro Wanted By Night is a sensual oriental fragrance that was launched by Azzaro in 2018. This elegant cologne opens with bright mandarin, lemon and lavender top notes that are warmed by hints of cinnamon. Cumin, incense and red cedar heart notes bring an earthy element to the fragrance which is enhanced by cedar, cypress, vanilla, tobacco, leather, and patchouli base notes.

items.title: Nuit D'issey Bleu Astral — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) para hombre

items.description_en: Launched in 2017, Nuit D’issey Bleu Astral by Issey Miyake is a romantic, seductive cologne that is a perfect fit for nighttime wear. For an exciting entrance, lime and coriander make up the zesty and citrusy top notes. Leather is added into the mix as a rich heart note, adding an addictive depth to the cologne.

items.title: Lamborghini Acqua — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Acqua by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2014, Lamborghini Acqua Cologne for men is an exciting fragrance suitable for regular use. Warm cardamom, tangy yuzu and earthy clary sage arrive at first encounter. Deeper into the blend rests fresh Granny Smith apples and buttery nutmeg.

items.title: Lamborghini Sportivo — Eau de Toilette en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Sportivo by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: In 2012, Lamborghini Sportivo by Tonino Lamborghini was launched as a distinctive and exhilarating cologne. With cardamom, orange, and pimento as the top notes, this cologne starts off bitter yet aromatic. The heart notes are a fragrant and herbal blend of sage, lavender, and black tea.

items.title_en: Lamborghini Classico by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: In 2013, Tonino Lamborghini released Lamborghini Classico for men. The top notes of passionfruit, cardamom and lemon bring in a zesty and fresh scent that’s perfect for the summer months. The herbal middle notes consist of a mix of basil, lavender and sage, combining a myriad of aromas together.

items.title: Lamborghini Prestigio — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Prestigio by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray 4.2 oz for Men

items.title: Aigner First Class Executive — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Aigner First Class Executive by Etienne Aigner Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2016, Aigner First Class Executive is part of Etienne Aigner’s first class passenger fragrance line. The men’s fragrance has woody and citrus accords for a touch of masculine sophisticated class. Grapefruit, sweet orange and bergamot give the opening a fresh, citrusy start.

items.title: Baldessarini Ambre Oud — Eau de Toilette en spray 30 ml (1.0 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Baldessarini Ambre Oud by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray 1.0 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2002, this citrusy, aromatic fragrance is Baldessarini Ambre Oud by German fashion house and lifestyle brand Hugo Boss. The noses behind this scent are Jean-Marc Chaillan and Pierre Wargnye. The opening notes include mint, bitter orange and tangerine for a crispy, fresh introduction.

items.description_en: Introduced to the market in 2013, Franck Boclet Leather is a fragrance that speaks of power and indulgence with rich flavors throughout. Cumin, lemon and saffron begin the cologne with a kick before softening in the heart with notes of jasmine and rose. Lastly, the base notes are composed of warm amber and earthy leather for a sensual and smoldering finish.

items.title: Franck Boclet Incense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Incense by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Franck Boclet Incense is a fresh and woody Oriental fragrance for men, launched in 2013. For a spicy and energizing opening, the top notes are comprised of black pepper, pink pepper, cardamom and cinnamon. Benzoin makes up the heart of this cologne, before finishing off with strong woodsy flavors in the base notes of ebony tree, guaiac wood and sandalwood.

items.title: Franck Boclet Chypre — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Chypre by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2014, Franck Boclet Chypre is a masculine scent that exudes confidence for men. The top notes are comprised of bergamot, cardamom and orange blossom for a fresh and invigorating opening. The middle notes include soft tones of jasmine, rose and tuberose for a floral heart.

items.title: Franck Boclet Heliotrope — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Heliotrope by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Franck Boclet Heliotrope is a unisex fragrance that was released in 2014. The top notes include cloves, peach and thyme. A soft heart of floral tones, including orange blossom and rose, create the middle notes.

items.title: Franck Boclet Cedre — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Cedre by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2015, Franck Boclet Cedre combines spices with woody notes for a delightful fragrance for men. Since 2013, Franck Boclet has ventured into the world of fragrance after studying under Kenzo. Black pepper, atlas cedar and coconut start the fragrance on a sweet, spicy, woody note.

items.description_en: Introduced in 2012, Grey Quartz is a men’s fragrance that defies stereotypes. From French perfumier Pascal Morabito, this spicy masculine scent has a playful floral side that makes for a unique cologne. The fragrance opens with fruity notes of bergamot and mandarin before revealing heart notes of carnation, violet leaf, and earthy nutmeg.

items.description_en: Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo Signature is a leathery cologne for men, ideally suited for a cold winter’s night. It opens with a fresh blast of fruit notes, including lemon and Italian mandarin orange mixed with pink pepper. The fragrance takes on spicier notes with cinnamon, cardamom and cypress in the heart.

items.title: Yohji Yamamoto Homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Yohji Yamamoto Homme by Yohji Yamamoto Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2013 by Yohji Yamamoto, Yohji Yamamoto Homme is a citrusy, aromatic cologne. Earthy orris root is contrasted by the citrusy notes of lemon and bergamot at the top of the fragrance. At the heart of the blend, sage and violet leaf amplify the woody notes in the blend while warmth is added to the cologne due to the rich note of leather.

items.title: Korloff in White — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Korloff in White by Korloff Eau De Toilette Spray 3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2010, Korloff in White is an aromatic Fougere men’s fragrance. Named after a famous diamond, Korloff opened in 1978 selling jewelry then by 1996, fragrances. Top notes include violet leaf, cardamom and bergamot.

items.title: Eternity Flame — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Eternity Flame by Calvin Klein Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Leathery with accords of fruits and amber, Eternity Flame is a gentleman’s cologne sure to drive a partner wild. Let the scent waft over you and indulge in a top note of tropical pineapple. Rosemary comprises the heart of this fragrance before a long-lasting base of decadent amber, labdanum and leather rounds out the cologne.

items.title: Lolita Lempicka Homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Lolita Lempicka Homme by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men

items.title: Tom Ford Beau De Jour — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Tom Ford Beau De Jour by Tom Ford Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A masculine fragrance from Tom Ford, Tom Ford Beau De Jour features a classic aromatic scent that is perfect for daily use all year long. Lavender and lavandin top notes open the fragrance before leading you into a green and herbal heart. In the middle layer, mint, rosemary, basil and oakmoss provide a fresh element that is softened by hints of floral geranium.

Top notes of sugared citrus, coriander leaf and lemon zest form a refreshing opening layer that is complemented by woody middle notes of vetiver, cedar and cypress. Base notes of benzoin resins form the finishing touch.

items.description_en: Citizen Jack Absolute by Michael Malul, launched in 2019, bottles the energy, excitement and allure of embarking on a new adventure. Ideal for those who are wild at heart yet want to exude an air of classy sophistication, this cologne provides the aroma needed to show off your uniqueness. It opens with a fresh burst of bergamot and mandarin.

items.title: Chocman Mint — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Chocman Mint by Alyson Oldoini  Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: A rich, enveloping vanilla oriental gourmand built on decadent accords of chocolate and coffee, Alyson Oldoini Chocman Mint was first introduced in 2014. The opening is an effusive, sparkling blend of fruity aromatic bergamot, tropical fruit and lavender absolute spiked with piquant, tart-sweet hints of grapefruit and peppery geranium. As the scent settles, a deep, dark chocolate accord develops, merged with coffee, crushed mint leaf and tobacco.

items.title: Alyson Oldoini Crystal Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Alyson Oldoini Crystal Oud by Alyson Oldoini Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: First launched in 2014, Alyson Oldoini Crystal Oud is a warm, masculine woody aromatic scent illuminated by citrus and spice. The opening is bright and brisk with accords of tart-sweet rhubarb and Italian lemon spiced with piquant nuances of black pepper. Powdery poppy and earthy tones of patchouli, white truffle and incense emerge as the scent settles.

items.title: Rhum D'hiver — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Rhum D'hiver by Alyson Oldoini  Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: A beautifully warm and ambery spiced rum scent released in 2013, Alyson Oldoini Rhum D'hiver merges elements of aromatic spice, luminous citrus and liquor. The top notes are a boozy yet balanced, bright effusion of Calabrian bergamot, kumquat and Sicilian lemon merged with hints of rum. The rum accord deepens and smooths as the scent settles, joined by spice nuances of steamed cardamom, nutmeg and vetiver.

items.title: Cuir D'encens — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para hombre
items.title_en: Cuir D'encens by Alyson Oldoini Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: A distinctive woody oriental fragrance for men, Cuir D'encens was first introduced in 2013 by niche Italian label Alyson Oldoini. Opening notes are an elegant, effusive fruity-aromatic blend of Calabrian and Sicilian bergamot mingled with mandarin and soft hints of pink pepper. Sensual spicy and earthy tones dominate the heart, merging supple Russian leather with warm nuances of honey, cinnamon, nutmeg and steamed cardamom.

This irresistible fragrance is reminiscent of the great outdoors and features a delightful blend of smoky, floral and herbal accords. It opens with a zesty top note of bergamot mixed with fruity fig, herbal sage, sweet rosemary and spicy pepper.

items.description_en: Both a little sweet and a little spicy, Bucephalus Ix is another daring men's fragrance from Armaf. This 2019 scent opens with top notes of grapefruit, bergamot and mandarin. A complex heart of violet leaf, aquatic notes and black pepper enlivens your senses.

items.description_en: Radiate confidence with the fresh scent of Bucephalus Xi fragrance for men. This 2019 Armaf release begins with bright top notes of blackcurrant, bergamot and pineapple. Slightly sweet middle notes of jasmine, myrrh and rose melt into the base of vanilla, musk, ambergris and oak moss.

items.title: Armaf Sauville — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre

items.description_en: Arriving in a unique flask-shaped bottle, Armaf Sauville is an aromatic amber scent reminiscent of Sauvage by Dior. Top notes include lemon, pepper and a twist of mint followed by a heart of warm sage, pink pepper and lavender. A potent scent of ambroxan gleams from the base along with its partners labdanum, vetiver, patchouli and cedar.

items.title: Bucephalus X — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para hombre

items.description_en: Named for the powerful steed of Alexander the Great, Bucephalus X is a sweet, aromatic scent reminiscent of Invectus with a twist. It opens with warm elements of grapefruit, ginger, bergamot and pepper before settling into the soothing notes of apple, leather, geranium, lavender and cinnamon. Add in the base of vetiver, patchouli, cedar, myrrh and labdanum and you get a fragrance that hearkens to glory and passion along with the elements of class that are skillfully woven into every Armaf fragrance.

This revitalizing men's fragrance has the perfect blend of ozonic and aquatic accords. It features notes of Clary sage, grapefruit, cardamom, cinnamon and frozen violet leaf and hovers close to the skin from morning until late afternoon.

items.title: Madame Gres — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Madame Gres by Parfums Gres Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Exude passion and grace wearing the delightful feminine scent named for the founder of Parfums Gres. Launched in 2103 by the venerable Parisian design house, Madame Gres reflects the artistic genius of its namesake, a renowned couturier and one-time sculptor. This masterful oriental floral composition blends intoxicating magnolia with tropical pineapple, tart grapefruit citrus, sweet vanilla spice and warm sandalwood.

items.title: Encre Noire Sport — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Encre Noire Sport by Lalique Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Woody and aromatic accords converge in Encre Noire Sport, a fragrance designed for the man who enjoys wearing a rich, daring aroma while on the go. Created in 2013 by the design house of Lalique, this masculine fragrance opens up with fresh hints of grapefruit and bergamot that slowly mature into a heart of cypress and lavender and rest on a base of cashmere wood. Start your day with a few drops of Encre Noire Sport on your neck, wrists and pulse points for an extra confidence boost.

items.title: Gentlemen Only Intense — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Gentlemen Only Intense by Givenchy Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Turn things up a notch when you wear Gentlemen Only Intense, a profoundly evocative scent for men. This masculine 2014 fragrance by Givenchy masterfully melds earthy notes of patchouli, leather and birch leaf with spicy black pepper and exotic green Mandarin for an aroma that transcends any bar already set. Pair this scent with your designer suits for an enhanced professional image, or wear it to impress on a first, second or 20th date with someone very special.

items.title: Eau De Mandarine Ambree — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Eau De Mandarine Ambree by Hermes Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: The smooth, anchoring amber base in Eau De Mandarine Ambree allows the festive top notes of mandarin and passion fruit to arouse the senses of everyone around you. Wear this fragrance to an out-of-town work or school conference, a weekend brunch outing with your closest friends or an evening at the opera. This 2013 formulation from acclaimed fashion design house Hermes makes a bold yet tasteful first impression that gently fades into a titillating, long-lasting aroma.

items.title: Karl Lagerfeld — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Karl Lagerfeld by Karl Lagerfeld Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Karl Lagerfeld with perfumer Jean Christophe Herault and released in 2014.  A remarkable masculine scent blended to bring out your spirit and show the world how confident you are.  It has top notes of juicy mandarin and lavender oil.

items.title: Mustang Sport — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Mustang Sport by Estee Lauder Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Be ready for anything life brings your way with Mustang Sport by Estee Lauder. Created in 2014, this enchanting men's fragrance is the perfect combination of sweet and spicy. Sicilian bergamot brings an orange-like quality that makes you feel revitalized, while juicy grapefruit uplifts you, both contrasting with notes of black pepper which lend spice and masculinity.

items.title: The Original — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: The Original by Gap Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Complement your casual style and add a subtle hint of elegance to your everyday outfits with The Original. This timeless women's fragrance, released in 2007 by the scent specialists at Gap, is the perfect way to enhance your stylish sensibilities. The lightweight scent opens with top notes of plum, which move seamlessly into rich cedar and leather notes for a result that is classic and distinctive.

items.title: Halloween Man Rock On — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Halloween Man Rock On by Jesus Del Pozo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Let out your inner rock star by applying a little Halloween Man Rock On before you head out for the night. This men's fragrance blends the juiciness of red apple with lemon and bamboo for a surprising scent that is sure to earn you compliments. Top notes of pink pepper and cardamom add spice without overwhelming the rest of the fragrance.

items.title: Lalique L'amour — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Lalique L'amour by Lalique Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sensuous and romantic, Lalique L'Amour is a scent for women who aren't afraid to express their love of life. It bursts with energy and vigor from start to finish, brightening your day and infusing it with joy. Top notes of neroli and bergamot dance enticingly on your skin, setting a thrilling precedent for the soft notes of rose, jasmine and tuberose that follow.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Man — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Man by Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the famous shoe designer Jimmy Choo and released in 2014.  This is a confident masculine fruity blend.  Nothing wimpy about this one.

items.title: Nuit D'issey — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Nuit D'issey by Issey Miyake Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Issey Miyake with perfumers Dominique Ropion and Loc Dong.  Together they released it in 2014.  A deep rich spicy woodsy scent to bring magic to any night.

items.title: Nuit D'issey — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Nuit D'issey by Issey Miyake Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Issey Miyake with perfumers Dominique Ropion and Loc Dong.  Together they released it in 2014.  A deep rich spicy woodsy scent to bring magic to any night.

items.title: My Burberry — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: My Burberry by Burberry Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: With the resplendent bouquet of fruit and flowers, My Burberry for women takes you from day to evening with grace and sophistication. Lovely notes of sweet pea, geranium, freesia and rose entwine with the essence of bergamot to create an unforgettably fresh scent. Introduced in 2014, this striking fragrance from Burberry lets you express your unique femininity and features layers of depth and intensity.

items.title: Cordovan — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Cordovan by Banana Republic Eau De Toilette Spray (New Packaging Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2007, Cordovan men's fragrance represents the tenacity and courage of the modern male spirit. Wear the scent to declare yourself as smart, successful and suave in the workplace or at fun weekend events. The leather base of this Banana Republic fragrance provides just the right grip for its sweet fig leaf, bergamot, nutmeg and lavender notes to envelop you in a rich, crisp aroma that pairs perfectly with both casual and formal attire.

items.title: Boss Ma Vie — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Boss Ma Vie by Hugo Boss Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Certain fragrances are so wonderful that everyone around you remembers them, which is the case with Boss Ma Vie for women. Created by Hugo Boss in 2014, Boss Ma Vie features notes of cactus flower, pink freesia, jasmine and rose, with a touch of cedar to balance out the scent. Wear this fresh, floral fragrance in the morning to last through the toughest work days, or spray some on at night while relaxing away from the office.

items.title: Guess Dare — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Guess Dare by Guess Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Fresh spicy and aromatic, Guess Dare for men was launched in 2016 by the design house Guess. Perfumer Jacques Huclier formulated this masculine cologne as part of the Dare collection. Top notes are spicy and sharp with juniper berry, white pepper, and bergamot.

items.title: Byredo Oud Immortel — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Byredo Oud Immortel by Byredo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Show your love of nature or complement your down-to-earth personality by wearing Byredo Oud Immortel. Created in 2010 by Byredo, this scent for women covers you in earthy tones that help you feel like you're outdoors, even when you're in the office. Enjoy the blend of wood and spice notes, including agarwood, papyrus, oakmoss and cardamom, with the crisp note of limoncello to lighten it up and balance it out.

items.title: Bois 1920 Oro — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Bois 1920 Oro by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Waltz through the day and into the night wearing Bois 1920 Oro, a women's fragrance designed with you in mind. Crafted by Bois 1920 and released to the public in 2013, this fragrance is redolent with the pungent scent of ginger. Sweet notes of raspberry linger in the air, wafting around the fresh, earthy scent of pine tree to create an intoxicating aroma.

items.title: Verde Di Mare — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Verde Di Mare by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Verve Di Mare is a women's fragrance that offers a sweet blend of fragrance notes that are fresh and flirty. Created in 2014 by Bois 1920, Verve Di Mare blends the feminine scent of juniper berries with uplifting notes of lemon and the tangy qualities of black currant. Black tea notes are instantly energizing, while vanilla lends its familiar, comforting qualities.

items.title: Versace Yellow Diamond Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Versace Yellow Diamond Intense by Versace Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Express your passion with the bold, enchanting scent of Versace Yellow Diamond Intense. Introduced in 2014, this luxurious fragrance perfectly complements women who are fearless and full of life. Notes of pear, citron and orange blossoms create a fresh, compelling blend that is sure to captivate and attract, while hints of bergamot and neroli add a soft, mysterious undertone.

items.title: Dolce & Gabbana Intenso — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Dolce & Gabbana Intenso by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2014.  A deep rich woodsy cologne for men.  An elegant aromatic blend of notes that while very deep, it still has a refreshingly charming side.

items.title: Lacoste Eau De Lacoste L.12.12 Jaune — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lacoste Eau De Lacoste L.12.12 Jaune by Lacoste Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Fun and fresh, Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Jaune lifts your mood and puts a spring in your step.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Blossom — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Blossom by Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Get carried away in the notes of a flourishing English garden when you spritz on Jimmy Choo Blossom. This decadent fragrance for women from designer Jimmy Choo was launched in 2015 and contains a crisp mix of notes to invigorate the senses and captivate those around you. The scent's medley of citrus, red berries and raspberry mingles with innocent notes of rose and sweet pea to envelop your body in fragrance, leaving you feeling beautifully feminine and youthful.

items.title: Gucci Bamboo — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Gucci Bamboo by Gucci Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Step out of the house feeling fantastic when you wear Gucci Bamboo for women from the storied house of Gucci. Created in 2015, Bamboo mingles floral notes of Casablanca lily and orange blossom with bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang to create a fragrance ideal for wearing all day, every day. Dab it on before heading to work in the morning, or give yourself a tiny spritz before a night on the town to ensure you smell great all night.

items.title: Somei Yoshino — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Somei Yoshino by Berdoues Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2015, Berdoues by Somei Yoshino features a refined fragrance profile carefully selected to produce complex and tantalizing contrasts. This fabulous fragrance for women opens with a splash of fresh and peppery shiso that grabs your attention, followed closely by the narcotic influence of intoxicating jasmine sambac. The sensuous scent of earthy patchouli finishes this intensely feminine blend.

items.title: Prada Luna Rossa Sport — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
