items.title_en: Prada Luna Rossa Sport by Prada Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Prada with perfumer Daniela Andrier and released in 2015.  A fresh spicy outdoorsy scent with a sweet side.  A relaxed blend that keeps your senses entertained for hours.

items.title: L'homme Ideal — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: L'homme Ideal by Guerlain Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Created by the house of Guerlain with perfumer Thierry Wasser and released in 2014.  You won't mistake this blend for anything other than a remarkable woodsy scent with a subtle personality that is clearly magical.  Hours and hours of sheer delight.

items.title: Police To Be Camouflage — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police To Be Camouflage by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: When you first get a look at the bottle for Police To Be Camouflage by Police Colognes, it makes quite a lasting impression. It comes in the shape of a skull, which has been done before for other fragrances made by the same brand, except this cologne comes with a camouflage pattern. This cologne is aimed toward modern men who want something with a powerful composition.

items.title: Jaguar Classic — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jaguar Classic by Jaguar Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by Jaguar with perfumers Takasago and Dominique Preyssas.  It was released in 2002.  A fresh aquatic cologne with floral notes at its heart.

items.title: Ari — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Ari by Ariana Grande Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the lovely pop singer Ariana Grande as her first contribution to the perfume industry and released in 2015.  She did a heck of a good job with this enlightening fruity floral.  Brilliantly blended and just a sheer pleasure to wear.

items.title: Lady Emblem — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Lady Emblem by Mont Blanc Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by the house of Mont Blanc with perfumers Nicolas Beaulieu and Dominique Ropion, Lady Emblem was released in 2015. A flowery fruity perfume whose best notes are in its sweetness -- with this fragrance, romance is in the air! The top notes are peach, pink rose and red currant jam.

items.title: Olympea — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Olympea by Paco Rabanne Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Paco Rabanne with perfumers Anne Flipo, Loc Dong and Dominique Ropion.  It was released in 2015.  A sweet flowery perfume with a hint of salt and powder.

items.title: Boss The Scent — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Boss The Scent by Hugo Boss Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Always trendy and never outdated, Hugo Boss created Boss the Scent with everything the modern woman loves in mind. With each and every note, they seek to make a sweet yet spicy experience that’s perfect for practically any situation. The tops notes used to build the experience include peach and freesia, which then fade flawlessly into core notes of osmanthus.

items.title: Vince Camuto Amore — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Vince Camuto Amore by Vince Camuto Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the design house of Vince Camuto with perfumer Laurent Le Guernec and released in 2014.  Passionate in its blend, this perfume is an exquisite warm fruity floral scent.  It is a limited edition meant to celebrate being a woman.

items.title: Le Jardin De Monsieur Li — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Le Jardin De Monsieur Li by Hermes Eau De Toilette Spray (unisex Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: For an aromatic, citrus scent that both men and women can enjoy, Le Jardin De Monsieur Li by Hermes is excellent any time of day. This is a relatively new cologne, being released in 2015. The notes you are going to find in this fragrance include mint, jasmine and kumquat.

items.title: Mr Burberry — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Mr Burberry by Burberry Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Mr. Burberry is a masculine cologne for the confident man. The herbal, woody composition is inspired by classic, aromatic Fougère of many famous fragrances.

items.title: Piece Unique — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Piece Unique by Parfums Gres Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Piece Unique draws inspiration from an artistic approach to fashion: the search for the ultimate haute couture. Pink peppercorn adds pizazz to tangy mandarin while black pepper enhances angelica, a smooth vegetal musk with surprisingly fresh, woody, herbal accents. Heart center notes of a delicate jasmine bouquet, ripe, fruity plum accord and absinthe wormwood are softened by rich base notes of frankincense, sensual leather, musk, patchouli and davana oil extract.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Illicit — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Illicit by Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Jimmy Choo’s Illicit is a new eau de parfum for women that was released in 2015. This sweet and spicy floral scent opens with hints of ginger and citrus, creating a sense of energy and freshness. On a deeper level, the perfume reveals a touch of sweet rose with jasmine, and the primary vehicle that pulls all the elements together is seductive honey.

items.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Ultra — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Ultra by Jean Paul Gaultier Eau De Toilette Intense Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Ultra, or “Ultra Male,” gives men a seductive energy that is both powerful and inviting. The base of amber, black vanilla and woods allows contrasting light and sharp notes to blend and create a very distinctive character. Its bergamot, pear, black lavender and mint give it its softer side, and its contrasting cumin, cinnamon and sage give it a biting and spicy edge.

items.title: Davidoff Horizon — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Davidoff Horizon by Davidoff Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Davidoff Horizon for men is a woody, aromatic cologne for men that embodies the link between earth and air. It opens with traces of citrus and spice from grapefruit, mandarin, warm rosemary and ginger. Darker, earthier middle notes blend scents of cedar, nutmeg, patchouli, sesame and pepper.

items.title: Montblanc Legend Spirit — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Montblanc Legend Spirit by Mont Blanc Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Montblanc Legend Spirit launched as an exclusive men’s cologne in 2016, symbolizes classy, timeless elegance. The crisp, aromatic sense opens with a zesty, vibrant blend of grapefruit, pink pepper and bergamot. A refreshing, aquatic accord rules the heart notes which are a soft blend of cardamom and lavender.

items.title: Viva La Juicy Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Viva La Juicy Rose by Juicy Couture Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Viva La Juicy Rose is a rosy fragrance for women with fresh, fruity and floral notes. This perfume opens with top notes of jasmine, mandarin orange and pear. The mandarin orange provides an initial scent that is fresh, sweet, succulent and juicy.

items.title: La Perla J'aime Elixir — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: La Perla J'aime Elixir by La Perla Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2015, La Perla J’aime Elixir has everything a woman needs to perfectly encapsulate the sense of seduction. This is one fragrance you can wear every single day no matter what the occasion might call for. From the casual to the formal, this perfume offers a refreshing aroma consisting of top notes of black pepper, mandarin oil and bergamot.

items.title: 1881 Sport — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: 1881 Sport by Nino Cerruti Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: 1881 Sport is a woody, aromatic cologne in limited edition from Nino Cerruti. Arriving on the scene in 2016, this fresh and light men’s cologne is a great choice by day and night, just right for a lunch date or casual dinner. Fresh off the top are lemon, bergamot and marine notes, which give way to cardamom, geranium, lavender and hedione.

items.title: Mercedes Benz Intense — Eau de Toilette en spray 120 ml (4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Mercedes Benz Intense by Mercedes Benz Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by Mercedes Benz with perfumer Olivier Cresp and released in 2013.  An exciting warm spicy scent with a very unique blend of notes to create a one of a kind experience for you.  It is a fresh, rich and somewhat deeper than the original cologne.

items.title: Time to Play — Eau de Toilette en spray 60 ml (2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Time to Play by Puma Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 2 oz for Men
items.description_en: When the time comes to play intensive sports with your mates, you need solid cologne to smell your best afterward. Before you head out to the gym or field, make sure you have Time to Play cologne by Puma in your pack. This fragrance was released in the summer of 2014 just in time for the World Soccer Championship of that year.

items.title: Mercedes Benz Le Parfum — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Mercedes Benz Le Parfum by Mercedes Benz Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by Mercedes Benz with perfumer Olivier Cresp and released in 2015.  A masculine scent that is woodsy with a bit of a green side and spicy highlights to add great interest.  Great for those cooler winter nights.

items.title: I Love Juicy Couture — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: I Love Juicy Couture by Juicy Couture Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2016.  A wonderful feminine fruity floral perfume.  Yummy and fragrant notes blended together sure to make you fall in love.

items.title: Acqua Di Parma Peonia Nobile — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Acqua Di Parma Peonia Nobile by Acqua Di Parma Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Acqua Di Parma Penia Nobile is a scent designed for women that truly attempts to grasp the essence of everything floral in its makeup. The designer, Acqua Di Parma, attempts to offer the freshest experience possible by introducing top scent notes like black pepper, musk, patchouli, raspberry, peony, amber, freesia, geranium and Turkish rose, and expertly combining them to make a one-of-a-kind perfume.  Acqua Di Parma is an Italian designer that’s been creating scents since 1916.

items.title: Versace Pour Homme Dylan Blue — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Versace Pour Homme Dylan Blue by Versace Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Recently launched in 2016, Versace Pour Homme Dylan Blue by Versace provides a delicate balance of citrus, spicy and musk accords, creating an ideal daily scent. The fragrance opens with fresh top notes of water, grapefruit, fig and bergamot. These are followed by a complex middle blend of floral and woodsy violet leaf, papyrus and patchouli mixed with spicy black pepper and ambroxan.

items.title: John Varvatos Artisan Blu — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: John Varvatos Artisan Blu by John Varvatos Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2016.  It is a masculine full bodied complex blend of notes that creates a unique fresh aquatic cologne that is sure to set you apart from the others.  This rich blend that starts off quiet, but give it a little time to settle in.

items.title: Good Girl — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Good Girl by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Good Girl by Carolina Herrera is a new fragrance that was launched in 2016. The slogan for this perfume is “It’s so good to be bad,” and you will definitely be feeling a little feistier when wearing it. The main notes in this fragrance are roasted tonka bean and tuberose.

items.title: iCarly iGlam — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: iCarly iGlam by Nickelodeon Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: iCarly iGlam Perfume by Nickelodeon

items.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir by Narciso Rodriguez Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Narciso Rodriguez with perfumer Sonia Constant and released in 2015.  An amazingly crafted fresh spicy scent for men.  With a personality that is sharp, clean and crisp which allows you to enjoy for hours.

items.title: Police Original — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police Original by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Police Original for men by Police Colognes was the very first fragrance released by the brand house. It came out in 1998 to great financial success. With the wonderful array of notes found within the cologne, it is no wonder that it found an audience.

items.title: Sarah Jessica Parker Stash — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Sarah Jessica Parker Stash by Sarah Jessica Parker Eau De Parfum Elixir Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This is a unisex fragrance created by Sarah Jessica Parker with perfumers Laurent Le Guernec and Clement Gavarry.  They released it is 2016 for both men and women to enjoy wearing it.  It is an earthy warm and spicy scent with a naughty side.

items.title: Coach — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Coach by Coach Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Coach in 2017, Coach for Men is a spicy, aromatic blend. The blend opens with bright top notes of bergamot, green nashi pear, kumquat and lavender. Middle notes of cardamom, geranium and coriander give the cologne its bold, spicy quality.

items.title: Coach — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Coach by Coach Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: How does one define a classic? While the answers vary from person to person, some attributes are universally recognizable. This 2016 version of Coach’s newest fragrance shares a name with the 2007 original, but with a drastically different package and aromatic profile than the earlier release.

items.title: Police Dark — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Police Dark by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Police Dark for women by Police Colognes is a seductive fragrance that adds a sense of elegance to any event. It was released in 2011. The opening of this perfume consists of juicy mandarin surrounding refreshingly vibrant violet leaves.

items.title: Mustang Performance — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Mustang Performance by Estee Lauder Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Mustang Performance by Estee Lauder is a highly masculine fragrance that has some exceptional aromatic, green accords to it. It came out in 2016. The notes you are going to find within this cologne are mint, lavender, sandalwood, vanilla, grass, cardamom, musk and green leaves.

items.title: Moschino Fresh Couture — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Moschino Fresh Couture by Moschino Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Moschino Fresh Couture is the second fragrance ever made by the brand, having been released in 2015. The inspiration behind the fragrance and the bottle was to combine the precious with the mundane, offering wearers something totally unique. Despite its traditional spray cleaner bottle aesthetic, it has some wonderfully rich aromas to it.

items.title: Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo by Salvatore Ferragamo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in the autumn of 2016, Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo is a new signature fragrance from the brand house. Its rich accords make it highly masculine and perfect for men who want to showcase their appreciation for the Italian lifestyle. Bergamot, cardamom and black pepper exist in the top of this cologne.

items.title: Eau De Neroli Dore — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Eau De Neroli Dore by Hermes Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Eau De Neroli Dore by Hermes is a newer fragrance, having come out in 2016. It continues the long-lasting legacy of the brand and has been well-received. There are only three notes in this cologne, but it is enough to leave an impact.

items.title: Byredo Super Cedar — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Byredo Super Cedar by Byredo Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Byredo Super Cedar is a distinct, utterly unique unisex scent launched by the Byredo brand in 2016. As such a recent creation it embraces everything fragrance fans love about the modern perfume world. A strong note of rose serves as the introductory scent to this particular fragrance, which is closely followed by a heart note of strong, earth cedar.

items.title: Carven Le Parfum — Fragancia 200 ml (6.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Carven Le Parfum by Carven Perfumed Bath and Shower Gel (Tester) 6.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in the early months of 2013, Carven Le Parfum by Carven is an excellent addition to any perfume aficionado’s collection of scents. This particular fragrances was designed to capture the emotion of spontaneity and joy in a bottle, which the designer begins by introducing wearers to top notes of mandarin blossom, apricot and white hyacinth. This is closely bonded with heart notes of jasmine, sweet pea and ylang-ylang.

items.title: Sweet Like Candy — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Sweet Like Candy by Ariana Grande Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sweet candy, berries and vanilla are the definitive aromas in Sweet Like Candy, a women’s fragrance by young American pop star Ariana Grande. This 2016 launch is marked by shades of white flowers and powder and features enough sweet ingredients to serve as dessert. Tangy blackberries, citrus-like bergamot and sweet, juicy pear are the top notes in this confection.

items.title: Trussardi Black Extreme — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Trussardi Black Extreme by Trussardi Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Trussardi with perfumer Aurelien Guichard and released in 2014.  A rich leather scent with some water notes to help keep it fresh.  Elegant by nature and just a little bit shy.

items.title: Her Majesty The Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Her Majesty The Oud by Atkinsons Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2016.  An oriental floral fragrance with the grace and elegance for a queen.  A rich blend of notes with a bit of spice to keep things lively.

items.title: The Big Bad Cedar — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: The Big Bad Cedar by Atkinsons Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: This is a unisex fragrance created by the house of Atkinsons as part of their Contemporary Collection released in 2016.  It is an exciting woodsy scent for both men and women to enjoy wearing.  An easy going cedar scent with hints of spices and a bit of sweetness along the way.

items.title: White Tea — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: White Tea by Elizabeth Arden Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Elizabeth Arden with perfumers Rodrigo Flores Roux, Guillaume Flavigny and Caroline Sabas.  It was released in 2017 as a remarkable fresh warm floral perfume for women.  A classy herbal scent with exotic notes to provide you with an exciting experience.

items.title: CK All — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: CK All by Calvin Klein Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This is a unisex fragrance created by the design house of Calvin Klein with perfumers Alberto Morillas and Harry Fremont.  It was released in 2017.  This fragrance for both men and women is a refreshing citrus scent that is easy to wear.

items.title: Jimmy Choo L'eau — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo L'eau by Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Jimmy Choo with perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou and released in 2017.  A gorgeous fresh fruity floral perfume for women.  Spectacular in nature, this blend is so captivating it will quickly become a favorite.

items.title: Halloween Mia Me Mine — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Halloween Mia Me Mine by Jesus Del Pozo Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was the house of Jesus Del Pozo with perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou and released in 2017 as part of the Halloween collection.  A unique oriental floral perfume that will make you feel very special.  An unusual blend of notes allows this scent to come alive in a magical way.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Ice — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Ice by Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: The fragrance was created by the design house of Jimmy Choo with perfumer Michel Almairac and released in 2017.  A masculine earthy woodsy cologne enhanced with the freshness of fruit notes.  This crisp scent opens rather icy, as it settles in you will enjoy the rest of the notes announcing their arrival.

items.title: Hugo Iced — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Hugo Iced by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2017.  A refreshing citrus scent with an aquatic personality.  Minty fresh and exhilarating at the top.

items.title: Mon Guerlain — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Mon Guerlain by Guerlain Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Guerlain with perfumers Thierry Wasser and Delphine Jelk.  It was released in 2017.  A relaxing oriental woodsy perfume for women.

items.title: Gucci Bloom — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Gucci Bloom by Gucci Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Gucci with perfumer Alberto Morillas and released in 2017.  It is a floral perfume with a smooth silky personality.  With a powdery side this scent allows you to indulge yourself in the creamy flowers in the blend.

items.title: Tous Bonjour Senorita — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Tous Bonjour Senorita by Tous Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by master perfumer Nathalie Lorson under the Spanish cosmetics and accessories brand Tous, Tous Bonjour Senorita is a floral and fruity perfume for women. Released in 2017, the fragrance is perfect for every day wear, especially in the warmer months of the year. Opening notes for the perfume consist of a fresh, tart, and fruity blend of mango, raspberry, and bergamot.

items.title: Gucci Guilty Absolute — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Gucci Guilty Absolute by Gucci Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Gucci with perfumer Alberto Morillas and released in 2017.  It is a warm leathery scent for men.  It has a bold and exciting personality without being overbearing.

items.title: Mercedes Benz Woman — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Mercedes Benz Woman by Mercedes Benz Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2016 by Mercedes Benz, Mercedes Benz Woman Perfume is the perfect scent to add to your collection. This unique scent stands out without being too overpowering and is perfect for everyday wear. Top notes of black currant leaf and aromatic lavender combine with the soft, subtle tone of a sweet, juicy pear.

items.title: Paris Hilton Rose Rush — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Paris Hilton Rose Rush by Paris Hilton Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Paris Hilton Rose Rush by Paris Hilton, launched in 2017, brings together the honey sweetness of neroli and the warmth of rose to blend seamlessly with the freshness of lychee at the top. Middle notes of papaya and peony provide gentle contrast, while a base of amber, cedarwood and musk add depth and dimension. Perfect for a morning jaunt or an afternoon tea, this fruity, floral scent adds waves of sexy, flirty fun to your day.

items.title: Girl of Now — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Girl of Now by Elie Saab Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: With a sweet almond scent, Girl of Now is an oriental floral fragrance for women, released by Elie Saab in 2017. Top notes are tart mandarin orange, juicy pear, and nutty pistachio, with sweet orange blossom, lush magnolia, and succulent almond providing the middle heart notes. The base notes are earthy patchouli, musky cashmeran, aromatic tonka bean, and sweet almond milk.

items.title: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric G — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric G by Gwen Stefani Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Creamy with a soft touch of woods, Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric G is your new go-to scent for everyday use. Top notes of whipped cream and coconut are first to greet you before melting to a floral heart accord. A long-lasting base of musk and wood will linger on your wrist like a kiss.

items.title: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Baby — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Baby by Gwen Stefani Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: For the vivacious, carefree woman, spray on some Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Baby by Gwen Stefani and you will have found your new signature scent. This powdery perfume is soft and feminine, perfect for everyday use. The sweet scent of flowers begins the scent profile before moving to a middle layer of warm vanilla.

items.title: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Music — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Music by Gwen Stefani Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: For the woman who loves an energetic concert, a spritz of Harajuku Pop Electric Music and you are the center of an epic dance party. Alluring top notes of wild berries and apple invite you in before melting to a middle layer of delicate florals and water notes. A sultry base of musk and amber will have those around you leaning in closer.

items.title: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Love — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Love by Gwen Stefani Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Floral and fruity with a touch of sultry musk, Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Love is the perfect scent to take you from the office to your dinner date. Top notes of luscious pear and tart apple invite you in before drying to a middle layer of delicate jasmine. An enticing base of musk and Cashmere wood will keep you sniffing your wrist.

items.title: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Lil' Angel — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Lil' Angel by Gwen Stefani Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: A spritz of the sugary sweet Harajuku Lovers Pop Electric Lil' Angel and you will smell delicious enough to eat. Fresh and fruity with a powdery dry down, this flirty perfume makes a great summertime scent. The perfume opens with a top note of red berries before moving to a floral heart accord of rose and violets with a splash of sugar.

items.title: Clean Rain Reserve Blend — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Clean Rain Reserve Blend by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Purifying and fresh, Clean Rain Reserve Blend is a spring and summertime fragrance with elements of rainwater, salt, citrus and flowers. The opening is a bright, elegantly aromatic effusion of bergamot. Clean, subtly aquatic white florals emerge at the heart, fusing jasmine with lovely lily-of-the-valley.

items.title: Jacques Bogart Club 75 — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jacques Bogart Club 75 by Jacques Bogart Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Jacques Bogart Club 75 fragrance for men offers fruity and spicy top notes of orange, lemon and cinnamon that give way to fresh heart notes of pungent lavender and crisp apple. Citrus and a singular spice and floral are tempered by rich, bracing and exotic foundational notes of cedar, sandalwood and musk. Jacques Bogart is a family-run and independent concern based in Paris that produces fragrances and skincare for a discerning male clientele.

items.title: Prada L'homme Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Prada L'homme Intense by Prada Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: L'homme Intense Prada launched in 2017 as a more dynamic version of the men’s L’Homme scent from Prada. The creation of perfumer Daniela (Roche) Andrier, this masculine fragrance begins with captivating top notes of amber and iris. Masculine leather and patchouli notes fill out the heart of this alluring scent, as tonka bean and sandalwood provide the exotic base notes.

items.title: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura by Acqua Di Parma Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura by Acqua Di Parma is a fresh and aromatic womens fragrance released in 2017. The perfume has bright, citrus top notes of bergamot, petitgrain, and orange, which are followed by middle notes of narcissus, coriander, and jasmine. Its base notes include white musk, patchouli, and cedar.

items.title: My Burberry Blush — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: My Burberry Blush by Burberry Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fruity, floral and feminine, My Burberry Blush was created for Burberry in 2017. Designed by perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, the scent's top notes include lemon and pomegranate. After the initial spritz, the wearer finds the heart of the fragrance, which includes rose, green apple and geranium.

items.title: Lacoste L'homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lacoste L'homme by Lacoste Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Lacoste L'homme is a versatile blend of fruity and woody accords. This smooth and refined fragrance, introduced in 2017, opens with fruity top notes. Rhubarb and orange stand out the most but are joined by mandarin orange and quince.

items.title: Stella Pop Bluebell — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Stella Pop Bluebell by Stella McCartney Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: Iconic designer Stella McCartney launched the mysterious, feminine Stella Pop Bluebell fragrance in 2017. This combination of sweet florals and dense, alluring woods creates enigmatic appeal. Top notes include English bluebell, violet leaf, green mandarin and tomato leaf.

items.title: Pure XS — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2017, Pure Xs is a sexy, erotic men’s fragranc with sweet, vanilla and balsamic accords. The top notes are bergamot, grapefruit, ginger, thyme and a green accord. Sweet vanilla and crisp green apple combine with leather, cinnamon and liquor in the heart.

items.title: Etat Libre D'orange Divin Enfant — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Etat Libre D'orange Divin Enfant by Etat Libre d'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Make yourself irresistible to that special someone in your life by wearing Divin Enfant perfume from Etat Libre d’Orange. This fragrance embodies the essence of a ruthless yet angelic child. The top notes of the composition are soft and gentle with scents of orange blossom and marshmallow.

items.title: Guess 1981 Indigo — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Guess 1981 Indigo by Guess Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Guess 1981 Indigo is a 2018 fragrance with a refreshing, casual vibe that calls to mind the company’s iconic blue jeans. The long-lasting scent opens with top notes of fruit, citrus and herbs, including bergamot orange, sage, blue lavender and fig. Beneath, the heart of the fragrance infuses notes of coconut nectar, iris, tonka bean and oak moss.

items.title: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue by Versace Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue, created by Versace, debuted in 2017. This tantalizing perfume opens with top notes Granny Smith apple, shiso, clover, black currant, forget-me-not and shiso for an intriguing combination that is feminine and passionate. The fruity and floral middle notes of rose, jasmine, petalia, peach and rosyfolia fuse together for a delicate, graceful aroma.

items.title: Oud Stars Malesia — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Oud Stars Malesia by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Chris Maurice, Oud Stars Malesia is a mesmerizing woody oriental fragrance that layers shimmering white florals over a rich balsamic musk base. Sweet, clean and intoxicating, bright tones of lily-of-the-valley open the fragrance, warmed by a serene heart of amber and gurjan balsam. Woody and earthy base notes balance the opening beautifully, mingling smoky oud and tonka bean with labdanum, tolu balsam and musk to produce an arresting, alluring trail that lasts all day.

items.title: Carven L'absolu — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Carven L'absolu by Carven Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: When romance is in the air, a spritz of Carven L'absolu by Carven fuels the passion fires. Released in 2015, this sensual scent is bold and for the woman who knows what she wants. An opening of rich ylang and fresh mandarin perk up the senses.

items.title: Daisy Love — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Daisy Love by Marc Jacobs Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Daisy Love by Marc Jacobs is a romantic blend that perfectly combines floral and musky notes. The sweet, fruity note of cloudberry gives the perfume an unforgettable opening. The note of daisy at the heart of the fragrance amplifies the sweetness in the blend.

items.title: Dolce Garden — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Dolce Garden by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Dolce Garden is a floral-gourmand fragrance for women that was launched by Dolce & Gabbana in 2018. This fragrance opens with top notes of mandarin, magnolia, and neroli. Its middle notes consist of frangipani, coconut, and ylang-ylang.

items.title: Safran Rare — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Safran Rare by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Safran Rare is a sweet and smoky fragrance created by Amouroud in 2016. The base notes of sandalwood, benzoin, oud wood and woody vetiver establish a woody scent, while jasmine creates a comforting aroma. The middle notes, which include rose de mai, cedar, saffron and more jasmine, add a floral touch to the perfume along with some spice.

items.title: Midnight Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Midnight Rose by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Midnight Rose is a woodsy, floral fragrance that has an almost autumnal feel to it. Perfect for evening, this feminine scent has fragrant notes of iris and rose as well as fruity lychee and spicy amber that linger pleasantly through the night. First released in 2016, this sensuous scent is from the fragrance house of Amouroud, a relative newcomer to the world of scents and is establishing a name for itself with several popular unisex fragrances.

items.title: Miel Sauvage — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Miel Sauvage by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: If you are searching for the right evening scent to entice the senses then the Miel Sauvage fragrance by Amouroud is the right choice. Its top notes of red pepper and mandarin open up the fragrance with the right kick. Meanwhile, golden honey notes inject a subtle feminine sweetness.

items.title: Moschino Toy — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Moschino Toy by Moschino Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Moschino in 2014, Moschino Toy is a fun and youthful fragrance that is suitable for both men and women. Bright and fruity top notes of juniper berries, mandarin, bergamot and cardamom open the fragrance. Middle notes of hawthorn petals and lavender provide a floral softness that is further enhanced by warm, earthy base notes of sandalwood, musk, cedar and vanilla.

items.title: Girl of Now Shine — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Girl of Now Shine by Elie Saab Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Girl of Now Shine is the classic fragrance creation of Lebanese fashion designer Elie Saab. Released in 2018, the perfume is for the woman who loves a scent that reflects her own complexity. Bursting top notes of pineapple, pear and mandarin open up the fragrance and merge into sweet heart notes of ylang-ylang and orange blossom.

items.title: Clean Fresh Linens — Eau de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Clean Fresh Linens by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir and launched in 2018, Clean Fresh Linens by Clean is as comforting and inviting as sheets straight out of the wash. Accords of clean sheets, succulent Asian pear and juicy clementine form the top notes of the fragrance. A light and floral freshness makes a presence in the heart of the scent with notes of rain lily, orchid and blonde woods.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Man Blue — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Man Blue by Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Opening with notes of leather and black pepper, Jimmy Choo Man Blue is an unmistakably male scent which is elegant as well as strong. It closes on the nose with earthy and natural tones, including sandalwood and vanilla tones.    Already famous around the world for his designer shoes, Jimmy Choo began making fragrences in 2011.

items.title: The Artist — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: The Artist by Gap Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The artist is a versatile fragrance for women and men. This beautifully crafted scent consists of three notes. Fresh violet leaf, an aqueous green note popular in unisex fragrances, opens the fragrance.

items.title: Kaloo Les Amis — Fragancia en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Kaloo Les Amis by Kaloo Eau De Senteur Spray / Room Fragrance Spray (Alcohol Free Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Kaloo Les Amis builds upon base notes of blackberry, musk and sandalwood to create a sweet, powdery fragrance for babies. The heart of the cologne is made up of green leaves and lemon blossom, while top notes of lavender, bergamot, mint, mandarin orange and grapefruit give the fragrance a sweet, citrusy overtone. The overall result is an aromatic accord with hints of floralcy.

items.title: Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver by Hermes Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Named for its signature ingredient, Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver by Hermes is a quintessentially masculine cologne that made its debut in 2018. Vetiver opens the fragrance with its grassy, woody character. Classic cologne stalwarts Sichuan pepper, bergamot and citrus complement the vetiver with their equally distinct natures.

items.title: Cuba VIP — Eau de Parfum en spray 35 ml (1.17 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Cuba VIP by Fragluxe Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.17 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by the label Cuba Paris and distributed by Fragluxe, Cuba Vip for women is a lush fruity and floral scent that is the perfect complement to hot summer days and fun nights out on the town. The opening is a sparkling, effervescent blend of ripe peach and pink champagne. Peach and orange blossom bloom at the heart: light, feminine and irresistible.

items.title: Aqua Kenzo — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Aqua Kenzo by Kenzo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2018 by Kenzo, Aqua Kenzo is a fruity and fun fragrance for women. The unique scent opens with top notes of raspberry leaf, mandarin orange and lemon for a touch of citrusy flavor. The heart consists of jasmine, rose, hedione, magnolio, apple and other green notes.

items.title: The Only One — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: The Only One by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: A sweet powdery fragrance for women, The Only One recently launched in August 2018. Floral violet combines with citrusy orange and crisp bergamot in the top notes. Coffee and pear combine with floral notes of iris, orange blossom and rose in the heart.

items.title: Sotoor RAA — Eau de Parfum en spray 98 ml (3.33 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Sotoor RAA by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.33 oz for Women
items.description_en: A fragrance for both sexes, Rasasi Sotoor debuted in 2017. Citrusy lemon and crisp bergamot top notes give the scent a light start. Lily of the valley, jasmine and nutmeg lightly spice up the heart.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Fever — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Fever by Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Jimmy Choo Fever is an elegant, sophisticated women’s perfume released by Jimmy Choo in 2018. It combines fruity notes with a touch of simple floral and a deep base. Its top notes are a richly fruit blend of lychee, black plum and citrusy grapefruit.

items.title: Lamborghini Intenso — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Intenso by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: In 2010, Tonino Lamborghini launched Lamborghini Intenso as a mens’ cologne. Starting from the base notes, benzoin, tonka bean and amber create an invigorating combination of spiciness and sweetness. A blend of leather and Virginia cedar make up the rich and woodsy middle notes.

items.title: Lamborghini Acqua — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Acqua by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2014, Lamborghini Acqua Cologne for men is an exciting fragrance suitable for regular use. Warm cardamom, tangy yuzu and earthy clary sage arrive at first encounter. Deeper into the blend rests fresh Granny Smith apples and buttery nutmeg.

items.title: Lamborghini Sportivo — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Sportivo by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: In 2012, Lamborghini Sportivo by Tonino Lamborghini was launched as a distinctive and exhilarating cologne. With cardamom, orange, and pimento as the top notes, this cologne starts off bitter yet aromatic. The heart notes are a fragrant and herbal blend of sage, lavender, and black tea.

items.title: Lamborghini Classico — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Classico by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: In 2013, Tonino Lamborghini released Lamborghini Classico for men. The top notes of passionfruit, cardamom and lemon bring in a zesty and fresh scent that’s perfect for the summer months. The herbal middle notes consist of a mix of basil, lavender and sage, combining a myriad of aromas together.

items.title: Lamborghini Prestigio — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Prestigio by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This vibrant and memorable fragrance is Lamborghini Prestigio for men. Launched in 2011 by Tonino Lamborghini, this scent incorporates citrusy, powdery and dark accords. Top notes of pineapple, Amalfi lemon, nutmeg and mandarin orange open the scent.

items.title: Noel Au Balcon — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Noel Au Balcon by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Every day can be Christmas with this holiday-inspired unisex fragrance from perfumier Etat Libre D’Orange. Released in 2007, Noel Au Balcon is sweet and spicy, exotic and familiar. It opens with top notes of honey, mandarin, and apricot before the middle notes of cinnamon and chili pepper bring a spicy kick.

items.title: Rien Intense Incense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Rien Intense Incense by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Rich oriental woods fuse with smoky incense, powdery florals and spice in Rien Intense Incense. The opening is a brisk aldehyde and bergamot effusion spiced with nuances of caraway and bracing black pepper. Powdery rose and earthy yet ethereal iris emerge at the heart, interwoven with rich accords of leather, labdanum and incense.

items.title: Yes I Do — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Yes I Do by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Yes I Do by Etat Libre D’Orange is a feminine and flowery scent. The brand launched in 2016 and appeals to every woman. It contains beautiful notes of jasmine, lily, aldehydes, cacao pod, marshmallow, and orange blossom.

items.title: Juicy Couture Oui — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Juicy Couture Oui by Juicy Couture Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Juicy Couture Oui is fun women’s fragrance with fruity and white floral accords. Juicy Couture is an American fashion line famous for their fashionable track suits and is now owned by the Liza Claiborn group. Fruity and sweet, the opening blends watermelon, pear and acai berry with the mellowing essence of tea leaves.

items.title: 4711 Remix — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: 4711 Remix by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex 2020 Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: 4711 Remix is a limited edition cologne released to celebrate the 225th anniversary of the original 4711 formulation in 2017. This fragrance retains the aromatherapy-inspired essential oil infusion of its predecessor, including citrus notes of lemon, orange and bergamot along with aromatic herbal notes of rosemary, lavender and petitgrain. This light, soothing, invigorating cologne is ideal for everyday wear, especially during the warm spring and summer months.

items.title: Lolita Lempicka Mon Premier — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Lolita Lempicka Mon Premier by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 1997, Lolita Lempicka Mon Premier is a sweet and floral fragrance for women created by Lolita Lempicka. An intriguing combination of ivy, cherry and star anise opens the perfume and moves into heart notes of violet, licorice, orris root and amaryllis. A blend of sweet and earthy base notes brings the fragrance to completion with musk, tonka bean, vanilla, vetiver and praline forming the gentle foundation of the perfume.

items.title: Yes I am Pink First — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Yes I am Pink First by Cacharel Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: From French fashion house Cacharel comes Yes I am Pink First, a women’s fragrance introduced in 2019. This spirited scent speaks to the strength and beauty of all women with layers of aromatic elements that are complex and enticing. The scent opens with top notes of raspberry and pear for a fruity introduction.

items.title: Versace Eros Flame — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Versace Eros Flame by Versace Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Named for the Greek God of love, Eros Flame is a fragrance of passion. Spritz on a touch of this cologne and those around you will lean in closer. The scent begins with top notes of black pepper, orange, rosemary and lemon.

items.title: Montblanc Explorer — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Montblanc Explorer by Mont Blanc Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in February 2019, Montblanc Explorer is an aromatic amber pillar fragrance for men. Mont Blanc used Givaudan perfumers Antoine Maisondieu, Olivier Pescheux and Jordi Fernandez to create the composition. Spicy pink pepper, crisp OrPur bergamot and aromatic French sage blend in the opening notes.

items.title: Vince Camuto Virtu — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Vince Camuto Virtu by Vince Camuto Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2018, Vince Camuto Virtu is a spicy, leathery scent for men that combines classic notes with a modern touch. From new perfumier Vince Camuto, this boldly masculine fragrance opens with top notes of peppercorn, cardamom, and papyrus. Its heart notes are woody, with white birch, tree moss, and vetiver.

items.title: Un Jardin Sur La Lagune — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Un Jardin Sur La Lagune by Hermes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Christine Nagel, Un Jardin Sur La Lagune combines unexpected accords of sea water and intoxicating white florals to produce a distinctive, enveloping fragrance that’s soft yet vibrant. Lush, citrusy floral tones of magnolia and Madonna lily fuse with heady jasmine nuances of pittosporum, followed by a clean base of blond wood and marine salt. This nostalgic springtime fragrances was first released by the French luxury house Hermes Paris in March of 2019.

items.title: Dolce Peony — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Dolce Peony by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by Dolce & Gabbana in 2019 as the fifth fragrance in the line, Dolce Peony is a soft and floral fragrance created by Christophe Raynaud for women. The perfume starts off bright with a blend of fruity top notes. Nashi pear, bergamot and pink pepper make way for heart notes of Bulgarian rose, freesia and peony, the star of the show.

items.title: Police To Be Tattoo Art — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2018.  An aromatic warm woodsy scent for men.  It opens with a nice crisp clean take with the fruit notes.

items.title: Police To Be Tattoo Art — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Celebrating individuality and all things unique, Police To Be Tattoo Art is a sweet fragrance for women that delivers a desirable blend of nature and sugar. Immediately recognizable top notes for the inner gourmand include gooey marshmallow and maple syrup with a hint of freesia as nature’s sweetener. Middle notes step in as a mixed flower bouquet of heliotrope and apple blossom combined with rose and violet.

items.title: Lolitaland — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Lolitaland by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Lolita Lempicka in 2018, Lolitaland is a powdery-sweet and fresh fruity floral fragrance for women. The opening notes are effervescent with bright tones of mandarin orange, grapefruit, lemon and lime pricked with warm hints of Sichuan pepper. Intoxicating flowers and succulent fruit notes emerge at the heart, mingling jasmine, magnolia and deep red rose with black currant, white peach and plum.

items.title: Blue Jeans — Eau de Toilette en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Blue Jeans by Versace Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester New Packaging) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by the design house of Gianni Versace in 1994, Blue Jeans is classified as a sharp, oriental, woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of woodsy, citrus notes. It is recommended for daytime wear.

items.title: Ghost Luminous — Eau de Toilette en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Ghost Luminous by Ghost Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Ghost Luminous is a sweetly enticing fruity-floral fragrance that helps to bring refreshment and a little fun to your spring and summer day. Introduced in 2009, this perfume opens with a blend of fruity notes, including melon, apple, pineapple, orange, black currant, and bergamot. The heart is where the floral notes bloom and expand, in a mix of freesia, jasmine, rose, violet, lily-of-the-valley, and raspberry.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Floral — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Floral by Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Effusive fruits and florals capture the radiant beauty of spring in Jimmy Choo Floral, a heavenly feminine fragrance by Louise Turner. Top notes are tart-sweet and effervescent with juicy tangerine, nectarine and lovely bergamot. Lush magnolia blooms alongside delicate, fresh tones of sweet pea and apricot blossom at the heart.

items.title: Good Girl Legere — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Good Girl Legere by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Legere Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2016, Good Girl Legere by Carolina Herrera is a sexy and addictive fragrance that fuses sensual white florals with deep, dark spice. The opening sparkles with a tart-sweet blend of lemon and bergamot mingled with nuances of almond and coffee bean. Luxuriant white floral accords of Sambac jasmine, orange blossom and sensual tuberose bloom at the heart, harmonized with powdery orris root and creamy praline.

items.title: Alexandria II — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Alexandria II by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Lavish and elegantly seductive, Alexandria Ii is an enveloping woody oriental scent that fuses fruit and spice with lovely rose and precious wood. The scent opens with a light blend of lavender and rosewood mingled with spicy hints of green apple, almond and cinnamon. Velvet rose and heady lily of the valley bloom at the heart, supported by serene aromatic cedar.

items.title: Roja Aoud Crystal — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Roja Aoud Crystal by Roja Parfums Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Roja Aoud Crystal is an oriental-spicy fragrance that was launched in 2010 by Roja Parfums. This fragrance has top notes of lemon, bergamot, and lemon verbena. Its heart features the floral notes of jasmine, geranium, May rose, and ylang-ylang.

items.title: Ariana Grande Cloud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Ariana Grande Cloud by Ariana Grande Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Like an airy dream, Ariana Grande Cloud is a creamy, soft and luxurious perfume with a high-class scent. Fresh and uplifting bergamot orange, rich lavender and juicy pear create a bright opening. Whipped crème de coconut, sweet Praliné and dark, mysterious vanilla create a memorable heart.

items.title: Banana Republic Wildbloom Vert — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Banana Republic Wildbloom Vert by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Banana Republic Wildbloom Vert was launched in 2012 and crafted by famed perfumer Ilias Ermenidis. The top notes of violet leaf, red apple and pear create a fruity, floral aroma that captures the lush vibrancy of springtime. The soft, sweet scent is enriched by middle notes of peach blossom, magnolia and gardenia.

items.title: Boss Bottled Infinite — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Boss Bottled Infinite by Hugo Boss Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Introduced in 2019, Boss Bottled Infinite blends classic masculine notes with more unique scents to create a one-of-a-kind men's fragrance. It begins with a fruity-spicy punch with notes of mandarin orange, safe, cinnamon, and apple. The middle notes take on an herbal flavor with rosemary, lavender, and patchouli, while the base notes invite sandalwood and olive tree to create balance, depth, and longevity.

items.title: Her Highness Black — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Her Highness Black by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by Uae label Afnan, Her Highness Black is a luxuriant, feminine fragrance that intertwines unapologetic accords of fruits and florals with mesmerizing musk. The opening notes are sweet and luscious, mingling honeyed plum and pear with rosy nuances of pink pepper. Lush, intoxicating flowers bloom at the heart, a heady fusion of jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang softened by hazy heliotrope.

items.title: 4711 Remix Lavender — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: 4711 Remix Lavender by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unixsex Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: First released in 2019, 4711 Remix Lavender is a deliciously fresh, summery fragrance with a citrusy-floral opening and a subtly sweet, light musk finish. Top notes are a bright, bubbly blend of lemon and bergamot harmonized with herbal undertones of mate and lavender. Lavender flowers are joined by shimmering florals of iris, freesia and hibiscus in the heart notes, followed by a comforting base of sheer musk, soft sandalwood and a hint of praline sweetness.

items.title: K — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: K by Dolce & Gabbana by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Both spicy and sweet, K by Dolce & Gabbana is a versatile masculine fragrance that is perfect for everyday wear. The opening is bright with top notes of blood orange, juniper berries, Sicilian lemon and a blend of citrus. As the heart of the fragrance moves forward, you are met with an intriguing combination of geranium, lavender, clary sage and pimento middle notes.

items.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition — Eau de Parfum en spray 60 ml (2 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 2 oz for Women
items.description_en: In a delightful and well-balanced scent for women, Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition was launched in 2018 and is for chic, upscale women who enjoy projecting class and sophistication. Uplifting and cheerful bergamot orange joins green notes for a refreshing open. The heart is fresh and fruity with juicy melon, tart pineapple, sweet gourmand notes and sensual, warm amber.

items.title: Mugler Take Me Out — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Mugler Take Me Out by Thierry Mugler Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced by Thierry Mugler in 2018, Mugler Take Me Out is a light, summery scent that both men and women can wear. It is a simple fragrance, with only a few notes that work well together and last a long time. The combination of floral orange blossom and almost minty shiso leaf blend together with a secret 'P' note that create an invigorating, memorable fragrance.

items.title: Perry Ellis 18 Fuego — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Perry Ellis 18 Fuego by Perry Ellis Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: What better way to add heat to your evening than with Perry Ellis 18 Fuego. This masculine scent launched in 2006, and it is one of over 50 fragrances offered by fashion designer Perry Ellis. The sultry scent opens with top notes of spicy black pepper and bergamot for a tangy beginning.

items.title: Bad Boy — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Bad Boy by Carolina Herrera Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Spicy and sweet elements fuse with fresh aromatic herbs and cacao in Bad Boy, a spicy oriental fragrance for men. The opening is a piquant effusion of white and black pepper mingled with bright, green tones of Italian bergamot. Heart notes are clean and masculine, merging crisp clary sage and cedar.

items.title: Hollister Free Wave — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Hollister Free Wave by Hollister Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: An active lifestyle requires a scent that will last throughout the day, which is what makes Hollister Free Wave the perfect choice for the guy who works hard and plays hard. Spicy and warm, this fragrance was released in 2018 By Southern California’s branch of the Abercrombie and Fitch family. Top notes are zesty tones like ginger and lime, while middle notes are earthier: Moss and algae lightened up with gentle white iris.

items.title: Swiss Army Steel — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Swiss Army Steel by Victorinox Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: An aromatic aquatic fragrance for men, Swiss Army Steel is composed of some of nature’s most distinctive ingredients. Top notes of lavender and violet leaf give the cologne its subtle sweetness, while heart notes of sea and moss create a watery, earthy accord. The smooth sole base note of cedar finishes this contemporary fragrance.

items.title: 5th Avenue NYC Live — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: 5th Avenue NYC Live by Elizabeth Arden Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Carlos Vinals, 5th Avenue Nyc Live is a floral feminine fragrance perfect for the warmer months of the year. It was launched by Elizabeth Arden in 2018. The opening layer is refreshing and fruity with top notes of acai berry, mandarin orange and pink pepper.

items.title: Armand Basi L'eau Pour Homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Armand Basi L'eau Pour Homme by Armand Basi Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: A wonderfully fresh woody aquatic for men, Armand Basi L'eau Pour Homme was introduced by the perfume house Armand Basi in 2010. Top notes of bergamot, lavender, and blue breeze open the fragrance. The heart adds a little spice with middle notes of nutmeg, cardamom, blue Mediterranean cypress, and bamboo leaves.

items.title: Le Parfum Royal Elie Saab — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Le Parfum Royal Elie Saab by Elie Saab Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Bold and feminine, Le Parfum Royal Elie Saab is a fragrance for women that was launched by Elie Saab in 2019. It was designed by perfumer Maia Lernout. The composition begins simply with a single top note of mandarin orange, bright and refreshing.

items.title: Booster — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Booster by Lacoste Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by the design house of Lacoste in 1996, Booster is classified as a sharp, fruity fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of menthol,  lavender, eucalyptus and peppermint with a touch of nutmeg. It is recommended for casual wear.

items.title: Police To Be Exotic Jungle — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police To Be Exotic Jungle by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2019, Police To Be Exotic Jungle is a spicy, woody men's fragrance that blends fresh elements with a darker side. It opens with top notes of bergamot, black pepper, and mandarin orange for a tart, zesty introduction. The classic heart notes of apple and rose take a playful turn before the base notes of cedar, sandalwood, musk, and vetiver blend together for a deeper finish.

items.title: Police To Be Exotic Jungle — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Police To Be Exotic Jungle by Police Colognes Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fresh, tart-sweet fruit and enveloping floral accords are layered over a soft vanilla-suede base in Police To Be Exotic Jungle, a summery floral oriental scent first launched in 2019 by Police Colognes. Opening notes are a bright and juicy blend of ripe plum, black currant and lemon. Hazy, subtly intoxicating blooms emerge at the heart, mingling lovely jasmine and heliotrope with apricot nuances of sweet osmanthus.

items.title: Halloween Man X — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Halloween Man X by Jesus Del Pozo Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: An oriental fougere fragrance for men, Spanish fashion brand Jesus Del Pozo describes its 2019 creation Halloween Man X as 'an addictive cocktail.' Cardamom, lavender and lemon are its soothing top notes, which disappear into the dark, rich heart notes of whiskey, coffee, leather, cinnamon and minerals. The smoky base notes of tonka bean, amber and incense give the fragrance its sexy, sophisticated finish.

items.title: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero by Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Bold and intriguing, Jimmy Choo Urban Hero is a masculine fragrance that was launched by Jimmy Choo in 2019. The opening of the cologne is refreshing with a hint of spice, featuring top notes of finger lime and black pepper. An earthy heart forms the transitioning layer as notes of vetiver and palisander rosewood come forward.

items.title: Disney Frozen II Anna — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Disney Frozen II Anna by Disney Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the Disney® character Anna from the Frozen franchise, Disney Frozen Ii Anna perfume is a fresh, fruity fragrance that is perfect for your daughter. This crisp perfume features both fruity and floral accords to create a fragrance that is invigorating, making it perfect for summer wear. The top note is a blend of fragrant citruses such as lemon, bergamot and orange.

items.title: 4711 Acqua Colonia Floral Fields of Ireland — Eau de Cologne en spray 169 ml (5.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: 4711 Acqua Colonia Floral Fields of Ireland by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 5.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Citrusy and balsamic yet sweet and earthy, 4711 Acqua Colonia Floral Fields of Ireland is a 2019 fragrance for men and women. Produced by Maurer & Wirtz, a sister company of famed perfumery 4711, top notes of lemon and mandarin orange welcome your nose to the scent. Following closely behind is the perfume's heart, a white floral combination of jasmine and orange blossom paired with herbal mimosa.

items.title: Xerjoff Opera — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Xerjoff Opera by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First introduced in 2019, Xerjoff opera is a mesmerizing wood and flower musk that fuses luxuriant yellow florals with sweet rose, fresh spice and subtly animalic musk. The scent opens with mellow tones of blended fruit and Turkish rose. Ylang ylang, sensuous and shimmering, blooms at the heart, harmonized with warm nuances of amber, nutmeg and suede.

items.title: The Only One Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: The Only One Intense by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: The Only One Intense Eau De Parfum was created by the house of Dolce & Gabbana with perfumer Violaine Collas and released in 2020.  A robust sweet floral fragrance for women.  This blend captures the vibrant energy of every note and delivers it in a way that is silky smooth and elegant.

items.title: Pierre Cardin Pour Homme — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Pierre Cardin Pour Homme by Pierre Cardin Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Pour Homme Cologne was created by the house of Pierre Cardin with perfumer Benoist Lapouza and released in 2007.  This is a woodsy scent for men.  A fragrance with a multi faceted personality.

items.title: Moschino Toy Boy — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Moschino Toy Boy by Moschino Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Moschino Toy Boy by Moschino is a lively fragrance released in 2019. The top notes include tart, bitter, citrusy bergamot; rosy, spicy pink pepper; aquatic, fresh pear; balsamic, piney elemi; and pungent, earthy Indonesian nutmeg. The middle notes are nutty, mild flax; lush, waxy magnolia; lemony, powdery rose; and spicy, warm clove.

items.title: Boss In Motion — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Boss In Motion by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Boss in Motion by Hugo Boss provides men everywhere with an affordable and pleasant solution to their fragrance needs for a wide variety of situations. The unique appearance of this cologne is matched by its contents. The top scent notes are orange, violet leaf, basil and bergamot, providing a fruity, herbal opening.

items.title: Boss No. 1 — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Boss No. 1 by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Hugo Boss in 1985, Boss is classified as a sharp, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of oak, cedar, mandarin, musk and amber.

items.title: Cuba Victory — Eau de Parfum en spray 35 ml (1.17 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Cuba Victory by Fragluxe Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.17 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sweetly feminine yet distinctly chic, Cuba Victory combines gourmand notes and shimmering white woods with lovely bright hints of citrus and lush white florals. The scent opens bright and tart-sweet, mingling sparkling green mandarin with warm spice nuances of ginger. Sensual, intoxicating floral notes of jasmine and lily embrace the heart.

items.title: The One Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: The One Intense by Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Jean-Christophe Herault and first released by Dolce & Gabbana in 2020, The One Intense is a clean masculine scent enhanced by magnetic nuances of leather and spice. Serene accords of neroli and cypress open the fragrance, harmonized with subtly sweet undertones of steamed cardamom and green, aromatic hints of clary sage. Cashmeran and benzoin introduce warmer tones at the heart, followed by a dark, enveloping finish of earthy-sweet patchouli, black leather and labdanum.

items.title: Byzance 2019 Edition — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Byzance 2019 Edition by Rochas Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: In 2019, French designer Rochas released a new interpretation of one of their iconic feminine scents. Byzance 2019 Edition is a not to that fragrance, and it puts a modern spin on a beloved classic. The fragrance opens with top notes of bergamot, juicy pear, orange blossom, and neroli.

items.title: Cabochard Cherie — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Cabochard Cherie by Cabochard Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sweet white flowers, crisp fruit and fresh spice are beautifully expressed in Cabochard Cherie, a sheer chypre floral that is perfect for warm-weather wear. Opening notes are a delicate, uplifting effusion of fruity-aromatic bergamot and ripe pear harmonized with herbal hints of basil leaf. Heady, shimmering floral accords embrace the heart, mingling orange blossom and narcissus absolute with lovely freesia.

items.title: Lalique Amethyst Exquise — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Lalique Amethyst Exquise by Lalique Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2017, Lalique Amethyst Exquise is a seductive, evening version of a another popular feminine scent from this designer. French luxury goods designer Lalique is known for its crystal creations, and this fragrance matches the beauty of its unique decanter. The scent opens with fruity top notes of black currant, blackberry, raspberry, and heliotrope.

items.title: Lady Rem — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Lady Rem by Reminiscence Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A chypre fruity fragrance for women, Lady Rem features sweet, fruity, tobacco and patchouli accords. The top note of juicy raspberry engages your palate while the sweet floral heart note of orange blossom suggests romance. Patchouli, leather and tobacco are the spicy, animalic base notes that give the fragrance its luxurious, sensuous character.

items.title: Boss No. 6 — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Boss No. 6 by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
