items.description_en: Lauched by the design house of Boss in 1999. It's fragrant nature explores essences of fern, bergamot and pineapple. Blended with notes of lavender,Â juniper and geranium, Boss # 6 is a casual type of fragrance.

items.title: Lamborghini Invincibile — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Lamborghini Invincibile by Tonino Lamborghini Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Lamborghini Invincible Cologne for men is from the chypre fruity group of fragrances. It opens with apple, bergamot, black currant and pineapple notes, an aromatic blend that imparts energy and appeals to the palate. Birch, Moroccan jasmine, patchouli and rose are the floral-herbal heart notes, singing out with their sweet and spicy accords.

items.title: Pierre Cardin Pour Femme — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Pierre Cardin Pour Femme by Pierre Cardin Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Pierre Cardin Pour Femme, launched in 2007 by Pierre Cardin, is a fragrance for women. Top notes of apple, black currant, orange and cinnamon open this perfume with a sweet fruitiness. At the heart, white floral notes of rose, violet, lily-of-the-valley, hawthorn and jasmine impart a powdery freshness that is sensual.

items.title: A Girl in Capri — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: A Girl in Capri by Lanvin Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Daydream of the ultimate summer escape with the refreshing scent of A Girl in Capri Eau de Toilette for women. This fun 2019 release from Lanvin opens with sparkling top notes of bergamot, Primafiore lemon and pink pepper. A heart of marine notes and grapefruit blossom transports you to a sunny beach before the dreamy base notes of white musk, driftwood and amber embrace your senses.

items.title: Boss Alive — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Boss Alive by Hugo Boss Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Perfect for the confident woman, Boss Alive is a feminine fragrance designed by perfumer Annick Menardo. It was launched by Hugo Boss in 2020. Fruity notes of plum, apple and black currant create a bright top layer with added warmth and sweetness from Madagascar vanilla and cinnamon.

items.title: Boucheron — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Boucheron by Boucheron Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Boucheron Pour Homme was introduced by Boucheron in 1999. Boucheron Pour Homme is packaged in an award-winning bottle design. This signature scent features notes of verbena, orange, basil, amber, heliotrope, bergamont, juniper berry, geranium, amber, vetiver, moss, sandalwood and vanilla.

items.title: Boucheron — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Boucheron by Boucheron Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Boucheron Pour Homme was introduced by Boucheron in 1999. Boucheron Pour Homme is packaged in an award-winning bottle design. This signature scent features notes of verbena, orange, basil, amber, heliotrope, bergamont, juniper berry, geranium, amber, vetiver, moss, sandalwood and vanilla.

items.title: Boucheron — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Boucheron by Boucheron Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created in 1988 by Perfumers Francis Deleamont and Jean-Pierre Bethouart,  Boucheron commemorates the luxury jewelry emporium in Paris' Place Vendome. For the woman who wants to make a statement, Boucheron is an opulent spicy floral perfume. Notes include pelargonium, ylang-ylang, tuberose, daffodil, orange blossom from Morocco and jasmin, civet, benzoin, woody notes, Tonka bean, Indian vanilla, oakmoss, ambergris and musk.

items.title: Boucheron — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Boucheron by Boucheron Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created in 1988 by Perfumers Francis Deleamont and Jean-Pierre Bethouart,  Boucheron commemorates the luxury jewelry emporium in Paris' Place Vendome. For the woman who wants to make a statement, Boucheron is an opulent spicy floral perfume. Notes include pelargonium, ylang-ylang, tuberose, daffodil, orange blossom from Morocco and jasmin, civet, benzoin, woody notes, Tonka bean, Indian vanilla, oakmoss, ambergris and musk.

items.title: Coach Blue — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Coach Blue by Coach Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2020, Coach Blue is a men's fragrance inspired by cool breezes and fresh air. From American luxury leather goods designer Coach, this masculine scent is perfect for daily wear. It opens with top notes of lime and absinthe for a tart and spicy beginning.

items.title: Marc Jacobs Perfect — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Marc Jacobs Perfect by Marc Jacobs Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Marc Jacobs Perfect by Marc Jacobs is a spirited perfume made with the modern woman in mind. Launched in 2020, it melds an array of fresh and soothing notes that come together in a calm, floral and flirty aroma that lingers. The first spritz entices the senses with a sunny blend of rhubarb and daffodil this subtly sweetened with a delectable heart of almond milk.

items.title: Sofia Vergara Lost In Paradise — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Sofia Vergara Lost In Paradise by Sofia Vergara Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A lushly tropical scent that’s perfect for spring and summer, Sofia Vergara Lost in Paradise is a vibrant fruity floral oriental fragrance for women. The opening is crisp and delicately tart-sweet, mingling nashi pear, red apple and soursop. Exotic florals bloom sensual at the heart, an enveloping garden of orange blossom, gardenia and shimmering lily of the valley.

items.title: Baldessarini Ambre Eau Fraiche — Eau de Toilette en spray 90 ml (3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Baldessarini Ambre Eau Fraiche by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Baldessarini Ambre Eau Fraiche by Hugo Boss is a crisp, invigorating fragrance for men. It opens with juicy top notes of bergamot and watermelon laced with a variety of aromatic spices. A middle note of apple deepens the juicy undertone of the perfume while violet leaf, sage, cypress and nutmeg add an earthy undertone.

items.title: Gentleman Eau De Parfum Boisee — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Gentleman Eau De Parfum Boisee by Givenchy Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2020, Gentleman Eau De Parfum Boisee captures the essence of the modern man with the aroma of sweet, raw earth and hints of intriguing spice. The woody fragrance with spicy accords is multifaceted, just like the interesting man of today. The sexy and confident men's cologne from Givenchy doesn't shy away from hitting all the right notes.

items.title: 1 Million Parfum — Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: 1 Million Parfum by Paco Rabanne Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A daring spirit deserves a complimentary fragrance. 1 Million Parfum by Paco Rabanne, released in 2020, delivers on lively intenseness that mesmerizes the senses. Intense yet also warm and inviting, this fragrance has a complexity that exudes all facets of masculinity.

items.title: Yardley Poppy & Violet — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Yardley Poppy & Violet by Yardley London Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Day or night, Yardley Poppy & Violet by Yardley London is a refreshing perfume that uplifts the senses while also exuding an air of mystery. Its innovative composition brings together an array of aromas for a unique finish that is unmistakably seductive. It has a bright opening of bergamot, wild ivy and spicy red pepper.

items.title: Silhouette In Bloom — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Silhouette In Bloom by Christian Siriano Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Honorine Blanc, Silhouette In Bloom is a feminine fragrance launched by Christian Siriano in 2018. Top notes of Italian mandarin, pear leaf and pink pepper form the opening layer of the perfume. As the top layer becomes less prominent, it is followed by a floral heart of Bulgarian rose, jasmine and jasmine sambac notes.

items.title: Police To Be Sweet Girl — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Police To Be Sweet Girl by Police Colognes Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: A sexy, feminine fruity floral gourmand, Police To Be Sweet Girl mingles tart-sweet fruits and fresh florals with sumptuous gourmand and woody accords. The opening is a bright, cheery effusion of bergamot, sparkling black currant and juicy orange. Creamy toffee and caramel emerge at the heart, harmonized with light, shimmering tones of jasmine and cyclamen.

items.title: Azzaro Wanted Girl Tonic — Eau de Toilette en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Azzaro Wanted Girl Tonic by Azzaro Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Azzaro Wanted Girl Tonic is a bright and refreshing floral scent that layers tropical fruits and flowers over a serene woody base. Top notes are a tart-sweet and tantalizing blend of kiwi and acai berry mingled with fresh nuances of Madagascan ginger. Lovely, mesmerizing datura blossom and a hint of freesia emerge at the heart, followed by a delicately aromatic, soothing finish of bamboo wood and tonka bean.

items.title: Azzaro Wanted Tonic — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Azzaro Wanted Tonic by Azzaro Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2020, Azzaro Wanted Tonic puts a casual yet stylish spin on men's fragrances. This scent is from French designer Azzaro, and it demonstrates a fresh approach to simple elegance. The top notes of lime and cardamom are tart and spicy, while the heart notes of ginger and aquatic accords take on a delicate feel.

items.title: L'ombre Des Merveilles — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: L'ombre Des Merveilles by Hermes Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Hermes L'Ombre Des Merveilles is a fragrance for men and women released in 2020. From luxury goods designer, Hermes, this scent is memorable, relying on classic elements to blend together to create an unforgettable fragrance. The bold accords of tonka bean and incense give way to notes of black tea for a unique scent that invites you to relish the simplicity.

items.title: Juicy Couture Oh So Orange — Eau de Toilette en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Juicy Couture Oh So Orange by Juicy Couture Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sunny spring and summer days deserve an equally bright fragrance. Juicy Couture Oh So Orange is sweet and refreshing, perfect for warm weather. Fruity notes of kumquat, mandarin orange and red berries form the opening of the perfume.

items.title: Dsquared2 Red Wood — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Dsquared2 Red Wood by Dsquared2 Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Woodsy but bursting with a fruity zest, Dsquared2 Red Wood is a rising star in the extravagant Canadian brand, Dsquared2. This 2019 fragrance opens with a sizzle of pink pepper along a burst of juicy yet sour cranberry. The heart dips into sweet petals of rose and magnolia but adds a touch of tangy litchi to keep things interesting.

items.title: Jaguar Classic Chromite — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Jaguar Classic Chromite by Jaguar Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Steely and blended with elements of rugged wilderness, Jaguar Classic Chromite is sophisticated with a touch of roughness. The top notes blend the unexpected combination of incense with mandarin and green apple. After such a independent opening, the heart of cedar and patchouli and the base of praline, ambroxan and tonka should hardly come as a surprise as each lends its unique and bold elements to represent a man comfortable in any situation.

items.title: Sophie La Girafe Eau de Soin Parfumee — Fragancia 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Sophie La Girafe Eau de Soin Parfumee by Sophie La Girafe Eau De Soin Parfumee (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The perfect fragrance for restful naps and wholesome adventures, Sophie La Girafe Eau de Soin Parfumee is made with natural ingredients safe for use around even the most delicate of little people. It opens with soft notes of peach, lemon and freesia. Light fruity and florals scents join in the heart along with ozone and heliotrope before a cozy base of vanilla, orange blossom, jasmine and musk take over for an ideal finish.

items.title: Replica Beachwalk — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Replica Beachwalk by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2012, Replica Beachwalk has all the promise of a warm summer's day. This unisex scent is from French perfume house Maison Margiela, and it opens with top notes of tart lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. At the heart are tropical notes of ylang ylang, coconut milk, and heliotrope.

items.title: Police To Be Bad Guy — Eau de Toilette en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police To Be Bad Guy by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Police Colognes in 2020, Police To Be Bad Guy is an oriental fragrance for men. The opening layer of the fragrance is a refreshing combination of bright blood orange, herbal red thyme and mint, spicy nutmeg and various green notes. Fruit is featured in the heart as well where green apple and sorbet notes are softened by geranium and white flowers.

items.title: Police Deep Blue — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police Deep Blue by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Police Deep Blue is a masculine fragrance launched by Police Colognes in 2019. It opens with a sweet and aromatic top layer formed by notes of rhubarb and Elemi resin. Floral notes are introduced in the heart of the fragrance where geranium and Provence lavender are brightened by a blend of green notes as it begins to transition.

items.title: L'homme Rochas — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: L'homme Rochas by Rochas Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: A masculine fragrance from Rochas, L'homme Rochas was designed by perfumer Bruno Jovanovic and launched in 2020. Each layer in this oriental fragrance features a trio of complementing notes, beginning with refreshing top notes of pineapple and blood orange warmed by cardamom. This freshness is continued in the heart where floral geranium mingles with basil and juniper berries.

items.title: Love In White For Summer — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Love In White For Summer by Creed Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Reminiscent of a breezy summer's day, Love in White for Summer is a fruity, floral scent for women. Released in 2018, this feminine fragrance is from Creed, a luxury perfume house based in Paris. The top notes of Bulgarian rose, sweet magnolia, and bergamot create a distinctive introduction, while heart notes tie iris to earthier notes of basmati rice and cedarwood.

items.title: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The 4711 brand describes this 2020 women’s floral fragrance as “seductive, feminine and elegant.” 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia features a balanced aromatic profile with several classic fragrance notes. Sweet mandarin, succulent orange and bright pink pepper create a refreshing opening.

items.title: Police Frozen — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Police Frozen by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A fresh fragrance for men, Police Frozen was launched by Police Colognes in 2015. The fragrance opens refreshing and sweet with lemon, mandarin orange and green apple top notes. This fruity layer is complemented by a spicy heart formed by nutmeg, cardamom and pepper notes, softened by floral jasmine.

items.title: Simone Cosac Sublime — Fragancia en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Simone Cosac Sublime by Simone Cosac Profumi Perfume Spray (Tester) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2014, Simone Cosac Sublime is a sweet, embracing white floral fragrance. Opening notes are a bright and tantalizing expression of sparkling mandarin orange, juicy pear and pink pepper. Heady jasmine sambac absolute and ethereal heliotrope in the heart notes blend beautifully with lush, piquant gardenia and green nuances of violet leaf.

items.title: Burberry Touch — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Burberry Touch by Burberry Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: The Burberry man likes to experience his sensuality steeped in authenticity and elegance. For this lover of fine fabrics, Burberry has devised a fragrance, which is comfortable, welcoming and yet rich in contrasts. The fragrance, created by Jean-Pierre Bethouard, Firmenich, displays an initial freshness of hard-to-define notes.

items.title: Moschino Toy 2 Bubble Gum — Fragancia en spray 10 ml (0.34 oz) (Tester, Mini) para mujer
items.title_en: Moschino Toy 2 Bubble Gum by Moschino Mini EDT Spray (Tester) 0.34 oz for Women
items.description_en: Moschino Toy 2 Bubble Gum is a playful and fun feminine fragrance designed by perfumer Olivier Pescheux. It was launched by Moschino in 2021. The composition begins with bright top notes of lemon, bitter orange and candied fruits.

items.title: Burberry — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Burberry by Burberry Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by the design house of Burberrys in 1997, Burberrys is classified as a sharp, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of mint, lavender, sandalwood, cedar, and rich amber. It is recommended for casual wear.

items.title: Burberry — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Burberry by Burberry Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by the design house of Burberrys in 1995, Burberrys is classified as a refreshing, oriental, floral fragrance. This feminine scent possesses a blend of peach, apricot, sandalwood, cedar, amber and musk. It is recommended for daytime wear.

items.title: Ecko Charge — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Ecko Charge by Marc Ecko Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Wake up every morning ready to take the world by storm when you're feeling empowered by the bold, luxurious refinement of Marc Ecko Charge. This revitalizing men's cologne combines woody, spicy and aromatic accords for a daring, enigmatic scent that packs a riveting punch. Top notes of bergamot, pepper and aldehydes mix with sage, saffron and amyris at the center for a rich, exhilarating aroma that lasts for hours.

items.title: Sui Dreams In Purple — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Sui Dreams In Purple by Anna Sui Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Dress up for any occasion with a hint of something delicate and special like the enchanting Sui Dreams In Purple. This mesmerizing 2019 fragrance for women mixes floral, powdery and fruity accords for a ravishing yet gentle aroma that's bound to attract positive attention. Top notes of pear and kiwi set the tone with their sweet, tangy flair, while the arrival of lavender, white rose and orchid at the heart infuses a soft, romantic ambience.

items.title: Michael Kors Gorgeous — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Michael Kors Gorgeous by Michael Kors Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Michael Kors Gorgeous is a women’s floral woody musk fragrance designed by Anne Flipo, Laurent Le Guernec and Nicolas Beaulieu along with International Flavors and Fragrances. Released in 2021 by Michael Kors, this scent opens with a delightful floral combination of jasmine sambac, Indian tuberose, ylang-ylang and orange blossom. It boasts a single note in its heart – tobacco, which lends an herbal grassy note with undertones of caramel and whiskey.

items.title: Very Good Girl — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Very Good Girl by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: The new fragrance Very Good Girl by Carolina Herrera comes in a gorgeous red bottle shaped like a stiletto. The bold, daring fragrance builds upon a soft base of smoky vetiver and creamy vanilla. Sweet, heady rose makes up the heart of the fragrance and then gives way to fragrant top notes of bright red currant and herbal litchi.

items.title: Viking Cologne — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Viking Cologne by Creed Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A refreshing blend reminiscent of wilderness expeditions and high seas, Viking Cologne defies expectations. It opens with the unbeatable freshness of pink pepper with a spritz of lemon, mandarin and bergamot. Natural herbal scents including rosemary, geranium, lavender, sage and nutmeg blend in the heart before the woodsy elements of cedar, sandalwood, vetiver, olibanum and patchouli take over for an aromatic ending.

items.title: Ralph's Club — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Tester) para hombre
items.title_en: Ralph's Club by Ralph Lauren Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Join the club with a classic blend of woody, aromatic masculine scent perfect for just about any occasion. Ralph's Club by Ralph Lauren opens with the reliable elements of lavender and clary sage, then drifts into a soft cedar in the heart. A potent base of vetiver completes the scent.

items.title: Jil Sander Evergreen — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) (Tester) para mujer
items.title_en: Jil Sander Evergreen by Jil Sander Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: A deliciously fresh, uplifting fragrance, Jil Sander Evergreen is a casually elegant chypre floral scent. The opening is a bright expression of crisp pear, grapefruit blossom and a whisper of white pepper. Lush, shimmering florals emerge in the heart notes, fusing velvety-fresh rose with sparkling jasmine and lily of the valley.

The visuals for Cheap & Chic, a Moschino offering from 1995, bring to mind Olive Oyl from the old Popeye cartoons, and the floral, fruity scent pops with interesting notes like bergamot, petitgrain, white orchid, sandalwood, and vanilla. Perfumer Alberto Morillas was inspired to create a mysterious, contemporary fragrance as an ode to modern femininity. Top notes of this fragrance include bergamot orange, pink pepper and mandora, a native Mediterranean fruit.

items.title_en: In Love With You by Giorgio Armani Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: One spritz of In Love With You and you are transported back to your first kiss. This floral-fruity fragrance is designed to remind you of falling in love. Luscious black currant, raspberry and sour cherry kick of the scent profile before moving to a delicate heart accord of jasmine, rose and wormwood.

items.title: Purple Ruby — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Purple Ruby by Pascal Morabito Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Purple Ruby is a sweet and creamy floral fruity gourmand that layers luscious berries and lush flowers over a delicious vanilla-caramel base. The opening is an intoxicating cocktail of tart-sweet green apple, succulent strawberry and honeyed raspberry. Shimmering white florals produce a heady heart, mingling orange blossom, gardenia and pink peony.

items.title: Bebe Luxe — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Bebe Luxe by Bebe Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: As complex as the woman who wears it, Bebe Luxe by Bebe is a feminine and youthful fragrance that gently lingers and enlivens the senses all day. Juicy sweetness abounds with a blend of mango, sweet pea, peony and tuberose. A hint of rich, bold and sensual jasmine subtly sets the stage for a woody finish of musk, sandalwood and cedar.

items.title: Bvlgari Splendida Magnolia Sensuel — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Bvlgari Splendida Magnolia Sensuel by Bvlgari Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Bvlgari Splendida Magnolia Sensuel is a rich floral perfume for women. The fragrance opens sweetly with tangerine and orange blossom. An intoxicating trio of white flowers is found in the heart with lush magnolia, orange blossom, and jasmine.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Caput Mundi — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Caput Mundi by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Like taking a trip back in time, Tiziana Terenzi Caput Mundi by Tiziana Terenzi captures the exotic old world with a breathtaking fusion of the modern world. This mysterious and alluring perfume opens with a bouquet of sensual lily of the valley, tea rose and Bulgarian rose absolute. A fragrant heart of iris, red saffron, sandalwood, patchouli and oud intoxicates the senses.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Lince — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Lince by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tiziana Terenzi Lince evokes a pureness only found in a heart-pounding romance blossoming under a star-filled sky. Released in 2018 by Tiziana Terenzi, this oriental spicy fragrance is as mesmerizing as the constellation it was named for. A bright opening of bergamot, anise and tea create a sense of urgency as they usher in a natural sensuality released by jasmine, orange blossom and rose.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Spirito Fiorentino — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Spirito Fiorentino by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tiziana Terenzi Spirito Fiorentino whisks the senses away to the romantic Italian countryside. Released in 2019 by Tiziana Terenzi, this alluring scent is built on a woody base that tantalizes and teases everyone around with delicate florals and natural sensuality. Its vibrant opening of lily, jasmine and magnolia blossoms into a delicate and dreamy bouquet of ylang ylang, magnolia, amber and lily of the valley.

items.title: Bombshell Wild Flower — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Bombshell Wild Flower by Victoria's Secret Eau De Parfum Spray (Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2019, the soft, romantic scent of Victoria’s Secret Bombshell Wild Flower features a sensual floral accord that is light enough for casual wear yet also complex enough for formal events. The perfume was released by Victoria’s Secret and builds upon sweet, sensual base notes of magnolia and desert wildflower. The heart of the fragrance is delicate rose, which further enhances the floralcy.

items.title: Mancera Gold Incense — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Mancera Gold Incense by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Mancera Gold Incense was released by fragrance company Mancera in 2018. Its unique combination of floral and Oriental notes creates a sophisticated perfume that is ideal for evening wear. Opening with top notes of coffee, mandarin orange, incense, and pink pepper, this perfume has a citrusy overtone with a hint of spiciness.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Afrodite — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Afrodite by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tiziana Terenzi Afrodite is an inviting unisex fragrance from Tiziana Terenzi that was released in 2018. Inspired by the goddess Aphrodite and the beautiful Mediterranean landscape, this perfume offers a complex and intoxicating blend of floral and earthy scents. It opens with sweet vanilla berries, white peach, pink pepper, lilac and white currant.

items.title: Un Jardin Sur La Lagune — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Un Jardin Sur La Lagune by Hermes Eau De Toilette Spray 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Christine Nagel, Un Jardin Sur La Lagune combines unexpected accords of sea water and intoxicating white florals to produce a distinctive, enveloping fragrance that’s soft yet vibrant. Lush, citrusy floral tones of magnolia and Madonna lily fuse with heady jasmine nuances of pittosporum, followed by a clean base of blond wood and marine salt. This nostalgic springtime fragrances was first released by the French luxury house Hermes Paris in March of 2019.

items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Morgan De Toi with perfumer Jerome Di Marino and released in 2016.  A warm rich oriental vanilla perfume for women.  It as a sensual personality which is perfect for those romantic adventures.

items.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Morgan De Toi with perfumer Jerome Di Marino and released in 2017.  It is an oriental floral perfume for women.  An impressive personality that will cause you to stand out and feel just as impressive.

items.title: Kensie Life Beat — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Kensie Life Beat by Kensie Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The Kensie Life Beat fragrance is everything a feminine perfume should be and more. It combines the liveliness of citrus notes with the gentleness of floral accords. Take in sweet top notes of peach, coconut, berries, cassis, apple and blackcurrant.

items.title: Kensie Free Spirit — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Kensie Free Spirit by Kensie Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Kensie Free Spirit by Kensie is the perfect fragrance for a bold and confident woman. Top notes of plum, bergamot, mandarin, lemon, and coconut are the first to fill your senses before a bouquet of heart notes takes over. Orange blossom, violet, rose, magnolia and jasmine blend with vetiver and pink pepper in a gorgeous floral layer with a bit of spice.

items.title: Viva Viola — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Viva Viola by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: A sweet and floral fragrance for women, Viva Viola was released by Ajmal in 2018. The perfume opens with top notes of raspberry, black currant and pear. This sweet and fruity blend is soon joined by rose and white flower heart notes.

items.title: Ajmal Aristocrat — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Ajmal Aristocrat by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released in 2018, Ajmal Aristocrat for her is a sophisticated floral woody musk that interfuses tones of citrus, white florals and sheer musk. Sparkling, tart-sweet orange and bergamot open the scent, harmonized with earthy, honeyed marigold nuances. Subtly intoxicating jasmine and warm hints of saffron emerge at the heart, sweetened with a touch of sugar.

items.title: Ajmal Evoke Gold — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Ajmal Evoke Gold by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by Ajmal in 2018, Evoke Gold is a bold yet feminine fragrance for women with a sense of adventure. A sweet and spicy blend of black currant, pink pepper and apple top notes open the fragrance, pulling you in with its unique scent. Floral heart notes of lily of the valley and peony soften the perfume and lead the way into warm, rich base notes of musk, tonka bean and vanilla that finish the fragrance with a hint of sweetness.

items.title: Aigner Starlight Gold — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Aigner Starlight Gold by Etienne Aigner Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by Aigner in 2018, Aigner Starlight Gold is a feminine fragrance created to celebrate the original perfume’s tenth anniversary. The updated fragrance adds an Oriental twist and opens with top notes of bergamot and plum. This fruity blend fades into heart notes of tuberose, violet, jasmine and ylang-ylang that soften the perfume with a light, floral scent.

items.title: Clean Reserve Citron Fig — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Clean Reserve Citron Fig by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by Clean in 2016, Clean Reserve Citron Fig is a light and refreshing fragrance that is suitable for both men and women. The perfume opens with bright notes of lemon, fig and ginger before moving into complementing heart notes of mandarin, copaiba balsam, mint and cardamom. Cedarwood, sandalwood and musk base notes complete the perfume.

items.title: Jo Malone Honeysuckle & Davana — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Jo Malone Honeysuckle & Davana by Jo Malone Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Lazy springtime days and butterflies feasting on newly-bloomed honeysuckle come to mind with one breath of this fresh, floral scent. Jo Malone Honeysuckle & Davana combines many natural elements to make one unforgettable fragrance. Davana, a spicy green plant that has a wine-like alcoholic aroma, is the main note.

items.title: Jo Malone Jasmine Sambac & Marigold — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Jo Malone Jasmine Sambac & Marigold by Jo Malone Cologne Intense Spray (Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Wake up to the precious floral aromas of the Jo Malone Jasmine Sambac & Marigold perfume. Inspired by the queen of all jasmines, jasmine sambac, this perfume is the epitome of delicate, floral perfection. This note is accompanied by marigold and benzoin to build an oriental feel.

items.title: Police To Be Tattoo Art — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes Eau De Parfum Spray 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Celebrating individuality and all things unique, Police To Be Tattoo Art is a sweet fragrance for women that delivers a desirable blend of nature and sugar. Immediately recognizable top notes for the inner gourmand include gooey marshmallow and maple syrup with a hint of freesia as nature’s sweetener. Middle notes step in as a mixed flower bouquet of heliotrope and apple blossom combined with rose and violet.

items.title: Montale Sweet Peony — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Montale Sweet Peony by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sensual and boldly feminine, Montale Sweet Peony is an intense floral fragrance enhanced by dark spice. Lush pink peony opens the fragrance with fresh effusion. Narcotic notes of jasmine and deep red rose bloom next, harmonized with luscious tones of ripest peach and creamy coconut.

items.title: Lolitaland — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Lolitaland by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Lolita Lempicka in 2018, Lolitaland is a powdery-sweet and fresh fruity floral fragrance for women. The opening notes are effervescent with bright tones of mandarin orange, grapefruit, lemon and lime pricked with warm hints of Sichuan pepper. Intoxicating flowers and succulent fruit notes emerge at the heart, mingling jasmine, magnolia and deep red rose with black currant, white peach and plum.

items.title: Cross of Asia — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Cross of Asia by Orlov Paris Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Travel to the other side of the world with the Asian influences of the Cross of Asia perfume. Top notes of geranium let you take in the beauty that China has to offer. Next, heart notes of ylang-ylang flower showoff its Indian roots.

items.title: Demeter Angel Food — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Angel Food by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Enjoy the sweet and succulent aroma of sponge cake with Demeter Angel Food. This perfume, which was released by Demeter in 1997, smells just as delectable as the famous light and fluffy dessert it is named after. A scented blend of coconut, sugar, warming vanilla and egg whites completes this fragrance for a scent that is comforting and charming and lingers throughout the day.

items.title: Demeter Bamboo — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Bamboo by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: If you're seeking a perfume for women that evokes the fresh, exotic vibe of a bamboo forest, try Demeter Bamboo. Tender green shoots of bamboo are flanked by notes of guava, lemon juice, mango, orange liquor and passion fruit. These natural ingredients lift your spirits and mood whenever you splash on this intoxicating fragrance from Demeter.

items.title: Demeter Banana Flambee — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Banana Flambee by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: An ode to the rich, caramelized flavors of an adored dessert, Demeter Banana Flambee will have your friends and admirers thronging to you. From the distinctive note of banana to the accompanying sugar and cognac notes, this intoxicating fragrance for women makes a splash at daytime activities or evening assignations. Wherever you go, you'll exude a sweetness and complexity that's all your own.

items.title: Demeter Banana Flambee — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Banana Flambee by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women

items.title: Demeter Between The Sheets — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Between The Sheets by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by a 1920s cocktail recipe, Demeter Between The Sheets is a whimsical blend of guava, lemon, mango, orange, passionfruit and rum. When you spritz a little of this fresh tropical fragrance on your pulse points, you can expect to become the center of attraction. Aromatic and fruity, it's the kind of perfume that is especially appropriate for wear in the summertime months.

items.title: Demeter Between The Sheets — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Between The Sheets by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women

items.title: Demeter Birthday Cake — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Birthday Cake by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: You can have your cake and smell it, too! Thanks to Demeter Birthday Cake perfume, every day is a special celebration when you inhale the delicious notes of chocolate cake, buttercream icing and pink icing flowers. Revel in the rich cocoa and sugary confection and transport yourself to birthdays of yesteryear and the future.

items.title: Demeter Black Russian — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Black Russian by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the cocktail of the same name, Demeter Black Russian marries the traditional ingredients of the beverage in one sophisticated swoop. Coffee, vodka and sugar are the three central notes, each one supporting the others to produce a powerful effect. If you love the taste of the cocktail, you'll love the aroma of the perfume.

items.title: Demeter Black Russian — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Black Russian by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the cocktail of the same name, Demeter Black Russian marries the traditional ingredients of the beverage in one sophisticated swoop. Coffee, vodka and sugar are the three central notes, each one supporting the others to produce a powerful effect. If you love the taste of the cocktail, you'll love the aroma of the perfume.

items.title: Demeter Bonfire — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Bonfire by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Wrap yourself in the intoxicating aura of a cool autumn day with Demeter Bonfire. Released by fragrance house Demeter in 2009, this smoky perfume conjures images of colorful orange, red and yellow maple tree leaves filling the tree-lined sky and gently falling on the path ahead. Hints of sweet apple cider comfort the senses as the powerful aroma of a burning bonfire creates a sensual and alluring warmness that makes one yearn to get closer.

items.title: Demeter Bubble Gum — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Bubble Gum by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Embrace the sweet carefree innocence of youth with a bottle of Demeter Bubble Gum. Designed by perfumer Demeter, known for its more than 300 unique single-scented fragrances, this perfume bursts with the lively and fun aroma of bubble gum. The first spritz takes one back to childhood, bringing alive memories of blowing the biggest bubble and laughing with friends.

items.title: Demeter Bulgarian Rose — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Bulgarian Rose by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A timeless aphrodisiac and calming oil cultivated from Rosa damascena blossoms, Bulgarian rose has long been a much sought-after ingredient for the finest perfumes. Demeter Bulgarian Rose, crafted by the fragrance house of Demeter, bottles the intoxicating allure of a valley filled with the delicate and precious flowers. Soft, gentle and intoxicating, this floral scent emits a sense of romance.

items.title: Demeter Champagne Brut — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Champagne Brut by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Pop open a bottle of Don Perignon champagne with the Demeter Champagne Brut perfume. This fragrance has the same elegance of the Don Perignon drink with a hint of added sweetness. Its singular champagne note lets you take in the slightly fruity nature of the drink.

items.title: Blue Grass — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Blue Grass by Elizabeth Arden Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Arden in 1934, Blue Grass is classified as a luxurious, flowery fragrance. This feminine scent possesses a blend of fresh cut flowers, wood and spices. It is recommended for romantic wear.

items.title: Demeter Chocolate Covered Cherries — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Chocolate Covered Cherries by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Why not enjoy the sweetness of chocolate-covered cherries all day? The Demeter Chocolate Covered Cherries perfume can help you do just that with its delectable cherry, chocolate and cognac notes. This combination creates the same happiness you feel when dipping into a box of this tasty treat.

items.title: Demeter Cinnamon Bun — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Cinnamon Bun by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The warm, sweet aroma of Demeter Cinnamon Bun by Demeter is sure to delight fans of the pastry. This fragrance holds several delicious notes, the most prominent of which is spicy cinnamon. Hints of sugar, milk and vanilla are reminiscent of icing dribbled over the golden brown spirals of pastry, while the light note of wheat brings to mind buns fresh from the oven.

items.title: Demeter Cinnamon Toast — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Cinnamon Toast by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter seems to have successfully bottled nostalgia with its tasty Demeter Cinnamon Toast fragrance. This perfume is a tantalizing mix of notes, including nutty wheat, warm cinnamon and a dash of sugar. Sweet and rich, this scent has moderate sillage and is long-lasting.

items.title: Demeter Coriander Tea — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Coriander Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The Demeter Coriander Tea fragrance by Demeter is an exercise in simplicity. This perfume holds only two notes to create the perfect balance between warm and refreshing. The coriander possesses a unique mix of spicy wood and juicy orange.

items.title: Demeter Cosmopolitan Cocktail — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Cosmopolitan Cocktail by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter offers a twist on a classic with the Demeter Cosmopolitan Cocktail fragrance. items.title: Demeter Grass — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Grass by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Grass was launched in 1996 as one of this company’s three original fragrances. Refreshing and green, it perfectly captures the smell of a newly mowed lawn. This perfume is invigorating and slightly sweet and will evoke a wistfulness for the great outdoors.

items.title: Demeter Gingerale — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Gingerale by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: For the dry scent of your favorite soda, take a whiff of Demeter Gingerale. The subtle sweetness blends well with the spices and citrusy tones to this distinctive smell, practically giving you that bubbly sensation in your nose. This singular scent was created by Demeter, designed to remain only one smell that is not overrun or overpowered by any others.

items.title: Demeter Ginseng Root — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Ginseng Root by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The fragrance of Demeter Ginseng Root takes on the scent of one of China’s most ancient and trusted medicinal herbs. Designed by the brand Demeter, named after the goddess of harvest, this natural scent is exactly what it says on the label, smelling of ginseng root. This perfume for women has a very natural and herbal scent, which is fresh and unique and will not be overpowered by any other smells.

items.title: Demeter Hot Fudge Sundae — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Hot Fudge Sundae by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the deliciousness of the frozen treat, Demeter Hot Fudge Sundae is a sweet fragrance for women that features both rich and fruity scent notes. Smelling strongly of chocolate fudge, this perfume from Demeter is a great choice for casual occasions, perhaps a fun night out with the girls. Notes of vanilla, whipped cream and cherry, necessary ingredients for every sundae, complete the fragrance.

items.title: Demeter Holy Water — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Holy Water by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Strange but familiar, difficult to describe with notes but unmistakable when experienced—this is Demeter Holy Water, a 2009 unisex scent created by the Us fragrance company Demeter. The fragrance is designed to recreate not just the holy water used in ceremonies but the whole experience surrounding it. It leads the imagination towards an old chapel filled with polished oak pews, a porcelain font warmed by the sun and hints of incense in the air.

items.title: Demeter Honey — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Honey by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: True to its name, Demeter Honey fragrance has one note, honey. This honey scent has nice warm undertones that linger beautifully throughout the day. It does have an enormous sillage, so take care to use it sparingly in small spaces.

items.title: Demeter Jasmine — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Jasmine by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: From the Demeter Fragrance Library comes Demeter Jasmine, a single-note women’s fragrance released in 2009. This composition features Spanish jasmine, a warm and intoxicating white flower that often plays a star role in many perfumes. Here, the jasmine is allowed to manifest its brilliance with its intensely warm, green and sweet aroma that also reveals mildly woody undertones.

items.title: Demeter Lavender — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Lavender by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Lavender is a floral herb prized for its calming properties. It’s also the star player in Demeter Lavender, released in 1995 as a floral green unisex fragrance with a powdery soft scent. Like other single-note offerings from Demeter, Lavender lets this sole olfactory note shine and reveal its aromatic, camphoraceous and licorice-like undertones.

items.title: Demeter Linen — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Linen by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Linen is a fresh, crisp, subtle scent inspired by the feel and aroma of sunlight-dried sheets on a freshly-made bed. As one of the oldest textiles in the world, Linen was used as a symbol of light and purity by the ancient Egyptians. Today, it’s prized for its soft texture and cooling properties.

items.title: Demeter Log Cabin — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Log Cabin by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Log Cabin evokes the experience of a snowy winter weekend at a cozy remote cabin with your loved ones. The unisex fragrance is characterized by rich, earthy wood notes, including oakmoss, Virginia cedar and Texas cedar. Smoky, sweet and green aromas combine to create this subtle yet sexy scent.

items.title: Demeter Orange Cream Pop — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Orange Cream Pop by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released as part of the Sweet Delights collection, Demeter Orange Cream Pop is summertime in a bottle. This fragrance will bring you back to childhoods spent chasing after the ice cream truck and the joy of an icy treat. This perfume from Demeter incorporates notes of vanilla and orange with sweet whipped cream and water notes to create the familiar scent.

items.title: Demeter Sambuca — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Sambuca by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Sambuca is a men’s and women’s fragrance with a single fragrance note of Sambuca, an Italian liqueur flavored with anise and infused with elderflower and licorice. The liqueur is also sweetened with sugar and contains a proprietary combination of herbs and spices to give it its unique taste. The scent is best for fall night wear and has moderate longevity and sillage ranging between moderate and enormous.

items.title: Demeter Lilac — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Lilac by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Lilac is a 2009 fragrance released as part of the brand’s Spring Is in the Air collection. This single-note scent is designed to evoke the intoxicating aroma of these gorgeous purple blooms that signify the full swing of spring. Fans of this scent say it smells exactly like a lilac bush, so you can have that new beginnings feeling all year long.

items.title: Demeter Pixie Dust — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Pixie Dust by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A delicious gourmand perfume, Demeter Pixie Dust is a wonderful floral fruity addition to your fragrance collection. It was launched in 2013 by Demeter Fragrance, a company that creates scents inspired by everyday aromas. The two notes in this perfume are sugar and fruity notes, which combine to invoke a youthful ambience.

items.title: Demeter Mountain Air — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Mountain Air by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the atmosphere of Alaskan mountains, Demeter Mountain Air attempts to bottle the awe-inspiring feeling of the expansive landscape by combining floral and earthy notes. It was released by Demeter in 2015 and is a great choice for both men and women. Green and woody notes transport you to a beautiful mountainside surrounded by trees and fresh air.

items.title: Demeter Kitten Fur — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Kitten Fur by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Kitten Fur Perfume by Demeter

items.title: Demeter Suntan Lotion — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Suntan Lotion by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2000, Demeter Suntan Lotion is the epitome of summer fun and joy. Crafted by the Pennsylvania-based fragrance brand Demeter, the women’s perfume is meant to brilliantly ignite memories of and feelings for luxuriating in the bright sun rays of summer. The fresh white floral scent bursts with the singular intoxicating fragrance note of orange blossom.

items.title: Demeter New Baby — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter New Baby by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter New Baby is a unique and unexpected delight of a scent. Released in 2015 by the popular fragrance house of Demeter, this unisex perfume is light and sheer, making it perfect for wearing on its own or layering with your own personal favorite scents. Spritz on the fragrance and enjoy the pure happiness and joy of taking in the aroma of a cuddly and soft new baby.

items.title: Demeter Neroli — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Neroli by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Neroli is a single-note perfume from Demeter that focuses on the oil produced by the bitter orange tree. This oil smells both floral and fruity, offering a lovely and unique scent. While it works well on its own for a soft and subtle every day fragrance, this perfume is also a great choice for layering.

items.title: Demeter Oud — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Oud by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created using only the scent note of agarwood, Demeter Oud is an intriguing fragrance for both women and men that was released by Demeter in 2013. Agarwood is a complex scent that is both woody and sweet. While you can wear this fragrance alone, as it provides a rich scent on its own, it is particularly suited to layering and will add depth to other perfumes.

items.title: Demeter Oud — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Oud by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created using only the scent note of agarwood, Demeter Oud is an intriguing fragrance for both women and men that was released by Demeter in 2013. Agarwood is a complex scent that is both woody and sweet. While you can wear this fragrance alone, as it provides a rich scent on its own, it is particularly suited to layering and will add depth to other perfumes.

items.title: Demeter Orange Blossom — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Orange Blossom by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Orange Blossom is a lovely, light scent that can be worn by both men and women. Featuring only the single scent note of orange blossoms, this perfume from Demeter is great for layering to create your own personalized scent. It is also wonderful on its own, providing the subtle scent of the white flowers found on the orange tree.

items.title: Demeter Pizza — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Pizza by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: For an unusual scent that appeals to men and women, try Demeter Pizza. This aromatic fruity fragrance features a blend of tomato, oregano, and cheese notes for an amazingly accurate recreation of the popular food. It was created in 2013 by Demeter Fragrance, a company that uses simples note combinations to evoke everyday memories and experiences.

items.title: Demeter Pistachio Ice Cream — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Pistachio Ice Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A sweet, nutty fragrance, Demeter Pistachio Ice Cream was released in 2014 for dessert lovers everywhere. It is bold and attention-getting, with a savory, enticing aroma. It is a well-balanced blend that can be enjoyed all year long—just like ice cream.

items.title: Demeter Pure Soap — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Pure Soap by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Experience the calming and relaxing benefits of taking a long lounge in the bath any time of the day when you surround yourself with the fresh aroma of Demeter Pure Soap. Launched by the fragrance brand Demeter in 2009, the women’s perfume perfectly captures the comforting and refreshing scent of newly-cleaned and scrubbed skin. The fragrance leaves behind a faint aroma that smells of Ivory Soap.

items.title: Demeter Pruning Shears — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Pruning Shears by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Transport yourself to a fresh spring garden or a classy outdoor tea with Demeter Pruning Shears cologne. This 1998 release features the scents of rose absolute and Bulgarian roses balanced by the essence of green grass. True to its name, this Demeter fragrance features a subtle a metallic tang reminiscent of pruning shears, but a recent reformulation places the roses in the spotlight.

items.title: Demeter Quince — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Quince by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by the popular fragrance brand Demeter, the women’s perfume Demeter Quince needs but one intoxicating note to make a statement. The simple uplifting scent contains the single bright and zesty note from the quince fruit. The smell of the fruit is likened to a cross between a juicy pear and a ripe apple.

items.title: Demeter Riding Crop — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Riding Crop by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Riding Crop is a leather men’s and women’s fragrance from Demeter with animalic, smoky, and woody main accords. The single fragrance note is leather, particularly the aroma from worn leather, which adds sensuality, spiciness and warmth to this concoction. There is a faint floral undertone that gives this scent some subtlety.

items.title: Demeter Red Poppies — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Red Poppies by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Red Poppies is a women’s floral fragrance that was announced by Demeter in 2009. This single note scent has red poppy as its fragrance note. This sensual, brilliant perfume was inspired by soft, undying large groups of wildflowers, known for their velvety petals, growing in fields during a warm summer evening.

items.title: Demeter Spring Break — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Spring Break by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2003 by Demeter, Demeter Spring Break is a fresh and exciting scent for women that brings about visions of fun, excitement and spring break. The intoxicating blend of coconut, coumarin and its marine-like undertones deliver a sweet and yet subtle and fresh punch that invades the senses. The mellow yet refreshing fragrance leaves passersby with beachside lingering thoughts of relaxation, peace and tropical vacation happiness.

items.title: Demeter Spring Break — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Spring Break by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2003 by Demeter, Demeter Spring Break is a fresh and exciting scent for women that brings about visions of fun, excitement and spring break. The intoxicating blend of coconut, coumarin and its marine-like undertones deliver a sweet and yet subtle and fresh punch that invades the senses. The mellow yet refreshing fragrance leaves passersby with beachside lingering thoughts of relaxation, peace and tropical vacation happiness.

items.title: Demeter Dragon Fruit — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Dragon Fruit by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Dragon Fruit perfume is a unique and incredibly natural-smelling fragrance featuring dragon fruit as its single note. This fruit is not quite like any other – native to the Americas, it’s very exotic-looking and lightly sweet – just like this perfume. The scent is bubbling with juiciness, with a mild sweetness; like a berry, but not sugary at all.

items.title: Demeter Sweet Pea — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Sweet Pea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The sight of a delicate sweet pea trailing up a trellis is one of the surefire signs of spring, and this old-fashioned bloom still graces many a garden. Demeter Sweet Pea from Demeter seeks to duplicate the smell of these small, dainty blossoms. It has a sweet floral scent with a fresh, green finish.

items.title: Demeter Silvery Tip Pekoe — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Silvery Tip Pekoe by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A crisp, clean and floral fragrance that develops over time, Demeter Silvery Tip Pekoe was first introduced in 2014 by Demeter and awakens the senses while leaving passersby guessing. The balanced, invigorating and earthy impression slowly gives way to a citrusy blend of lemon juice, guava, mango, orange liqueur, passion fruit and green and white tea that hints at the original floral scent and leaves a strong, lasting and unforgettable impression of its namesake, Silvery Tip white tea.

items.title: Demeter Saddle — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Saddle by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Saddle is a leather men’s and women’s fragrance from Demeter with animalic, woody, and smoky main accords. Ideal for fall season wear on its own or as a layer underneath other aromas, this scent has brief longevity and soft sillage. With its singular fragrance note of leather, this potion was created to evoke memories or fantasies of riding horses.

items.title: Demeter Tomato Seeds — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Tomato Seeds by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 1996 by the fragrance house of Demeter, the crisp, fresh and invigorating Demeter Tomato Seeds scent is all women. The crisp and intoxicating top note of tomato gives the perfect blend of green, spicy tomato berry scent without overpowering the senses. Exudes sophistication and class while leaving behind a bit of mystery to all who smell the mesmerizing aroma of tomato, fruit, and earthiness and leave mouths and hearts watering and wanting for more.

items.title: Demeter Chai Tea — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Chai Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Relax for a while with the warm and spicy aromas of Demeter Chai Tea. This perfume captures the wholesome essence of this timeless drink with notes of clove, cardamom and cinnamon. Other notes of star anise, pepper and ginger continue this drink’s spicy spirit.

items.title: Demeter Violet — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Violet by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Violet by Demeter is a floral fragrance made up primarily of a dominant violet linear note that pervades throughout the top, middle and bottom of the perfume. Powdery, woody accords compliment the violet flower, offering a sweet aroma with soft sillage and short to moderate longevity. Wear it everywhere, apply often and use it any time of the year.

items.title: Demeter Caribbean Sea — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Caribbean Sea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Take a dip into clear waters with the fresh aroma of the Demeter Caribbean Sea perfume. This item contains only one ingredient, sea water. By highlighting this note, you can experience the beauty of the sea in its purest form.

items.title: Demeter Gardenia — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Gardenia by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Smell as sweet and delicate as the tropical flower with Demeter Gardenia. Designed by Demeter, named after the goddess of the harvest, this perfume for women is simple yet powerful. Taking on only the scent of gardenia flowers, you will remain smelling floral throughout the day without changing scent notes.

items.title: Demeter Great Barrier Reef — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Great Barrier Reef by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2015 as part of this company’s Destination Collection, Demeter Great Barrier Reef was designed to evoke thoughts of the beautiful Pacific Ocean and the gorgeous coral that rests in its waters. This fragrance is sweet and powdery, with hints of a salty sea breeze. It is a perfect summer aroma that will have you longing to bury your toes in the sand.

items.title: Demeter Lavender Martini — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Lavender Martini by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A timeless floral scent gets an unexpected twist in Demeter Lavender Martini. This women’s fragrance contains citrusy, aromatic, sweet, fresh spicy and floral accords. Lavender imparts its calming herbal aroma, but this perfume is anything but sedate with a distinctively punchy blend representing the classic martini.

items.title: Demeter Tangerine — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Tangerine by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: In the midst of the bleak winter months, one bright spot is the arrival of tangerine season. These oblong fruits, so juicy and easier to peel than oranges, have an invigorating, fresh scent. Demeter Tangerine by Demeter delivers an energizing blast in fragrance form, with a fruity citrus scent that is similar to oranges, but with a sweet, honeyed finish.

items.title: Demeter Thailand — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Thailand by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: There is nothing quite like the experience of browsing through and purchasing spices in the open-air markets of Thailand. The chaotic action and hubbub highlight the warm and stimulating atmosphere. It is this scent that Demeter reproduces in Demeter Thailand.

items.title: Demeter Thailand — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Thailand by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: There is nothing quite like the experience of browsing through and purchasing spices in the open-air markets of Thailand. The chaotic action and hubbub highlight the warm and stimulating atmosphere. It is this scent that Demeter reproduces in Demeter Thailand.

items.title: Demeter Amber — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Amber by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Amber is a playful, seductive fragrance for women. The warm aroma of amber is inviting and sultry, as well as uplifting. This sweet and refined scent is suitable to wear during the day and for those special nights out.

items.title: Demeter Butterscotch — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Butterscotch by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Create a sweet and irresistible allure with Demeter Butterscotch. Crafted by Demeter, a unique perfumer that captures the essence of single scents, this perfume may make people’s mouths water. This scent is like unwrapping a buttery richness that oozes a smooth and sugary intoxicating aroma, which warms the senses on a cool or cold day.

items.title: Demeter Barbados Cherry — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Barbados Cherry by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A bright, tart-sweet fragrance, Demeter Barbados Cherry evokes the bounty of spring and summer in the tropics. Dab on a little and wait for the mouth-watering scent of its signature cherries to consume you and those in your company. You'll all enjoy a hint of tropical splendor and the accompanying feeling of well-being and optimism.

items.title: Demeter Black Ginger — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Black Ginger by Demeter Cologne Spray (formerly Kahala ) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2012, Demeter Black Ginger is packed full of ginger, ginger flower and spices. Distinct for its spicy nature, the fragrance is both energizing and warming. If you're looking for a long-lasting perfume that celebrates one of the most beloved roots in nature, turn to this full-bodied offering from Demeter.

items.title: Demeter Blue Spruce — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Blue Spruce by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2016, Demeter Blue Spruce perfume fulfills your belief that Christmas should come every day. From the aromatic group of fragrances, this perfume features signature spruce and ozonic notes that conjure feelings of pure health and festivity. Dash on a little of this enticing Demeter fragrance and let your olfactory senses take over.

items.title: Demeter Baby Shampoo — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Baby Shampoo by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Baby Shampoo, launched by the fragrance house of Demeter in 2016, is a light and gentle perfume that is suitable for both women and men. The fresh, powdery aroma of baby shampoo dries to a subtle, slightly sweet scent that is mild and calming. This clean, natural fragrance has a soft sillage and is not overpowering.

items.title: Demeter Beeswax — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Beeswax by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2008, Demeter Beeswax is an oriental floral fragrance for women. With its sweet animalic notes, you could be excused for shirking work and fleeing to the woods! Composed of beeswax, flower pollen and honey, this slightly powdery perfume from Demeter is at once soothing and enlivening.

items.title: Demeter Cuba — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) (Sin caja) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Cuba by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced as a member of the Destination Collection in 2015, Demeter Cuba by Demeter aims to take you away to the sunny shores of its namesake country. This fragrance is a tantalizing combination of the island’s most well-known exports with notes of sugar cane, sharp spices and earthy tobacco. A touch of rich vanilla and smoky whiskey provide depth.

items.title: Demeter Cuba — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Cuba by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced as a member of the Destination Collection in 2015, Demeter Cuba by Demeter aims to take you away to the sunny shores of its namesake country. This fragrance is a tantalizing combination of the island’s most well-known exports with notes of sugar cane, sharp spices and earthy tobacco. A touch of rich vanilla and smoky whiskey provide depth.

items.title: Demeter Christmas in New York — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Christmas in New York by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Christmas in New York by Demeter is a festive scent evocative of a December night spent in Times Square. Released in 2009, this unisex perfume begins with top notes of warm spices like cinnamon mixed with crisp apple, crowned with the sugary delight of candied chestnuts. The delicious aroma then moves into base notes of rum and cream.

items.title: Demeter Dark Chocolate — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Dark Chocolate by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2013, Demeter Dark Chocolate is a rich, warm fragrance that is comforting and familiar. Sweet and slightly spicy, it is ideal for the woman seeking something different and can be worn during a night out or as an everyday perfume. It is a true chocolaty aroma and is creamy and familiar without turning bitter.

items.title: Demeter Fresh Hay — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Fresh Hay by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Enjoy a pleasant springtime scent with a nostalgic feel with Demeter Fresh Hay, an aromatic green unisex fragrance. As part of Demeter’s collection of single note scents, it delights the senses a solitary note of hay. This cut and dried grass’s familiar aroma offers sweet, earthy, warm and dry tones that evoke a rustic feel and memories of summer.

items.title: Demeter Ireland — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Demeter Ireland by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Demeter Ireland beautifully captures the Emerald Isle’s essence in a fresh, uplifting unisex fragrance. its composition features a blend of green and aquatic notes, similar to the Demeter brand’s other dual-note colognes. The wearer may think of Ireland’s verdant landscapes of rolling hills and expansive fields, along with the breathtaking views of its coastline and its majestic rivers.
