items.description_en: Make heads turn wherever you go wearing Be Extra Delicious by Donna Karan. Launched in 2020, this perfume is a tantalizing blend of fruity and floral that is ultra-feminine and irresistible. It opens with a complementary blend of black currant, freesia, pear and bergamot.

items.title: Ktoret 173 Candy — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Ktoret 173 Candy by Michael Malul Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First launched by London-based designer Michael Malul in 2020, Ktoret 173 Candy is a vibrant and vivacious fruity floral scent set against a sensual backdrop of embracing amber and musk. Top notes blend sheer, sparkling citrus with crisp, tantalizing hints of bright quince. Shimmering floral tones bloom next, fusing jasmine and freesia with freshly intoxicating rose.

items.title: Joie de Vie — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Joie de Vie by Michael Malul Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by London designer Michael Malul in 2019, Joie de Vie is a delicately fresh citrus white floral scent enhanced by a hint of subtle sweetness. Opening notes are a breathless embrace of sparking mandarin orange and lovely lotus mingled with a whisper of apple blossom. Powdery violet and serene jasmine merge with lush nuances of magnolia at the heart, followed by a smooth and serene base of light blended woods and sheer musk.

items.title: Andrew Charles — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Andrew Charles by Andy Hilfiger Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: A great fragrance for any occasion, Andrew Charles by Andy Hilfiger is a fruity floral perfume that is sure to delight your senses. It opens with a warm, earthy foundation made up of ambroxan, patchouli and white musk base notes. The strong floral accord is incorporated with tantalizing heart notes of peony, orange blossom and datura flower.

items.title: Al Haramain Hayati — Eau de Parfum en spray 12 ml (0.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Al Haramain Hayati by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray 0.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Perfume house Al Haramain, based in United Arab Emirates, launched a seductive and exotic unisex fragrance to make lasting memories. Al Haramain Hayati is rich and dark, with just enough hints of lighter elements to add a playful charm to the scent profile. It opens with bold top notes of ambergris and musk for a strong introduction.

items.title: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Stay in that warm comfort of sleeping in on the weekend whenever you wear Replica Lazy Sunday Morning, a unisex scent. Launched in 2013 by French perfume house Maison Margiela, this fragrance takes its inspiration from the decadence of doing nothing. It opens with top notes of pear, ambrette, and clean linen accords.

items.title: Replica Beachwalk — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Replica Beachwalk by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2012, Replica Beachwalk has all the promise of a warm summer's day. This unisex scent is from French perfume house Maison Margiela, and it opens with top notes of tart lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. At the heart are tropical notes of ylang ylang, coconut milk, and heliotrope.

The unisex perfume is featured in the Tiziana Terenzi Sea Stars collection and features scent notes of green-tinged tuberose, heady narcissus, zesty Calabrian bergamot, exotic passionfruit and romantic rose.

items.title_en: Sapil Rave by Sapil Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A feminine perfume from Sapil, Sapil Rave is a combination of floral and earthy notes. The opening layer of the fragrance brings together delicate iris, aromatic saffron and bright plum, creating a sweet blend of top notes. A floral heart becomes more prominent as the fragrance transitions, allowing jasmine sambac, iris and Bulgarian rose to capture your senses.

items.description_en: Reminiscent of a breezy summer's day, Love in White for Summer is a fruity, floral scent for women. The top notes of Bulgarian rose, sweet magnolia, and bergamot create a distinctive introduction, while heart notes tie iris to earthier notes of basmati rice and cedarwood.

items.title: Moresque Lady Tubereuse — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) para mujer

items.description_en: Let the intoxicating scent of Moresque Lady Tubereuse carry you away to a lush and mysterious world. This inspiring 2020 release from Moresque opens with fruity notes accented by spicy ginger and sweet tuberose. Heady heart notes of angelica, lily and ylang-ylang melt into a lavish and sensuous base of vetiver, white musk, vanilla, cedar, resin, tonka bean and amber.

items.description_en: Moresque Royal Limited Edition is a 2019 floral fruity women’s fragrance inspired by the Onna-bugeisha, women warriors that fought alongside samurai in pre-modern Japan. This scent opens with top notes of bright and juicy white peach, bitter grapefruit, powdery pink pepper and the sharp-sweet tones of rhubarb. Japanese peony, jasmine grandiflorum and iris make up the heart with a balance of creamy and narcotic tones with lightweight starchy and green facets.

items.title: Mademoiselle Rochas In Black — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para mujer

items.description_en: Introduced in 2020, Mademoiselle Rochas in Black looks at the dark side of femininity. The fragrance opens with top notes of bergamot, black tea, and blackberry for a fresh, slightly sweet beginning.

items.title_en: Demeter Christmas Bouquet by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Ideal for any holiday gathering, Demeter Christmas Bouquet is a fresh, floral perfume that is both enchanting and irresistible. It is made with a single scent note as part of the light fragrance collection Demeter is known for. However, the delicate scent of sweet carnations gives this aroma a subtle heady undertone that makes it both light and sophisticated so it wears well both during the day and at night.

items.title_en: Demeter Chrysanthemum by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Chrysanthemum is a beautiful, enticing floral green fragrance for contemporary women. Composed of chrysanthemum flowers, leaves and stems, the scent serves up aromatic, floral, fresh spicy and herbal accords, a full-bodied offering that is romantic and mysterious. Moderately long-lasting with an intimate sillage, the fragrance is a favorite among its fans for daytime wear in the spring and fall.

items.description_en: Chaz Sport is a stimulating fragrance for women that is perfectly suited for daytime use or casual evening wear. The base of this perfume consists mainly of smooth oriental notes like patchouli and sandalwood, but there is also a mellow overtone of vanilla and musk that completes the enticing effect of the overall fragrance.

items.title: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix by Parisis Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix by Parisis Parfums begins right at the top with notes of brilliant red berries and the wild, sweet scent of bergamot, offering just a touch of lavender. The heart of the fragrance delights with notes of jasmine sambac and delicate Turkish rose. The base is deep and robust with its strong notes of patchouli, musk, sandalwood, cedarwood, amber, and oakmoss.

items.title: Double Diamond — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Double Diamond by Yzy Perfume Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: No matter the occasion, dazzle and shine wearing Double Diamond by Yzy Perfume. Seductive and bold, this complex perfume captures the many layers of femininity. The sweet and citrusy opening of grapefruit, bergamot and blood orange exudes a playfulness that is complemented by a spicy and seductive heart of cinnamon, pepper, lavender and mint.

items.title: Voce Viva Intensa — Eau de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Voce Viva Intensa by Valentino Eau De Parfum Spray 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Whether you drape yourself in high fashion or simply dream of it, the lush florals, bright citrus bursts and warm touches found in Voce Viva Intensa prove to be a perfect pairing. Released by the fashion house of Valentino in 2021, the women's perfume captures the essence of opulent style mixed with everyday life. A citrus freshness comes alive in the top of the scent with notes of juicy mandarin orange and zesty bergamot.

items.title: La Rive — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: La Rive by La Rive Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Exude elegance and class no matter what day of the week wearing La Rive by La Rive. This feminine fragrance has sensual undertones mixed with a dreamy floral heart and a touch of the exotic. The delightful opening of freesia and pepper instantly refreshes and enlivens the senses.

items.title: Michael Kors Super Gorgeous — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Michael Kors Super Gorgeous by Michael Kors Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This 2021 perfume by Michael Kors is indeed Super Gorgeous! With captivating and elegant top notes of Mandarin orange, bergamot, and myrrh layered effortlessly over a middle of ylang-ylang, orange blossom, and jasmine sambac, this scent is striking and remarkable all the way through to its heart. The accords featured here are woody, citrusy, and sweet, offering a touch of inspiration and surprise.

items.title: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) para mujer
items.title_en: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari delivers a strong, earthy scent that is a delight to savor. It begins with top notes of patchouli and orris layered in a straightforward way over the middle notes at the heart, which include patchouli once again, this time paired with orris. Accords are strongly representative of patchouli, iris, and woodsy scents that present a musky aroma.

items.description_en: Moschino is best known as a design house with an avant-garde ede to their designs, and their fragrances are no exception to this rule.  The visuals for Cheap & Chic, a Moschino offering from 1995, bring to mind Olive Oyl from the old Popeye cartoons, and the floral, fruity scent pops with interesting notes like bergamot, petitgrain, white orchid, sandalwood, and vanilla.  That said, the fragrance isn't overpowering, and in fact is perfect to wear around the office.

items.title: Roger & Gallet Cedrat Citron — Fragancia en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex

Wear this scent for any occasion from Sunday brunch to shopping with the girls or going for a night out with that special someone.

This 2013 formulation from acclaimed fashion design house Hermes makes a bold yet tasteful first impression that gently fades into a titillating, long-lasting aroma.

items.title: Juniper Sling — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Juniper Sling by Penhaligon's Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

items.description_en: Introduced in 2014, Byredo Mojave Ghost blends a bevy of unusual notes to bring you a scent that exudes mystery and intense, earthy sensuality. Exotic top notes of ambrette and sapodilla hit your senses before the fragrance dries down to reveal notes of violet, magnolia and ambergris. This unusual women's fragrance makes a great go-to scent for daytime wear, and the complex characteristics make it an intriguing choice for mornings at the office or afternoons at the local art gallery.

Layering inspiring floral notes of iris, tuberose and African orange flower over solid base notes of benzoin and musk, this fragrance has a moderate sillage that leaves a lasting impression without being overwhelming. Perfect for evening, it surrounds you with an air of delicate beauty and grace, whether you're dining, dancing or getting close to that special someone.

items.title: Diptyque VETYVERIO — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Diptyque VETYVERIO by Diptyque Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

items.title_en: Moonlight In Heaven by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Moonlight in Heaven perfume was created in 2016 by Kilian, a perfume house founded by Kilian Hennessy, patriarch of the Hennessy cognac company. It is a sultry, fresh fragrance that invigorates and revives. Alive with fruity, tropical scents, it starts with citrusy top notes of grapefruit and lemon, tempered with the soft feel of red pepper.

items.title: Ambre Pimente — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ambre Pimente by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A woody, oriental unisex fragrance, Ambre Pimente was launched in 2012 by Ajmal. Spices combine with woody notes of guaiac wood and cedar, creating an intoxicating scent. Musk amplifies the woody notes and adds depth to the blend while the note of amber gives the fragrance a slight sweetness to balance out the scent.

items.title: Oud Satin Mood — Extrait de Parfum en spray 35 ml (1.2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Oud Satin Mood by Maison Francis Kurkdjian Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Oud Satin Mood perfume was created by the French company Maison Francis Kurkdjian in 2015. It is a lush scent filled with sensuality and warmth – a woody, oriental fragrance ideal for a formal evening out on the town. This fragrance for women opens with aromas of Turkish and Bulgarian rose, violet and benzoin, which complement deep notes of agar wood.

items.title: Escentric 04 — Eau de Toilette en spray 104 ml (3.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Escentric 04 by Escentric Molecules Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2017, Escentric 04 is an exotic and light fragrance blending the finest of citrus and floral aromas and adding a fascinating twist. This unisex fragrance from Escentric Molecules centers on the aroma of pure javanol, a molecule that takes the classic scent of sandalwood to a new intensity. Balancing this compelling base are energizing juniper and grapefruit mellowed with notes of elegant rose, galbanum and mastic.

items.title: Radio Bombay — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Radio Bombay by D.S. & Durga Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Radio Bombay is a sweet and warm perfume that was released in 2016 by the American fragrance house D.S. & Durga.

items.title: 4711 Acqua Colonia White Peach & Coriander — Eau de Cologne en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 4711 Acqua Colonia White Peach & Coriander by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2017 by German perfume brand, Maurer & Wirtz, the 4711 Acqua Colonia White Peach & Coriander is a light and fruity fragrance made for women and men. It combines the sweetness of white peaches with the tang of fresh citrus, the woody aroma of coriander and the earthiness of herbal notes. This scent brings to mind an evening stroll through a citrus garden in the summer: an excellent choice for those who prefer more natural scents.

items.title: 4711 Acqua Colonia White Peach & Coriander — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 4711 Acqua Colonia White Peach & Coriander by 4711 Cologne Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

items.title: Jeroboam Insulo — Extrait de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Jeroboam Insulo by Jeroboam Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: In 2015, the fragrance house Jeroboam launched an Oriental vanilla fragrance for women called Jeroboam Insulo. The top note of this enticing scent is vanilla for a smooth and irresistible opening. The middle note of jasmine in the heart perfectly complements the rich vanilla in the opening.

items.title: Jeroboam Oriento — Extrait de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Jeroboam Oriento by Jeroboam Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: The fragrance house Jeroboam introduced an exotic Oriental perfume for women in 2015, called Jeroboam Oriento. The top notes include lemon, saffron and styrax for an energetic opening. The middle notes are comprised of apple, rose and ylang ylang for a floral and fruity heart.

items.title: Jeroboam Origino — Extrait de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Jeroboam Origino by Jeroboam Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: In 2015, the fragrance house Jeroboam introduced a fresh and spicy perfume for women called Jeroboam Origino. The top notes include bergamot, peppercorns and rose for an intriguing opening. The middle notes are comprised of juniper and nutmeg to enhance the spicy flavors in the heart.

items.title: Seminalis — Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Seminalis by Orto Parisi Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Seminalis Perfume by Orto Parisi is a magnetic, unisex fragrance that stimulates the senses and has an air of seductiveness. This raw mixture of sweet, spicy and woody is sure to evoke attraction and make an impression as an alluring, energetic and powerful scent. Creamy almond and milk combine for a luscious beginning that is only sweetened by the intense aroma of resin.

items.title: Terroni — Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Terroni by Orto Parisi Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Terroni by Orto Parisi captures the smoky passion of a volcano. This 2017 unisex fragrance designed by perfumer Allesandro Gualtieri contains an earthy and intense blend of fir, incense and oud accords. A hint of red berries sweetens the fragrance, enhancing its seductive powers.

items.title: Boccanera — Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Boccanera by Orto Parisi Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Subtlety is not an element of Boccanera. Released in 2014 by Orto Parisi, this perfume tempts and tantalizes the senses with sweet and spicy indulgence. The delectable creaminess of dark chocolate and warm bite of ginger creates an enticing opening that quickly turns fiery and exotic with black pepper and chill pepper.

items.title: Nirvana French Grey — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Nirvana French Grey by Elizabeth and James Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Busting onto the scene in 2017, Nirvana French Grey by Elizabeth and James is an elegant fragrance created by Mary Kate and Ashley Olsen. The neroli scent (from the bitter orange tree) and lavender blend together to create a musky and citrusy fragrance. The fragrance is long-lasting yet non-obtrusive, and draws you into its sensual scent.

items.title: Montale Aoud Night — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Night by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Aoud Night is a unisex cologne launched by the perfume brand Montale in 2014. It has a sensual, smoky fragrance perfect for winter. The top notes have a touch of citrus, from the Sicilian lemon and bergamot.

items.title: Montale Aoud Forest — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Forest by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale released Montale Aoud Forest as an integral part of the Aoud Collection in 2009. It is a unisex fragrance, so anyone can benefit from the strong assortment of notes within the composition. The notes you will enjoy in this perfume include Amalfi lemon, rosemary, grapefruit, agar wood, ambergris, rose, ginger and white musk.

items.title: Montale Sweet Vanilla — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Sweet Vanilla by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Composed by French designer Pierre Montale and first released in 2015, Montale Sweet Vanilla fuses the rich sweetness of vanilla pod with fresh, crisp apricot nuances to produce a luscious but never over-sweet gourmand composition. Delicate fruit tones and creamy vanilla open the scent, followed by harmonizing base notes of powder and soft white musk. Lush yet lightweight, this unisex scent is simply stunning on its own or layered to create your own signature scent.

items.title: Montale Rose Night — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Rose Night by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally released by Montale Paris in 2014, Montale Rose Night is an elegantly chic rose fragrance illuminated by nuances of fruit and musk. The opening is a fresh and refined effusion of bright, citrusy rose petals. The floral notes deepen to an intense Bulgarian rose accord in the heart notes, enhanced by earthy-sweet patchouli.

items.title: Montale Aoud Greedy — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Greedy by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale has manufactured numerous perfumes over the years, including Montale Aoud Greedy in 2013. It was released with the Aoud Collection, and it functions as a unisex fragrance. Men and women alike can enjoy the sweet aroma of black licorice.

items.title: Montale Aoud Lagoon — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Lagoon by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Aoud Lagoon is a unisex cologne released by the perfume brand Montale in 2016. Sicilian orange and osmanthus blossom combine for a sweet and bright opening. The heart is comprised of light florals, with delicate tiare and lotus petals.

items.title: Montale Aoud Leather — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Leather by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Aoud Leather is a fragrance for men and women released in 2009 by Montale as part of its Aoud Collection. It combines the alluring aroma of spices with animalic scents for a rich, sensual fragrance that brings Eastern flavors to the forefront. Indian pepper, Guatemalan saffron, cardamom and Calabrian bergamot create an aromatic, spiced scent with a citrus tinge.

items.title: Montale Intense Amber — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Intense Amber by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale So Amber is a lovely woody floral musk with a modern oriental profile. The opening is a luxuriant yet refined floral effusion of lush Moroccan rose fused with soft suede nuances of saffron. As the scent settles, a warm and intimate accord of ambergris and creamy Indian sandalwood emerges, harmonized with delicate floral and fruit facets of tart-sweet raspberry.

items.title: Mancera Sicily — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Sicily by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2016 by Mancera and created by perfumer Pierre Montale, Mancera Sicily is a unisex fragrance with a bright, citrusy scent. Light and fruity top notes of mandarin orange, bergamot, peach, apple, grapefruit and pineapple create a refreshing opening to the fragrance. A bouquet of violet, ylang ylang, rose and jasmine add a touch of floral sweetness.

items.title: Mancera Holidays — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Holidays by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released in 2016, Mancera Holidays is a lovely paradise fragrance that layers tropical floral and marine tones over a serene, inviting vanilla musk base. The opening is a lush effusion of coconut laced with elegant, fruity-aromatic bergamot. Banana-toned ylang-ylang and sensuous tiare flower emerge as the scent warms on the skin, accompanied by ethereal aquatic undertones.

items.title: Mancera Aoud Lemon Mint — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Aoud Lemon Mint by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2016, Mancera Aoud Lemon Mint is a unisex fragrance that works well for both men and women. It was created by Pierre Montale for Mancera. Top notes of coriander, pepper, mandarin, lemon and almond provide a fresh opening layer that is complemented by earthy and floral notes of patchouli, Egyptian jasmine and agar wood.

items.title: Mancera Choco Violette — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Choco Violette by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by perfumer Pierre Montale, Mancera Choco Violette is a unique and intriguing oriental fragrance released by Mancera in 2016. Top notes of hazelnut, orange and bergamot open the fragrance with a bright freshness that is joined by an elegant combination of dark chocolate and violet heart notes. White musk and Madagascan vanilla base notes provide a sweet finishing touch.

items.title: Mancera Velvet Vanilla — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Velvet Vanilla by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2016 by French perfume house Mancera, Velvet Vanilla is a perfume as soft and delicate as its name. Accords of florals, musk, vanilla and fruits marry to forge a scent that is regal and elegant. Spritz on your wrist to experience a mix of fruits and spices including black pepper, nutmeg, mandarin, pear, clove and black currant.

items.title: Mancera Coco Vanille — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Coco Vanille by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Mancera Coco Vanille is a unisex fragrance released by Mancera in 2016. It was created by perfumer Pierre Montale. Sweet and tropical top notes of white peach and coconut transport you to an island paradise while heart notes of ylang ylang, tiare flower and Egyptian jasmine bring to mind a lush, blooming garden.

items.title: Mancera Aoud Orchid — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Aoud Orchid by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Mancera Aoud Orchid is a unisex fragrance released in 2017. It was created for Mancera by perfumer Pierre Montale. The perfume opens with fresh and sweet top notes of coconut, mandarin orange and peach.

items.title: Al haramain Dazzle — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al haramain Dazzle by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Deliciously fresh yet subtly sensual, Al Haramain Dazzle is a mesmerizing, sophisticated floral and fruity fragrance that’s perfect for elegant cool-weather wear. The scent opens with tangy, fruity-aromatic tones of bergamot and tart-sweet black currant. Lemon-fresh red rose emerges at the heart, fused with delicately perfumed litchi fruit and crisply herbal, intoxicating tones of davana.

items.title: Al Haramain Dazzle Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Dazzle Intense by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sweet citrus and flowers give way to mesmerizing Eastern tones of spice and musk in Al Haramain Dazzle Intense, a vibrant and seductive scent that layers fruity and aromatic notes over an intoxicating heart of fresh florals and lush gourmand accords. Sparkling tangerine and creamy orange blossom open the scent, rounded out by richly resinous elemi. Heady jasmine blossom and dark plum emerge at the heart, softened by violet-tinged orris root.

items.title: Demeter Aquarius — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Aquarius by Demeter Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Aquarius is part of the brand’s Zodiac collection, a line of 12 fragrances inspired by the astrological signs. Released in 2015, this scent is designed to create the feeling of vast, open space. Some of the most prominent notes include oud, cedar, long spurred violets and neroli.

items.title: Lalique Fleur Universelle Noir Premier — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lalique Fleur Universelle Noir Premier by Lalique Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2014, Lalique Fleur Universelle Noir Premier is a bewitching scent for the woman who likes bold spices and soft liqueur. At first spritz, you are greeted with a warm head accord of cardamom, pink pepper and decadent rum. These notes are followed with a heart accord of myrrh, cinnamon and alluring immortelle.

items.title: Stercus — Parfum 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Stercus by Orto Parisi Pure Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: With a deep and sexy scent, Stercus is a perfume which can be a fitting scent for both men and women, day and night. This unisex fragrance is created by Orto Parisi with a variety of warm and spicy scents. Seductive and alluring, this perfume includes the smell of sensuous leather and spicy tobacco.

items.title: The Afternoon Of A Faun — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: The Afternoon Of A Faun by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The Afternoon of a Faun is a warm, woody unisex fragrance that was launched in 2012 by Etat Libre d’Orange. Bracing notes of pepper and cinnamon are brightened by the citrusy note of bergamot at the top of the blend. Floral heart notes of rose, orris root, immortelle and jasmine add a hint of fresh sweetness to the fragrance.

items.title: Fils De Dieu — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Fils De Dieu by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fils De Dieu is an exotic women’s perfume released by the French company Etat Libre d'Orange in 2012. The top notes for this fragrance are fruity, with spicy ginger flower, bright lime, shiso and green coriander. The heart notes evoke dessert, due to the notes of rice, cinnamon and coconut, which blend into the florals of jasmine and rose.

items.title: Marquis De Sade Attaquer Le Soleil — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Marquis De Sade Attaquer Le Soleil by Etat Libre d'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Marquis De Sade Attaquer Le Soleil is a women’s fragrance created by Etat Libre D’orange. The perfume captures the essence of the sun with the overarching scent of rockrose or cistus. The 18th century French nobleman, Marquis de Sade, lends his sexual libertarianism to the unique fragrance.

items.title: Archives 69 — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Archives 69 by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2011, this bold and romantic fragrance is Archives 69 by Etat Libre D’Orange. This French perfumer created a fruity and spicy scent for women that opens with a blend of pepper leaf, pink berries and sweet tangerine. The heart is comprised of prune, orchid and smoky incense.

items.title: Kirke — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kirke by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: First launched by Tiziana Terenzi in 2015, Kirke is an effusive fruity chypre fragrance that layers bright tropical notes over shimmering florals and sensual musk. The opening is a sweet paradise cocktail of peach, passionfruit, pear and raspberry laced with fresh, tangy nuances of black currant. A warm sand accord develops at the heart, beautifully harmonized with lily-of the-valley and the almond and vanilla facets of heliotrope.

items.title: Orion — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Orion by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Orion is a floral and woody fragrance that was designed for women and men. It was released in 2015 by Tiziana Terenzi. This fragrance opens with fruity top notes of bergamot, pineapple, red currant, and apple.

items.title: Casanova — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Casanova by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Spritz on a little Casanova by Tiziana Terenzi and be ready for wherever the day goes. This unisex fragrance, launched in 2014, features a complex range of notes that entices and keeps people guessing. It opens with an array of fresh, sweet notes including bergamot, fig leaf, jasmine and orchid.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Elegant and ethereal florals mingles with hints of tropical fruits and warm, balsamic woods in Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea, a honeyed chypre floral fragrance released in 2015. The opening is luminous with citrus and delicate green tones, fusing bright lemon and cassis with exotic nuances of passionfruit and fern. The heart notes are a piquant, fresh floral accord that blends powdery, sweet red rose with shimmering lily-of-the-valley and hints of clove-tinged carnation.

items.title: Fenicia — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Fenicia by The Merchant of Venice Eau De Parfum Concentree Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

items.title: Liberty — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Liberty by The Merchant of Venice Eau De Parfum Concentree Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Spicy and earthy, Liberty is a unisex fragrance created by The Merchant of Venice as part of the Murano Exclusive collection in 2015. Thyme and saffron top notes open the perfume and fade into soft heart notes of white lily, white suede and cedar. Patchouli and crystal amber base notes add warmth while completing the fragrance.

items.title: Rococo — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Rococo by The Merchant of Venice Eau De Parfum Concentree Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Wrap yourself in a warm embrace of chocolate and floral-toned incense with Rococo, an intimate oriental floral fragrance released by The Merchant of Venice in 2015. The opening is a sweet-tart and enveloping effusion of bergamot and subtly spicy, resinous olibanum. Luminous white floral tones bloom next, mingling hazy heliotrope and heady jasmine with lovely undertones of warm clove.

items.title: African Leather — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex

items.title: Kedu — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kedu by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women

items.title: Italian Leather — Eau de Parfum en spray 200 ml (6.8 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Italian Leather by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 6.8 oz for Women
items.description_en: This unisex fragrance was created by the house of Memo Paris with perfumer Alienor Massenet and released in 2013.  It is a leathery scent for both men and women to wear.  It starts off with a dusty smoky personality.

items.title_en: Italian Leather by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women

items.title: Moon Fever — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 OZ) unisex
items.title_en: Moon Fever by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 OZ for Women
items.description_en: This unisex fragrance was created by the house of Memo Paris with perfumer Alienor Massenet and released in 2009.  It is a spicy citrus scent for both men and women to wear.  For citrus lovers you will find this an exciting scent to wear.

items.title: Byzantium Saffron — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Byzantium Saffron by The Merchant of Venice Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Byzantium Saffron is a 2013 Oriental scent for women with an exotic, alluring profile inspired by the love affair between Smilax and Crocus in Greek mythology. Saffron is the primary note in this warm, spicy perfume, highlighted with contrasting notes of white suede, crystal amber and Indonesian patchouli leaf. This scent is by The Merchant of Venice, an Italian perfume label that has released 75 fragrances since it was founded in 2013.

items.title: Carnal Flower — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Carnal Flower by Frederic Malle Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This is an unisex fragrance created by the house of Frederic Malle with perfumer Dominique Ropion and released in 2005.  It is a floral scent for both men and women to wear.  A fresh floral bouquet with a luscious dark and spicy side.

items.title: Carnal Flower — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Carnal Flower by Frederic Malle Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: This is an unisex fragrance created by the house of Frederic Malle with perfumer Dominique Ropion and released in 2005.  It is a floral scent for both men and women to wear.  A fresh floral bouquet with a luscious dark and spicy side.

items.title: Lipstick Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lipstick Rose by Frederic Malle Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Lipstick Rose was created for Frederic Malle by Ralf Schwieger in the year 2000. As suggested by the name, one of its most prominent notes is the romantic scent of rose. Violet is another floral note that strongly arrests the senses.

items.title: Mancera Gold Aoud — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Gold Aoud by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Mancera Gold Aoud is a mesmerizing floral woody musk released by the French fragrance house Mancera Paris in 2017. The scent opens with a bold, effusive aoud accord spiced with black pepper, softened with warm saffron and illuminated by bright citrus notes of lemon, mandarin and bergamot. As the introduction recedes, elegant floral tones emerge, mingling fresh red rose with jasmine and earthy-sweet patchouli.

items.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 60 ml (2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Amber Oud by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released in 2018, Al Harmain Amber Oud is a mesmerizing oriental woody fragrance that layers rich herbal aromatics over a warm and soothing base of precious woods, spice and musk. The scent opens with an energizing blend of camphor and citrus, mingling rosemary and cedar wood with sparkling lemon and fruity-aromatic bergamot. Spicy guaiac wood and warm hints of nutmeg and incense develop at the heart, followed by a soothing, sensual finish of tawny amber, balsam and earthy musk.

items.title: Mancera Red Tobacco — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Red Tobacco by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by Mancera in 2017, Mancera Red Tobacco is a unisex perfume created by Pierre Montale that works well for both women and men. Sweet and spicy top notes of white pear, green apple, cinnamon, nutmeg, saffron, agarwood and incense create a warm opening that is then joined by patchouli and jasmine heart notes. The rich opening layer is matched by an equally complex base note blend of Haitian vetiver, guaiac wood, tobacco, white musk, sandalwood, amber and Madagascan vanilla.

items.title: Musc Ravageur — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Musc Ravageur by Frederic Malle Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2000, Musc Ravageur is an Oriental fragrance created by Maurice Roucel for Frederic Malle. Floral and fruity top notes of bergamot, tangerine and lavender are complemented by spicy middle notes of cloves and cinnamon, a warm and inviting combination. The complex base note layer features a combination of woody and sweet scents, bringing together guaiac wood, sandalwood, cedar, musk, amber, tonka bean and vanilla to create a unique blend of scents that adds an earthy but soft element to the perfume.

items.title: Safran Rare — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Safran Rare by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Safran Rare is a sweet and smoky fragrance created by Amouroud in 2016. The base notes of sandalwood, benzoin, oud wood and woody vetiver establish a woody scent, while jasmine creates a comforting aroma. The middle notes, which include rose de mai, cedar, saffron and more jasmine, add a floral touch to the perfume along with some spice.

items.title: Midnight Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Midnight Rose by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Midnight Rose is a woodsy, floral fragrance that has an almost autumnal feel to it. Perfect for evening, this feminine scent has fragrant notes of iris and rose as well as fruity lychee and spicy amber that linger pleasantly through the night. First released in 2016, this sensuous scent is from the fragrance house of Amouroud, a relative newcomer to the world of scents and is establishing a name for itself with several popular unisex fragrances.

items.title: Amouroud Dark Orchid — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Amouroud Dark Orchid by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A sophisticated, modern fragrance for both men and women, Dark Orchid was released by Amaroud in 2016. This scent is mystical, mysterious and hypnotic. You’ll first notice citrus and floral notes including Sicilian bergamot, mandarin orange and black gardenia.

items.title: Santal Des Indes — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Santal Des Indes by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Santal Des Indes is a bold fragrance for women that want to make a statement. Made by Amouroud in 2016, the fragrance features top notes of absinthe and incense, intriguing audiences with spice and smoke. The middle notes of Chinese cedar, curry tree, narcissus and Turkish rose create a floral and earthy scent that is natural, yet romantic.

items.title: Oud Du Jour — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Oud Du Jour by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Oud du Jour illuminates magnificent oud with lovely fruit, floral and spice tones for a soft, sunny-feeling fragrance that’s perfect for warming chill days and cold nights. The opening is a delicately fruity effusion of raspberry and rosy pink pepper warmed by saffron nuances. Lush rose and lily-of-the-valley flourish in the heart notes, harmonized with deep plum and incense.

items.title: Oud After Dark — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Oud After Dark by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sweet fruit and florals merge with rich wood and spice in Amouroud’s Oud After Dark, a boldly sensual fragrance launched in 2016. Delicately bittersweet spice and lush fruit tones open the scent, mingling plush apricot and osmanthus with hints of saffron, black pepper and dianthus. A lush rose and oud accord emerges next, wreathed in frankincense and softened with velvet notes of plum and suede.

items.title: Miel Sauvage — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Miel Sauvage by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: If you are searching for the right evening scent to entice the senses then the Miel Sauvage fragrance by Amouroud is the right choice. Its top notes of red pepper and mandarin open up the fragrance with the right kick. Meanwhile, golden honey notes inject a subtle feminine sweetness.

items.title: Golden Powder — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Golden Powder by The House of Oud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: The House of Oud introduced Golden Powder perfume to the public in 2016 to fantastic acclaim. This is a spicier fragrance that will reinvigorate your skin when it is cold out during the winter months. The opening notes include cinnamon and sweet nutmeg.

items.title: Wind Heat — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Wind Heat by The House of Oud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fiercely individual, Wind Heat is an uncompromising fragrance for women first released in 2016. Animalic base notes include suede and musk, the former of which is soft but persistent, while the latter is relentless in its strength. Floral middle notes of peony, rose, and freesia bring a lightness and freshness to the profile, while the top note of pink pepper adds a spicy nuance.

items.title: Cypress Shade — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cypress Shade by The House of Oud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by The House of Oud as part of the Klem Garden Collection, Cypress Shade is a feminine fragrance that was released in 2016. Fresh and bright, the perfume opens with top notes of mandarin orange, lemon, star anise and bergamot. Enchanting mint, petitgrain, coriander and mimosa heart notes add a sweet and refreshing layer that is complemented by woody and earthy base notes of cedar and vetiver.

items.title: Blessing Silence — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Blessing Silence by The House of Oud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released by The House of Oud in 2016, Blessing Silence is a feminine fragrance that combines oriental and woody scents to create a decadent, indulgent perfume that works well for any occasion. Pure top notes of labdanum open the fragrance with a floral layer that is perfectly complemented by earthy patchouli middle notes. Rose, oud and sandalwood base notes combine to finish the fragrance with a warm sweetness.

items.title: Ambar Del Sur — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ambar Del Sur by Carner Barcelona Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Carner Barcelona captures the essence of the open sea in its 2018 fragrance, Ambar Del Sur. Sweet vanilla, exotic tonka bean, myrrh and Spanish labdanum emulate the warmth of the coastal air, while scents of spicy patchouli, amber and sandalwood waft in from afar. Bright bergamot and jasmine finish the sensory experience with notes as fresh and lively as waves crashing against the shore.

items.title: Megalium — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Megalium by Carner Barcelona Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The Megalium fragrance by Carner Barcelona provides great balsamic accords that are excellent year-round. Top notes like cinnamon and calamus create an opening warmth while mandarin orange adds just a small amount of zest. Middle notes like nutmeg, pimento and myrrh solidify this fragrance as a smoky scent with hints of spice.

items.title: Botafumeiro — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Botafumeiro by Carner Barcelona Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Botafumeiro, a mysterious, spicy unisex blend, was first launched by Carner Barcelona in 2018. Notes of pink pepper and Indonesian nutmeg gives the fragrance a balsamic quality while bergamot adds brightness to the blend. At the heart of the blend, floral notes of freesia, lily-of-the-valley and Spanish labdanum combine with Indonesian patchouli.

items.title: Ajmal Cuir Musc — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ajmal Cuir Musc by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2015, Ajmal Cuir Musc is a leathery unisex cologne with additional sweet, musky and woody accords. Juicy and tarty raspberry combines with deliciously fresh watermelon and the vitality of musk in the top notes. The dark, smoky essence of tobacco pairs perfectly with the sensual softness of leather in the heart.

items.title: Ajmal Amber Musc — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ajmal Amber Musc by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Ajmal Amber Musc is a musky, woody fragrance that entered the market the spring of 2015. The fragrance is part of a Musc collection, but sets itself apart with strong notes of rose throughout. Top notes include rose and musk.

items.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tom Ford Ombre Leather by Tom Ford Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tom Ford Ombre Leather combines an intense, deliciously sensuous leather accord with nuances of fruit, florals and spice to produce an irresistible, darkly glamorous fragrance. Sweetly resinous, fruity-aromatic cardamom opens the scent, followed by a bold effusion of fresh leather refined with subtly narcotic undertones of jasmine sambac. The finish is an earthy patchouli blend enhanced by deep amber and oak moss for a warm, balanced finish.

items.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tom Ford Ombre Leather by Tom Ford Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tom Ford Ombre Leather combines an intense, deliciously sensuous leather accord with nuances of fruit, florals and spice to produce an irresistible, darkly glamorous fragrance. Sweetly resinous, fruity-aromatic cardamom opens the scent, followed by a bold effusion of fresh leather refined with subtly narcotic undertones of jasmine sambac. The finish is an earthy patchouli blend enhanced by deep amber and oak moss for a warm, balanced finish.

items.title: Noir Epices — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Noir Epices by Frederic Malle Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This is an unisex fragrance created by the house of Frederic Malle with perfumer Michel Roudnitska and released in 2000.  It is a spicy woodsy scent for both men and women to wear.  Come on over to the dark side with this remarkable deep, bold scent.

items.title: Black Onyx — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Black Onyx by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A mysterious feminine fragrance released by Ajmal, Black Onyx is an oriental-inspired perfume that combines sweet and spicy scents. Warm and comforting cinnamon and cardamom are joined by lemon in the top notes before they are softened by rose, oud and myrrh middle notes. The fragrance is finished with an earthy base note layer of white musk, amber and patchouli that brings a sensual element to the perfume.

items.title: Carlisle — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Carlisle by Parfums De Marly Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Like a favorite sweater, Carlisle by Parfums De Marly, released in 2015, has a warm, cozy aura that is made to last. Suitable for day or night wear, this spicy and sweet scent opens with a fresh burst of mandarin orange and bergamot. This energetic balance soon welcomes the delightful heart notes of jasmine and violet.

items.title: Clean Fresh Linens — Eau de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clean Fresh Linens by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir and launched in 2018, Clean Fresh Linens by Clean is as comforting and inviting as sheets straight out of the wash. Accords of clean sheets, succulent Asian pear and juicy clementine form the top notes of the fragrance. A light and floral freshness makes a presence in the heart of the scent with notes of rain lily, orchid and blonde woods.

items.title: Clean Fresh Linens — Eau de Parfum en spray 63 ml (2.14 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clean Fresh Linens by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.14 oz for Women
items.description_en: Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir and launched in 2018, Clean Fresh Linens by Clean is as comforting and inviting as sheets straight out of the wash. Accords of clean sheets, succulent Asian pear and juicy clementine form the top notes of the fragrance. A light and floral freshness makes a presence in the heart of the scent with notes of rain lily, orchid and blonde woods.

items.title: Rose Omeyyade — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Rose Omeyyade by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2015 for women and men, Rose Omeyyade is a sweet perfume that captivates and delights. The top notes include raspberry, rose and pink pepper for an unusual combination of juicy, floral and spicy at the beginning. Brown sugar, patchouli and guaiac wood combine in the middle notes.

items.title: Larmes Du Desert — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Larmes Du Desert by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the vibrant Middle Eastern desert, Larmes Du Desert is a sensual feast with accords of woods, spices and smoke. Apply to your pressure points and you will begin the scent profile with top notes of cypress and incense before melting to a woody heart accord of guaiac wood, patchouli and cedar. Benzoin, amber and citrus round out this alluring fragrance.

items.title: Iris Fauve — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Iris Fauve by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2017, Iris Fauve is the creation of Marie Salamagne for Atelier Cologne. The unisex fragrance opens with top notes of floral iris, crisp bergamot and enticing cinnamon. The heart consists of nagarmotha or cypriol oil, patchouli and Haitian vetiver.

items.title: Cuir Sacre — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cuir Sacre by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Atelier Cologne released the unisex fragrance Cuir Sacre in 2015. The name of this fragrance translates to “sacred leather,” and leather is a key ingredient in the composition. Its down-to-earth nature begins with opening notes of juniper berries, cardamom and cypress.

items.title: Montale Vanilla Cake — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Vanilla Cake by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Vanilla Cake is a silky, serene yet versatile fragrance designed for both men and women and suitable for all types of wear—day to night. Top notes of this scent include soothing Madagascar vanilla, sweetened caramel and fluffy meringue. Later, wisps of warm milk and woody almond emerge for a calm and comforting finish that lasts for hours.

items.title: Montale Chypre Fruite — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Chypre Fruite by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Chypre Fruite is an elegant, subtly seductive fragrance that layers bright fruits and shimmering florals over a woody musk base. The opening notes are a fresh and vibrant blend of tropical fruits enhanced by delicately aromatic nuances of bergamot. Floral tones of rose and jasmine merge with earthy sweet patchouli in the heart notes, followed by a harmonizing finish of oak moss and musk.

items.title: Montale Intense Cherry — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Intense Cherry by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Intense Cherry is a 2017 release from the brand Montale. It is a women’s perfume with a sweet, light aroma suited for warm weather and time spent outdoors. Sour black cherry comes out in the opening notes, along with bitter, aromatic bergamot.

items.title: Mancera Black Vanilla — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Black Vanilla by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Mancera Black Vanilla is a unisex fragrance that was released by Mancera in 2017. This warm and rich fragrance combines sweet, floral and earthy notes to create an intriguing and sensual perfume. It opens with top notes of coconut, white peach, bergamot and black currant that are complemented by jasmine, rose and violet heart notes.

items.title: Montale Day Dreams — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Day Dreams by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Day dreams is a beautiful floral and fruity gourmand fragrance first released by Montale Paris in 2017. Inspired by warm Mediterranean evenings, the scent opens with an effusive, intoxicating blend of fresh orange blossom and honeyed neroli brightened with sparkling nuances of mandarin. Heady white florals bloom at the heart, mingling an intensive, hypnotic tiare flower accord with night-blooming jasmine.

items.title: Montale Fantastic Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Fantastic Oud by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Experience oud as you never have before. First released in 2018, Montale Fantastic Oud is a rich oriental woody fragrance that’s perfect for illuminating cold-weather days. The scent opens with an intensive blend of oud and fresh red rose.

items.title: Montale Aoud Legend — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Legend by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Aoud Legend is a women’s fragrance released by the perfumery Montale in 2016. It has a richly woody scent that is sensual and feminine. The top notes are distinctive, resinous agarwood and sandalwood, tempered by the delicate fragrance of saffron.

items.title: Montale Aoud Legend — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Aoud Legend by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Aoud Legend is a women’s fragrance released by the perfumery Montale in 2016. It has a richly woody scent that is sensual and feminine. The top notes are distinctive, resinous agarwood and sandalwood, tempered by the delicate fragrance of saffron.

items.title: Montale Golden Sand — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Golden Sand by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Golden Sand is a women’s fragrance launched by the perfume brand Montale in 2015. It is a feminine, floral scent that gets an edge from the addition of spices. The top notes are fresh and citrusy, with bergamot, orange and cool mint.

items.title: Montale Arabians — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Arabians by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released in 2017, Montale Arabians is an intense oriental fragrance that fuses a bold leather and oud accord with hints of florals and honeyed spice. The top notes combine fresh aromatic nuances of lavender with sweetly spicy cardamom and red thyme. Lovely rose blooms at the heart, accompanied by patchouli and subtle tobacco nuances of vetiver.

items.title: Montale Intense So Iris — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Intense So Iris by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Intense So Iris is a mesmerizing blend of floral and woody accords that wafts around the wearer in a subtle, gentle haze. This fragrance consists of the earthy, floral smell of iris, accented by creamy sandalwood and soft musk. The result is an alluring, powdery scent that beguiles the wearer and those close to her.

items.title: Aube Rubis Des Ors — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Aube Rubis Des Ors by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Aube Rubis Des Ors is a sophisticated and sensual fragrance for men and women. Top notes of grapefruit, bergamot and blackcurrant offer a bright beginning, supported by heart notes of violet, sage and spring iris for a sweet earthiness. Base notes of praline and patchouli weave together for a complex blend of fruit, flowers and herbs.

items.title: Le Participe Passe — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Le Participe Passe by Serge Lutens Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2018, Le Participe Passe is a fresh spicy, balsamic oriental unisex fragrance created by Serge Lutens. Notes of fresh, crisp bergamot and artemisia open the fragrance. The heart features fruity notes with spicy pepper.

items.title: Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut by Jo Malone Cologne Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Beautifully smooth and balanced, Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut fuses creamy nut tones with a richly woody base. Silken hazelnut notes open the scent, followed by a clean, aromatic blend of cedar, oak moss and frankincense nuances of resinous elemi. Robust, roasted oak and tobacco hints of smoky sweet vetiver provide a distinctive, sophisticated finish with moderate sillage and longevity.

items.title: Eau De Citron Noir — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Eau De Citron Noir by Hermes Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Eau De Citron Noir cologne stands apart from other fragrances with its central ingredient: black lime. This is a key component in many Middle Eastern dishes, and it is basically dried lime, which has a smoky and sour essence to it. Other notes in this cologne’s composition include Paraguayan wood, black tea, citron and lemon.

items.title: Montale Patchouli Leaves — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Patchouli Leaves by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Patchouli Leaves is an oriental fragrance that was designed for women. It was launched in 2006. This perfume features the notes of patchouli, vanilla, musk, amber, and labdanum.

items.title: Olfattology Kasai — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Olfattology Kasai by Enzo Galardi Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Olfattology Kasai is a fragrance that was created for women. It was launched in 2015 by Enzo Galardi. This fragrance opens with top notes of pink pepper, cardamom, nutmeg, cinnamon leaf, coriander, and rose.

items.title_en: Enrico Gi Oud Magnifico by Enrico Gi Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Enrico Gi Oud Magnifico is impressive in its simplicity and potent in its longevity. It has a down-to-earth effect that is nonetheless feminine. Notes of black pepper, saffron and amber lusciously blend together to produce a natural and mysterious aura for an evening date or important outing.

items.title: Percival Royal Essence — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Percival Royal Essence by Parfums De Marly Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Percival Royal Essence is a fresh and citrusy perfume created by Hamid Merati-Kashani for Parfums De Marly. Light fruity and floral geranium, bergamot, mandarin orange and lavender top notes evoke images of a bright and blossoming garden before they are tempered by spicy middle notes of jasmine, violet, coriander, cinnamon and hedione. A woody base note layer of clearwood, ambroxan, musk, amberwood and balsam fir further balances the fragrance with its complementing earthiness.

items.title: Irish Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.53 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Irish Oud by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.53 oz for Women
items.description_en: From Parisian fragrance house Memo comes Irish Oud, a long-lasting cologne for women and men with a heavy sillage. Its unmistakable fresh spicy profile includes a woody accord of birch and juniper, aromatic notes of mate and herbaceous clary sage, spicy scents of bittersweet tonka bean and rosy pink pepper, a resinous note of amber, and a floral hint of iris. Above all the other notes in the profile is the dominant sensuality of primitive leather.

items.title: Eau De Memo — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Eau De Memo by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by perfumer Alienor Massenet for Memo, Eau de Memo is a feminine oriental fragrance that was released in 2017. Fresh and citrusy top notes of lemon, green tea and bergamot give the perfume a bright opening that is complemented by spicy and floral middle notes of iris, jasmine and saffron. White musk, leather and moss base notes add earthiness to the fragrance.

items.title_en: Grand Soir by Maison Francis Kurkdjian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Grand Soir Perfume by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is an impressive fragrance for women, fashioned by only a few simple scent notes. At first spray comes the aroma of earthy, nutty labdanum of Mediterranean origin. The smell of tonka beans and warm vanilla soon follow, giving the perfume slightly more depth without over complicating the blend.

It is part of the White Collection offered by Atelier Des Ors, a newcomer in the world of perfumes and colognes. The scent opens with top notes of bergamot and delicate orange blossom.

items.title: Patchouli Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Patchouli Oud by Affinessence Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women

items.title: Sandor 70's — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sandor 70's by Carner Barcelona Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by an iconic bar in 1970’s Barcelona, a spritz of Sandor 70’s and you’ll feel like a disco queen. This leathery perfume will harken you back to nights spent socializing at the swankiest bars with friends. Spray on your pressure points and indulge in top notes of Bulgarian rose, Chinese osmanthus, bergamot, jasmine and suede.

items.title: Chaugan Delicate — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Chaugan Delicate by Chaugan Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Lush florals and warm spice are beautifully interwoven in Chaugan Delicate, an oriental fragrance launched by French fragrance house Chaugan in 2014. The opening is a lovely yellow floral effusion of ylang-ylang spiced with cardamom, black pepper and rosy nuances of pink pepper. Lush, alluring tuberose and a rich cream accord merge with incense and warm clove in the heart.

items.title: Dangerous Complicity — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Dangerous Complicity by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Sensual and magnetic, Dangerous Complicity is a woody floral fragrance enhanced by subtle spice. The top notes are a fruity-sweet blend of apricot-nuanced osmanthus spiced with crisp ginger, bay leaf and calamus. Luminous white florals of jasmine and ylang-ylang fuse in the heart notes with intoxicating undertones of rum and creamy coconut.

items.title: Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created in 2015 by Etat Libre D’Orange, Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre is an intriguingly elegant perfume crafted for sophisticated women. This harmonious blend of floral and earthy elements exudes an alluring sense of assertive confidence. Top notes of ambroxan, geosmin and pepperwood provide an enticingly warm and rustic ambiance that instantly captures your attention.

items.title: Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex

items.title: Rien Intense Incense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex

items.description_en: Rich oriental woods fuse with smoky incense, powdery florals and spice in Rien Intense Incense. The opening is a brisk aldehyde and bergamot effusion spiced with nuances of caraway and bracing black pepper. Powdery rose and earthy yet ethereal iris emerge at the heart, interwoven with rich accords of leather, labdanum and incense.

items.title: Remarkable People — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Remarkable People by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Remarkable People by fragrance house Etat Libre D'Orange is a scent that mixes oriental and spicy accords to reflect the spirit of remarkable women. This lovely 2015 perfume begins with opening notes of cardamom, champagne and grapefruit to invoke the beautiful harmony of zest and sophistication. It then unveils a spicy and feminine heart, which consists of jasmine, black pepper and curry tree.

items.title: Remarkable People — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Remarkable People by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
