items.title: Franck Boclet Vanille — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Vanille by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: The French fashion designer and perfumer, Franck Boclet, launched this sweet and citrusy fragrance for men in 2015. Franck Boclet Vanille blends vibrant and fresh accords with a hint of masculine spiciness, making it perfect for daytime or nighttime wear. The top notes include juicy grapefruit, cardamom and lime.

items.title: Franck Boclet Absinthe — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Absinthe by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2015, Franck Boclet Absinthe is an aromatic woody fragrance for men and women. In 2010, Franck Boclet started his French fashion house releasing perfumes as early as 2013. Notes of green mandarin, lavender and wormwood combine in the opening.

items.title: Franck Boclet Ylang Ylang — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Ylang Ylang by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2017, Franck Boclet Ylang Ylang is a sweet and sensual perfume for women. The top notes open the scent with bergamot, mandarin orange and incense for a refreshing beginning before combining with a floral heart of iris, jasmine and ylang ylang. Finally, the base notes of amber, caramel, musk and vetiver combine for a rich and smooth finish that entices all who smell it.

items.title: Giardino Benessere Tuberose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Giardino Benessere Tuberose by Giardino Benessere Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Perfume house Giardino Benessere released a white floral and spirited perfume called Giardino Benessere Tuberose in 2015. Water jasmine, ripe apricot and sweet orange all compose the top notes for a refreshing opening to this scent. The middle notes include ylang ylang, tuberose and jasmine for a sweetly floral heart.

items.title: Gritti Antalya — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Antalya by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The smell of the sun and sea beckon alluringly in this blend of marine and smoky notes by Gritti. Introduced in 2010, Gritti Antalya opens with the aromatic, herbal scent of myrtle mixed with the refreshing saltiness of the ocean. The heart of the fragrance is intense with the flavors of cedar, tobacco, and other woody notes.

items.title: Gritti Saraj — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Saraj by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Gritti Saraj is a smoky, aromatic fragrance designed for both women and men. The top of the scent is characterized by notes of angelica, cinnamon, olibanum and lime. Beneath, the heart of the fragrance consists of wood and herbal notes including labdanum, cloves, Egyptian jasmine, vetiver and Virginia cedar.

items.title: Gritti Preludio — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Preludio by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Gritti Preludio is a unique unisex scent that combines earthy and sweet fragrances for a distinctively alluring effect. Notes of watermelon, lemon and lavender combine with sensual musk and pine to create a strong, long-lasting fragrance that will get you noticed. You may also detect notes of tobacco, amber, sandalwood and borage.

items.title: Gritti Noctem Arabs — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Noctem Arabs by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This full, enigmatic fragrance from Gritti invites you to imagine a scene full of desert breezes and whispered meetings. Introduced in 2014, Gritti Noctem Arabs opens with earthy and rich scents from the notes of cedar, patchouli, and tobacco. The heart of the fragrance features oud, one of the most distinctive and luxurious ingredients in Middle Eastern perfumes.

items.title: Gritti Ephesus Prive — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Ephesus Prive by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The past and the present combine in this blend of spicy and woody accords. Gritti Ephesus Prive, introduced in Gritti in 2015, is named for the ancient city of Ephesus, a renowned center of culture, art, and learning. The opening to this fragrance is sweet and spicy with notes of orange and cloves.

items.title: Gritti Arete Prive — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Arete Prive by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Named for the goddess of virtue, Gritti Arete Prive is an intoxicating blend of leathery and woody accords. Introduced in 2015 by Gritti, this fragrance opens gently with notes of bergamot, labdanum, cardamom, and cinnamon. Belying its subtle beginning, the heart of the perfume grabs ahold of the senses with a sensual combination of leather, tobacco, and whiskey.

items.title: Gritti Neroli Extreme — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gritti Neroli Extreme by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This fresh, compelling fragrance from Gritti is a confident blend of fruity and green accords that is at once light and substantial. Introduced in 2017, Gritti Neroli Extreme opens with delicate springtime neroli, which is accented by leaf-green petitgrain and bright lemon zest. The heart of the fragrance is rich with notes of musk and slightly bitter galbanum.

items.title: Hayari Rose Chic — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Hayari Rose Chic by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: An enticing scent for women, Hayari Rose Chic was created by Hayari in 2015. Top notes of freesia, buchu and mandarin orange offer an intriguing blend of floral and citrus that introduces an invigorating freshness. Magnolia, rose and lily of the valley middle notes offer an alluring hint of delicate sweetness that integrates beautifully with the other elements.

items.title: Hayari Amour Elegant — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Hayari Amour Elegant by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Hayari Amour Elegant is a 2015 fragrance designed for both women and men, combining intoxicating florals with earthy, spicy scents. The top notes include herbal notes of chamomile and pink pepper along with sweet, zesty bergamot orange. Beneath, the heart is comprised of cloves, grasse rose and Indian jasmine.

items.title: Hayari New Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Hayari New Oud by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Hayari New Oud is warm spicy oud fragrance for women and men. Hayari combines oriental and French styles in the dozen perfumes the company has created since 2011. Petitgrain, bitter orange and orange blossom combine woody notes with delicate floral notes in the opening.

items.title: Ombre Indigo — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ombre Indigo by Olfactive Studio Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Celebrate sensuality and mystery with Ombre Indigo. This women's fragrance was created by Olfactive Studio and was launched in 2014. The base consists of ambergris, musk, and benzoin to give users a relaxing depth.

items.title: Olfactive Studio Panorama — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Olfactive Studio Panorama by Olfactive Studio Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Olfactive Studio Panorama by Olfactive Studio is a women's scent that wraps users up in the fresh, green scents of luscious forests. Released in 2015, the fragrance features top notes of bergamot and lemon. It follows with a heart of spicy wasabi and notes of fig, violet, galbanum and grass.

items.title: Arancia Ambrata — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Arancia Ambrata by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2017, Arancia Ambrata is a fragrance for women and men. Founded in 2010 by Luca Gritti, Gritti has created 32 fragrances. Blood orange and bergamot start the fragrance on a burst of citrus zest.

items.title: You or Someone Like You — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: You or Someone Like You by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: You or Someone Like You by Etat Libre D’orange is a summery, fresh fragrance. This brand was designed in 2017 and includes a perfect blend of ingredients. The flowery notes of hedione, cassis and rose will drift your mind into its favorite flower garden.

items.title: Musc Ambre Gris — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Musc Ambre Gris by Affinessence Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Affinessence introduced the world to its seductively exotic women’s perfume, Musc Ambre Gris, in 2017. An alluring combination of black musk and grey amber create a mysterious ambiance that captures your attention. Earthy notes of truffle, Haitian vetiver and mate infuse an invigorating and refreshing woodsy element that lends an element of warmth and comfort to this enticing fragrance.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Porpora — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Porpora by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Majestic rose flourishes in mesmerizing profusion in Tiziana Terenzi Porpora, a hypnotic floral oriental fragrance released in 2017. The fragrance opens with an intense accord of rose absolute, harmonized with lovely woody-spicy nuances of wild raspberry, cinnamon and clove. Bulgarian rose and hazy, earthy-floral poppy emerge at the heart alongside incense and patchouli.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Eclix — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Eclix by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the beauty of an eclipse, Eclix was introduced in 2017 by Tiziana Terenzi. The opening of the perfume is sweet and soft thanks to notes including almond, iris, and vanilla, while notes of lemon and tangerine add brightness to the blend. Floral notes of white lily and violet at the heart of the blend give the fragrance a powdery quality while the note of petitgrain amplifies the citrusy top notes.

items.title: Tom Ford Oud Minerale — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tom Ford Oud Minerale by Tom Ford Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tom Ford Oud Minerale is an aquatic woody perfume for women. Fresh and exhilarating, the fragrance opens with bracing pink pepper, savory sea salt and sea notes. The unmistakable smoked essence of oud is found in the bold heart along with styrax and seaweed.

items.title: Korloff Royal Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Korloff Royal Oud by Korloff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3 oz for Women
items.description_en: For women who are a little sweet and a little spicy, Korloff Royal Oud by Korloff captures and complements that unique essence. Launched in 2015, this captivating fragrance is a balanced blend of bold Oriental spices with sensual, delicate notes. It opens with a fragrant burst of rose, frankincense and nutmeg.

items.title: L'eau D'armoise — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: L'eau D'armoise by Serge Lutens Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: L'eau D'armoise Perfume by Serge Lutens

items.title: Montale Amber Musk — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Amber Musk by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Amber Musk is an oriental woody perfume for women. This versatile fragrance is composed of five notes. As the scent’s name suggests, both amber and white musk make a strong showing in this scent.

items.title: Demeter Almond — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Almond by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A unique perfume for women that is both flirty and fun, Demeter Almond was created by the fragrance house of Demeter in 2000. The simple scent of toasted almonds is sweet and refreshing, as well as evocative of the smell of desserts baking in the oven. This fragrance is long-lasting, with the irresistibly inviting aroma beckoning others to come closer.

items.title: Demeter Asian Pear Cologne — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Asian Pear Cologne by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Asian Pear Cologne, established by Demeter in 2015, is a seductive and delicate perfume for women. This fresh fragrance uses the delicious Asian pear for a slight sweetness, with a hint of spices such as cinnamon and nutmeg for an elevated scent that is natural and light, yet aromatic and durable. The result is a perfume that is both refined and elegant.

items.title: Demeter Rain — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Rain by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Rain, a unisex fragrance, welcomed spring showers when it was launched by the fragrance house of Demeter in April of 2009. Even just a quick smell of the perfume transports you to the outdoors after a heavy downpour, where you take in the aromas of fresh rain and wet earth. The scent has a refreshingly simple composition and features only rejuvenating and renewing rain notes.

items.title: Demeter Tomato — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Tomato by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced to the market by Demeter in 1996, Demeter Tomato is a fragrance for women. The strong yet, mesmerizing tomato note present a strong, yet pleasant green scent that leaves one wanting more. With moderate silage and a nice, long-lasting impression, the embodies every aspect of the tomato plant, from the stem to the blossoms and leaves.

items.title: Demeter Giant Sequoia — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Giant Sequoia by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The giant sequoia tree is a grand and majestic sight as one of the largest living things in the world, so embrace the boldness and confidence with Demeter Giant Sequoia. The brand Demeter is named after the goddess of the harvest, creating perfumes which are a single natural scent untouched by others. This fragrance for women is a fresh and woody scent, giving a spicy and lasting overtone that won’t be diluted by any other fragrances.

items.title: Demeter Lava Rock — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Lava Rock by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Lava Rock Perfume by Demeter

items.title: Demeter Lemon Meringue — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Lemon Meringue by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Lemon Meringue is as light and fluffy as its namesake pie. This is the third lemon fragrance released by Demeter, a brand that specializes in evocative single-note scents. This version is bright and invigorating, pairing the classic tartness of lemon with creamy, sweet vanilla undertones that provide a feminine countenance to the pure citrus notes.

items.title: Demeter New Zealand — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter New Zealand by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: This unisex fragrance is part of Demeter's Destination Collection and released in 2003.  It is a aromatic green perfume that both men and women can wear.  Inspired by the intriguing outdoors of New Zealand.

items.title: Demeter String Bean — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex

Creamy patchouli and woody tobacco nuances dominate the heart, followed by a rich, magnetic base of guaiac wood, amber and white musk veiled with sweet vanilla.

Florals persist in the background, joined at the heart by tangy black currant and fresh green hints of violet leaf.

Floral notes deepen to a heady crescendo at the heart, mingling lush, enveloping ylang ylang with warm undertones of leather, ambergris and nutmeg.

items.description_en: Amber Oud Tobacco Edition for men is a strong, spicy fragrance from the perfume house of Al Haramain. It opens with top notes of black pepper, ginger, cinnamon, and tobacco leaf. The heart continues this spice theme with middle notes of cloves, star anise, vanilla, cacao, incense, and tonka bean.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Arrakis — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Arrakis by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Arrakis Perfume was created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Golden Star Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  It is a warm spicy citrus scent perfect for every day.

items.description_en: Orionis Perfume was created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Absoluto Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  A beautiful oriental cologne with a warm inviting personality.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Wirtanen — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Wirtanen by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Wirtanen Perfume was created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Comet Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  It is an attractive musky woodsy floral cologne with a flirty personality.

items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Draconis by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Draconis Perfume was created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Golden Star Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  It is an inspired woodsy smoky spicy cologne.

items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Hale Bopp by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Hale Bopp Perfume was created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Comet Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  It is a remarkable spicy woodsy cologne with a bit of a seductive personality.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Tempel — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Tempel by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tempel Perfume was created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Comet Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  It is a floral scent with a bit of an animalistic personality.
