items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Halley by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Halley Perfume created by the house of Tiziana Terenzi with perfumer Paolo Terenzi and released in 2019 as part of the Comet Collection.  This is part of their unisex collection of fragrances for both men and women to wear.  It is a vibrant fruity floral scent with great grace and brilliance.

items.title: Rihanah Mukhalat — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Rihanah Mukhalat by Rihanah Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Rihanah Mukhalat Perfume by Rihanah

items.title: Al Haramain Opulent Saffron — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Opulent Saffron by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Designed to be worn by both women and men, Al Haramain Opulent Saffron is an oriental floral fragrance that was launched by Al Haramain in 2019. The opening layer is bright and floral with ylang-ylang, bergamot and cherry blossom top notes. Rose and heliotrope notes carry the floral element into the heart of the fragrance where they are joined by amaretto and powdery notes.

items.title: Al Haramain Opulent Sapphire — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Opulent Sapphire by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Al Haramain in 2019, Al Haramain Opulent Sapphire is an aromatic fragrance that combines fresh, floral and fruity notes. Bright lemon and bergamot notes form the opening, complemented by myrtle and basil. A floral combination of rose and jasmine becomes prominent as the heart of the fragrance moves forward.

items.title: Franck Boclet Amber — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Amber by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: An oriental fragrance suitable for both men and women, Franck Boclet Amber was launched by Franck Boclet in 2014. Herbal top notes serve as the opening for the fragrance with oregano and bay leaf that are complemented by floral ylang-ylang. Earthy patchouli blends with jasmine in the heart of the composition, creating an inviting middle layer.

items.title: Xerjoff Red Hoba — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Red Hoba by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Suitable for both women and men, Xerjoff Red Hoba is a sweet oriental fragrance. It was designed by perfumer Chris Maurice and launched by Xerjoff in 2014. Bright notes of bergamot come together with spicy cardamom and cinnamon in the top layer.

items.title: Champs De Provence — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Champs De Provence by Eight & Bob Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Bright and floral, Champs De Provence is a great daily fragrance during the spring and summer months. It was launched by Eight & Bob in 2017 and is suitable for both women and men. Sweet and fruity top notes of orange, bergamot and pear serve as a refreshing introduction to the fragrance.

items.title: Terrasse a St Germain — Extrait de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Terrasse a St Germain by Jul Et Mad Paris Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Modern with a hint of traditional sophistication, Terrasse a St Germain by Jul Et Mad Paris is a harmonious perfume that lifts the spirits yet leaves a calming effect. Launched in 2012, this vibrant scent opens with the fruity and tarty notes of grapefruit, rhubarb and tangerine. Sweet and citrusy, it slowly blends with the subtle and soft aromas of freesia, lotus flower and blue rose.

items.title: Memoires de Mustique — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Memoires de Mustique  by Eight & Bob Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A spritz of Memoires de Mustique by Eight & Bob whisks one away to a summer adventure relaxing and enjoying life by the crystal-clear waters of a Caribbean island. Launched in 2016, its aroma conjures images of gentle breezes, glorious sunsets and tranquility. A fresh opening of bergamot and neroli invigorates the spirit as it gently ushers in the sweet and mesmerizing scents of jasmine, orange blossom and Osmanthus.

items.title: Woody Mood — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Woody Mood by Olfactive Studio Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: French perfume house Olfactive Studio released Woody Mood in 2017. Like its name implies, this women's fragrance is exotic, earthy, green, spicy, and incredibly complex. The top notes of bergamot, ginger, clary sage, and saffron draw inspiration from faraway lands and flavors, as does the heart, with its notes of black tea, incense, sequoia, and nard Himalayan.

items.title: Xerjoff Oud Stars Gao — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Oud Stars Gao by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: A compelling unisex fragrance inspired by the traditional Arabic perfumes, Xerjoff Oud Stars Gao is a heady Oriental Woody scent that commands attention. The fragrance combines the notes of oud, amber, ssaffron, patchouli, Cypriol oil, juniper, resins, and Gurjan balsam. This scent has amazing longevity.

items.title: Oud Stars Zafar — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Oud Stars Zafar by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Give your day a new blend of exotic richness with Oud Stars Zafar. This fresh woody and spicy fragrance opens with a leading note of oud that continues throughout the layers. Crisp green apple and black pepper steal the show in the top notes until the floral richness of rose and neroli pop in along the heart.

items.title: Santal Basmati — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Santal Basmati by Affinessence Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Simple yet complex, Santal Basmati by Affinessence, launched in 2015, is a unique fragrance that gently envelopes the wearer in a subtle and desirable aroma that lingers. A blend of milky notes with surprisingly fragrant basmati rice turns this perfume into a one-of-kind. Nutty and enchanting, the rice blends well with the rare and complementary Mysore sandalwood.

items.title: Franck Boclet Cafe — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Cafe by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Find the woody-spicy-floral blend you've been missing with Franck Boclet Cafe, a unisex fragrance introduced in 2019. From French men's designer Franck Boclet, this scent is unexpectedly complex, yet it wears simply for an exotic aroma perfect for the nighttime. The top notes open with coffee, bergamot, and lemon for an interesting introduction.

items.title: Franck Boclet Cashmere — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Cashmere by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Franck Boclet Cashmere is a perfect fragrance for warming up a cold winter or autumn evening. This spicy perfume can be worn by both women and men and was launched by Franck Boclet in 2017. Bright grapefruit and pink pepper top notes pull you in before allowing heart notes of cinnamon, cloves and leather to take over.

items.title: Franck Boclet Flowers — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Flowers by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: As its name suggests, Franck Boclet Flowers is a predominantly floral fragrance that is suitable for both women and men. It was designed by perfumer Bruno Herve and launched by Franck Boclet in 2018. The perfume opens with a refreshing and energizing combination of lime, bergamot and basil top notes.

items.title: Xerjoff Ouverture — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Ouverture by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: An oriental floral fragrance designed by perfumer Chris Maurice, Xerjoff Ouverture was launched by Xerjoff in 2019. It is a great daily perfume for the winter and autumn months and can be worn by both women and men. Fresh notes of orange, fig leaf and magnolia are first apparent before making way for heart notes of Bulgarian rose, Indian jasmine, ylang-ylang and cinnamon.

items.title: Lucepura — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lucepura by Accendis Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: For a bold but balanced fragrance, turn to Italian perfume house Accendis, which launched Lucepura in 2017. This unisex scent is unpredictable and dark, but also playful with its blend of masculine and feminine aromas. It opens with top notes of Sicilian lemon, lavender, and juicy watermelon.

items.title: Fiorialux — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Fiorialux by Accendis Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fiorialux, launched in 2018 by Accendis, is a sweet fragrance for women. Top notes of lemon, bergamot, grapefruit, apricot and aromatic wormwood open this perfume with a bright, citrusy crispness that is fruity and delicate. The heart notes of iris, marigold, osmanthus and suede add a floral and powdery sweetness that caresses the skin and gently lingers.

items.title: Cedre Iris — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cedre Iris by Affinessence Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Naturally intoxicating, Cedre Iris by Affinessence boldly has three cedarwood aromas at its heart, giving this perfume a unique and complex aura. Hints of spice, leather, smoke and balsam linger within its layers that are lightly powdered down with fresh iris. Hints of aromatic and warm myrrh and spicy benzoin begin to make their presence known, adding a seductiveness that few can resist.

items.title: Aclus — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Aclus by Accendis Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A unique blend of masculine and feminine notes is the hallmark of Aclus, which was introduced by Italian perfumier Accendis in 2015. The unisex fragrance goes off the beaten path for its unconventional formula, creating something one-of-a-kind to add to your scent collection. This fragrance begins innocently with top notes of bergamot and lemon.

items.title: Accendis 0.1 — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Accendis 0.1 by Accendis Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Accendis 0.1 is a floral and woody fragrance launched by Accendis in 2015 that can be worn by both women and men. It was designed by perfumer Celine Ripert.

items.title: Cor Gentile V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cor Gentile V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Like being basked in gentle caresses, Cor Gentile V by Canto exudes a lingering sense of love, grace and sweetness. Released in 2015, this perfume immediately arouses the senses with lively yet calming opening of black pepper, musk, juniper berries and myrrh. A bouquet of floral further delights as hints of camellia, rose, lily and carnation begin to take hold.

items.title: Accendis 0.2 — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Accendis 0.2 by Accendis Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Accendis in 2015, Accendis 0.2 is a woody fragrance that works well during the cooler months of the year. It was designed by perfumer Celine Ripert and can be worn by both women and men.

items.title: Franck Boclet Violet — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Violet by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Women with a zest for life who are aren’t afraid to unleash their spicy side can complement their tenacious spirit with Franck Boclet Violet by Franck Boclet. Released in 2016, this perfume has subtle masculine undertones that further fuels its irresistible aroma. A fresh and lively opening of black pepper, pink pepper, nutmeg, cardamom and citrus notes tingle and delight as they slowly meld with aromatic violet.

items.title: Franck Boclet Jasmin — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Jasmin by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Franck Boclet Jasmin is a floral fragrance that can be worn by women and men alike. Geranium is featured in the opening of the perfume, along with spicy notes of pink pepper and coriander. The floral element grows in the heart of the composition which is formed by a delicate blend of violet, jasmine, ylang-ylang and rose notes.

items.title: Franck Boclet Vetiver — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Vetiver by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed for both women and men by perfumer Bruno Herve, Franck Boclet Vetiver was launched by Franck Boclet in 2018. A layer of citrus opens the fragrance with top notes of bright lemon, orange and bergamot. Floral notes of rose, orange blossom, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley come together in the heart.

items.title: Montale Leather Patchouli — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Leather Patchouli by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Montale in 2018, Montale Leather Patchouli is a dark and warm fragrance, perfect for cold winter and autumn days and nights. Patchouli, leather and agarwood top notes are softened by floral labdanum as the fragrance opens. A woody heart becomes more noticeable as the fragrance transitions and notes of sandalwood and cedar move forward.

items.title: Montale Sensual Instinct — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Sensual Instinct by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A great perfume for an evening out, Montale Sensual Instinct is an oriental vanilla fragrance that was launched by Montale in 2019. It is suitable for use by both women and men. A single note of roasted coffee beans makes up the top layer, warm and inviting.

items.title: Montale Bengal Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Bengal Oud by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Bengal Oud was launched by Montale in 2019 and is suitable for both women and men. Bright and energizing citrus notes of bitter orange and bergamot are complemented by agarwood as the fragrance opens. A bouquet of Egyptian jasmine, iris and Bulgarian rose form a predominantly floral heart with patchouli and leather adding a hint of darkness.

items.title: Montale Arabians Tonka — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Arabians Tonka by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Arabians Tonka is a dark and seductive fragrance for women. Top notes of saffron and citrusy bergamot open the scent with a sweetness and slight spicy accord that is adventurous. The heart notes of agarwood and Bulgarian rose add a balsamic, woodsy oud with an elegant floral tone.

items.title: Montale Vetiver Patchouli — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Vetiver Patchouli by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Montale Vetiver Patchouli is a versatile fragrance that is great for daily use throughout the year. It is a woody perfume launched by Montale in 2019 and can be worn by both women and men. The opening layer is sweet and spicy with top notes of carrot and pink pepper.

items.title: Irae V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Irae V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A great choice for both women and men, Irae V is an aromatic fragrance designed by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. It was launched by Canto in 2015 and is particularly suited for use during the cooler months. Sweet top notes of tonka bean, cacao pod and bergamot open the fragrance.

items.title: Ensis V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ensis V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Paolo Terenzi and launched by Canto in 2015, Ensis V is a green and floral fragrance that can be worn by both women and men. The top layer consists of fresh notes of bergamot, cassis and green leaves complemented by pansy notes. Florals continue into the heart with lilac, Bulgarian rose and lily-of-the-valley which are joined by sweet black currant.

items.title: Kashimire V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kashimire V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Canto in 2015, Kashimire V is a woody fragrance suitable for both women and men. It was designed by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. Dark and warm notes of copahu balm, amber and cashmere wood create an inviting opening to the fragrance.

items.title: Alibi V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Alibi V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Alibi V is a woody fragrance that was designed by perfumer Paolo Terenzi and is suitable for both women and men. It was launched by Canto in 2015. Cypress, mandarin orange, bergamot and salt combine in the top layer, giving the fragrance a fresh opening.

items.title: Franck Boclet Tonka — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Tonka by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Franck Boclet in 2015, Franck Boclet Tonka is a woody and spicy fragrance for men. Energizing top notes of lemon, ginger and fig leaf form the opening of the fragrance. Sweet and fruity notes persist into the heart of the composition with white peach, almond and cedar moving forward as the fragrance begins to transition.

items.title: Montale Pure Love — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Pure Love by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Suitable for both women and men, Montale Pure Love is a sensual oriental woody fragrance. It was launched by Montale in 2019 and is a great choice for the cooler months of the year. A single note of rose forms the opening layer of the fragrance, pulling you in with its beautiful floral scent.

items.title: Mastin V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mastin V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Paolo Terenzi, Mastin V is a woody fragrance suitable for both women and men. It was launched by Canto in 2015. The opening layer of the fragrance is both floral and spicy with notes of rose, saffron, cardamom and agarwood.

items.title: Mea Culpa V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mea Culpa V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Hints of outdoor adventures flicker throughout Mea Culpa V, lending a powerful freshness to this balsamic, woody fragrance. It opens with the simple smells of incense and sand before dipping into the powerful sensation of patchouli that fills the heart. Flickers of birch and cedar dance throughout the middle notes before giving way to benzoin, vanilla and musk in the base.

items.title: Xerjoff Wardasina — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Wardasina by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Italian perfume House Xerjoff introduced an enigmatic fragrance in 2019. Xerjoff Wardasina blends masculine and feminine elements for a unique fragrance that anyone can wear. The scent opens with herbal top notes for a fresh, green sensation.

items.title: Franck Boclet Musc — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Boclet Musc by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: An aromatic fragrance created for use by both women and men, Franck Boclet Musc was designed by perfumer Fabienne Bourcier and launched by Franck Boclet in 2016. The top layer of the perfume is warm and inviting, formed by notes of musk and various spices. The heart is soft and delicate with floral notes of iris and rose combined with creamy milk.

items.title: Chopard Rose Malaki — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Chopard Rose Malaki by Chopard Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2014, Chopard Rose Malaki by Chopard is a sensual, smoky perfume that tantalizes the senses with a blend of sweet and sultry florals and woody freshness. An intriguing opening of salty, syrupy yet earthy saffron and spicy cardamom tantalizes the senses and lays the foundation for a romantic and adventurous heart of rose absolute, rose petals and leather. Intense and irresistible, vanilla and patchouli gently begin to blossom, creating a smooth and warm finish that lingers.

items.title: Chopard Oud Malaki — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Chopard Oud Malaki by Chopard Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: A masculine fragrance designed by Dominique Ropion, Chopard Oud Malaki is dark and inviting, great for cool autumn and winter nights. It was launched by Chopard in 2012. The top layer is fruity and herbal with notes of grapefruit, artemisia and lavender.

items.title: Wisal Dhahab — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Wisal Dhahab by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Wisal Dhahab Perfume by Ajmal.  This fragrance was released in 2015.  It is a floral woodsy musky scent for women.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Lyncis — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Lyncis by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A dazzling chypre floral fragrance launched in 2019, Tiziana Terenzi Lyncis layers sparkling citrus and shimmering blooms over a smooth base rich with earthy and woody accords. Bright bergamot opens, accompanied by radiant citrus nuances of grapefruit and mandarin and just softened by hints of pink pepper. Embracing white iris blooms at the heart, merged with lush tones of orange blossom, jasmine and rose.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Adhil — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Adhil by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A breezy, uplifting green floral scent released in 2016, Tiziana Terenzi Adhil captures the breathless beauty of a beachside garden in springtime. The scent opens with crisp and vibrant tones of green grass, black currant leaf and lovely anise. Delicately intoxicating jasmine and heliotrope bloom in the heart notes, brightened with aquatic nuances of ozone and fresh, piney hints of amyris.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Tyl — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Tyl by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released in 2016, Tiziana Terenzi Tyl is a woody floral scent that layers bright blooms and sparkling citrus over a sweet gourmand and musk base. The opening is effervescent with ozone, bergamot and lemon blended with lovely clean aromatic hints of lavender. Rose and jasmine bloom in profusion at the heart, merged with a warm, magnetic accord of golden amber.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Dubhe Assoluto — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Dubhe Assoluto by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2016, Tiziana Terenzi Dubhe Assoluto is an exotic and intricate scent for both men and women. From Italian perfumier Tiziana Terenzi, this fragrance brings spicy, woody, and floral elements together for an intriguing aromatic experience. The scent opens with top notes of saffron, rose, and geranium, while the heart notes present with white oud, cedar, vanilla, balsam, and currant buds.

items.title: Mancera Instant Crush — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Instant Crush by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Instant Crush perfume by Mancera.  This is a unsex fragrance released in 2019.  It is an oriental floral scent perfect for both men and women.

items.title: Mancera Amber Fever — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Amber Fever by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released in 2019, Mancera Amber Fever is a sensual and sweet, embracing vanilla oriental gourmand scent for cool-weather and evening wear. The opening is a boozy effusion of whiskey and caramel fused with roasted hazelnut and tonka bean. Powdery, earthy florals emerge in the heart notes, mingling heady Indian jasmine and rose petals with soft violet.

items.title: Banana Republic 06 Black Platinum — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic 06 Black Platinum by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: O6 Black Platinum Perfume was created by the house of Banana Republic with perfumer Gino Percontino and released in 2017.  This is a unisex fragrance that is terrific for men and women to wear.  A spicy floral with a bit of citrus to keep it lively.

items.title: Banana Republic Neroli Woods — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Neroli Woods by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Neroli Woods Perfume by Banana Republic.  This unisex fragrance was released in 2018.  It is a magical aromatic citrus scent with a fabulous floral heart.

items.title: Banana Republic Classic Green — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Classic Green by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created by Banana Republic, Banana Republic Classic Green is a perfume that lives up to its name. Staying away from the old clichés, this fragrance is feminine and fresh. The top notes open with a mix of herbs and florals: citrusy, crushed-leaves-liked petitgrain; piney, fizzy ginger; and spicy, aromatic basil.

items.title: Banana Republic Classic Citrus — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Classic Citrus by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Banana Republic Classic Citrus by Banana Republic is the perfect accessory for summer. The perfume opens with the black currant-like, bitter scent of grapefruit and juicy, sweet clementine. For the middle notes, you can be transported to a tranquil garden with pollen-laden, honey-like honeysuckle.

items.title: Banana Republic Classic Acqua — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Classic Acqua by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4.2 oz for Women
items.description_en: Banana Republic Classic Acqua by Banana Republic is perfume that whisks you away on a high seas adventure with just one spritz. The top notes start this oceanic experience with salty, aquatic marine notes that are sure to remind you of the beach. The scent then moves into rosy, waxy, lemony pink pepper and piney, citrusy grapefruit.

items.title: Banana Republic Classic Red — Eau de Parfum en spray 125 ml (4.2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Classic Red by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4.2 oz for Men
items.description_en: Banana Republic Classic Red by Banana Republic is a colorful twist on an old classic. The top notes of this cologne are sure to please citrus fans with juicy, sweet clementine; tart, bitter and slightly spicy bergamot; and black currant-like grapefruit. Earthy, green herbs; richly sweet syringa; and honey-like, pollen-laden honeysuckle make up the delightfully floral middle notes while the base notes are comprised of a single fragrance: rubbery, tobacco-like guaiac wood.

items.title: Banana Republic 83 Leather Reserve — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic 83 Leather Reserve by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Designed by Vincent Kuczinski, Banana Republick 83 Leather Reserve is a simply sophisticated woody aromatic scent enhanced by citrus, spice and soft suede. The opening sparkles with crisp, elegant accords of bergamot, lemon zest and aromatic cypress. Lovely, sheer neroli merges with clean, serene cedar at the heart.

items.title: Banana Republic 17 Oud Mosaic — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic 17 Oud Mosaic by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Rich oud and warm spice merge beautifully with fresh flowers and magnetic amber in the simply sophisticated Banana Republic 17 Oud Mosaic, first released in 2017. The scent opens with a mellow fruity and spicy effusion of ripe plume harmonized with hints of green cardamom and white pepper. Light, luminous Turkish rose blooms at the heart, supported by soft, resinous undertones of labdanum and saffron.

items.title: Banana Republic Cypress Cedar — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Cypress Cedar by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: A deliciously fresh woody spicy fragrance that’s perfect for all-season wear, Banana Republic Cypress Cedar mingles elements of sparkling citrus with undertones of aromatic wood and musk. The scent opens with a brisk, crisp effusion of crushed mint leaf, bitter orange and pink pepper. Lovely aromatic cedar emerges at the heart, supported by warm hints of black pepper and tart-sweet rhubarb nuances.

items.title: Banana Republic Linen Vetiver — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Linen Vetiver by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: First launched in 2018, Banana Republic Linen Vetiver is an uplifting spring and summer scent that fuses soft woody aromatic accords with fresh, powdery florals and bright citrus. The scent opens with a sparkling embrace of Italian bergamot mingled with spice nuances of cardamom and lovely, citrusy-green petitgrain. Shimmering iris blooms at the heart, fused with alluring tones of hyacinth and water jasmine.

items.title: Montale Ristretto Intense Cafe — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Montale Ristretto Intense Cafe by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally launched in 2019, Montale Ristretto Intense Cafe is a decadently rich gourmand that’s cozy yet alluring. The scent opens with a bold, fresh accord of Italian black coffee, freshly brewed and mingled with bright nuances of Turkish rose water. The scent sweetens as it settles, fusing blooms of French rose buds and undertones of warm wood with rich, dark-roasted coffee beans.

items.title: Safran Colognise — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Safran Colognise by Nishane Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Bringing exotic aromas together is Safran Colognise, a unisex fragrance launched in 2019. This citrusy, spicy scent is from Turkish perfume house Nishane, and it blends masculine and feminine to create a modern, memorable fragrance. The scent opens with top notes of passion fruit, pink grapefruit, and citron for a tart and fruity introduction.

items.title: The Persian Gold — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: The Persian Gold  by Attar Collection Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2017, The Persian Gold is slightly sweet and spicy. This unisex fragrance is part of the Attar Collection, a perfume house in the United Arab Emirates, and it brings the opulence of the Persian Empire to life through richly exotic aromas. The fragrance opens with floral notes of tea rose and powdery elements.

items.title: Blond Jasmine — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Blond Jasmine by Carolina Herrera Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Let the heady aroma of Blond Jasmine from Carolina Herrera whisk you away to somewhere a little more relaxing and exotic. Released in 2017, the women's perfume was launched as an addition to the fashion brand's Herrera Confidential Eaux de Toilette fragrance collection. Each scent is modeled after a different luxurious destination perfect for a discreet and opulent getaway.

items.title: Orange Affair — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Orange Affair by Carolina Herrera Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: From Us fashion designer Carolina Herrera comes a feminine scent that mimics a warm summer breeze through an orange grove. Released in 2017, Orange Affair is suitable for daytime wear as well as a casual evening out. The top notes of mandarin orange, and petitigrain lead the way to heart notes of almond and orange blossoms.

items.title: Shaman — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Shaman by Min New York Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Min New York, an American luxury fragrance and grooming brand, launched its Scent Stories Collection in 2014, one of which is Shaman. This women's fragrance is an aromatic air of mystery, blending unique elements together for an enigmatic scent. It opens with top notes of cardamom, violet leaf, and mandarin.

items.title: Al Rayhan — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Rayhan by Attar Collection Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Al Rayhan by Attar Collection, launched in 2017, whisks the senses away to magical and tropical locale. Fresh air, fragrant blossoms and citrusy exotic fruits meld for a tantalizing and seductive aroma. It opens with a burst of oriental sweets, succulent white flowers and delectable mango.

items.title: Musk Kashmir — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Musk Kashmir by Attar Collection Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Like a second sheer layer of skin, Musk Kashmir, launched by Attar Collection in 2016, is a sophisticated perfume that brings the inner spirit to life. Sweet and spicy, it gently lingers to create an enticing aroma that is heavenly and irresistible. Its complex composition melds the seductive scents of white musk and sandalwood with the exotic and tingly auras of white pepper and cloves.

items.title: Pikovaya Dama — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Pikovaya Dama by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by Xerjoff in 2015, Pikovaya Dama is a sophisticated and beautifully blended powdery floral oriental scent with a retro yet contemporary feel. The opening is a fresh, clean effusion of Sicilian lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Bulgarian rose mingled with airy aldehydic notes. Earthy, enveloping Turkish iris blooms at the heart, spiced with coriander and nutmeg and wreathed in cedar incense.

items.title: Pikovaya Dama — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Pikovaya Dama by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by Xerjoff in 2015, Pikovaya Dama is a sophisticated and beautifully blended powdery floral oriental scent with a retro yet contemporary feel. The opening is a fresh, clean effusion of Sicilian lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Bulgarian rose mingled with airy aldehydic notes. Earthy, enveloping Turkish iris blooms at the heart, spiced with coriander and nutmeg and wreathed in cedar incense.

items.title: Spice Must Flow — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Spice Must Flow by Etat Libre d'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Take an olfactory trip along the Silk Road through this exotic unisex fragrance, Spice Must Flow. It was released in 2019 from French perfume house Etat Libre d'Orange, and it takes old world elements and puts a modern spin on them for a one-of-a-kind scent. The introduction features top notes of cardamom, cinnamon, and pepper, which reveals heart notes of ginger and Turkish rose.

items.title: 500 Years — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 500 Years by Etat Libre d'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: In 2019, Parisian perfume house Etat Libre d'Orange introduced a spicy-floral-woodsy scent for women and men. 500 Years, this bold, exotic unisex fragrance, brings together elements to create an air of mystery and richness reminiscent of worldly empires from long ago. The top note of bergamot blends into the flavorful heart notes of cacao, cardamom, saffron, and Turkish rose.

items.title: Bronze Tonka — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Bronze Tonka by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Bronze Tonka is a bold and masculine fragrance for men. Top notes of agarwood, coffee and cypriol oil open this exotic scent with a spicy, slightly smoky warmth that radiates off the skin. The middle note of rich leather combines with fragrant jasmine for an aromatic aroma with a white floral touch.

items.title: Platinum Leather — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Platinum Leather by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Platinum Leather meshes masculine and feminine elements for a modern, luxurious fragrance, Platinum Leather. This unisex scent is from Us fashion house, Carolina Herrera, and it can be worn for daytime events or special evenings. It opens with top notes of spicy pink pepper, and cypriol essential oil.

items.title: Sandal Ruby — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sandal Ruby by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Awake your senses and transport yourself to an exotic paradise with Sandal Ruby from Carolina Herrera. Released in 2019, the alluring perfume for women is a floral sensation that is softly touched by hints of oriental aromas. The top of the scent delivers the spice with notes of black pepper and the warm and fragrant appeal of cinnamon.

items.title: Forever Now — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Forever Now by Min New York Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Forever Now, launched by Min New York in 2015, is an aromatic perfume for women. Top notes of pink pepper, coriander, aldehydes and geranium open this balsamic scent with a bold and warm spiciness. At the heart, cedar and fragrant incense impart a rich, woodsy smokiness.

items.title: She Was an Anomaly — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: She Was an Anomaly by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Authentic, distinct and always perplexing, She Was an Anomaly by Etat Libre D'orange, released in 2019, is a perfume that embodies the complex woman forging her own path. Sometimes mysterious and sometimes familiar, this scent exudes an energetic aura that adds to the allure of the essence of femininity. Although composed of seemingly subtle and simple notes, they meld in an unforgettable way that forever entices the senses.

items.title: She Was an Anomaly — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: She Was an Anomaly by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: Authentic, distinct and always perplexing, She Was an Anomaly by Etat Libre D'orange, released in 2019, is a perfume that embodies the complex woman forging her own path. Sometimes mysterious and sometimes familiar, this scent exudes an energetic aura that adds to the allure of the essence of femininity. Although composed of seemingly subtle and simple notes, they meld in an unforgettable way that forever entices the senses.

items.title: Nightfall Patchouli — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Nightfall Patchouli by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: American designer Carolina Herrera created Nightfall Patchouli, a fragrance suitable for men and women, thanks to the blend of light and dark elements. Introduced in 2015, this scent leaves a lasting impression. The top note of bergamot makes for a classic introduction before bringing in the heart notes of cinnamon, clove, Bulgarian rose, and iris for a spicy-floral middle.

items.title: Cafe Chantant — Extrait de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cafe Chantant  by Nobile 1942 Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: First introduced in 2013, Cafe Chantant by Nobile 1942 is an alluring chypre gourmand fragrance that mingles elements of powdery florals, mellow fruits, vanilla and sweet balsam. The scent opens with fruity and spicy accords of bright cherry harmonized with star anise and green hints of laurel leaf. Hazy heliotrope and shimmering iris bloom at the heart.

items.title: Cruz Del Sur I — Extrait de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cruz Del Sur I by Xerjoff Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: First launched by Italian label Xerjoff in 2017, Cruz Del Sur I combines elements of soft leather, fruit, warm wood, spice and smoky balsam. The scent opens with a bright yet balanced blend of bergamot and crushed grapes spiked with sweet hints of rum and dried fruits. Spice and woods dominate the heart, merging cedar and sandalwood with nuances of cinnamon, cumin and clove.

items.title: Amber Desire — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Amber Desire by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Amber Desire was created to be the perfect amber fragrance. It opens with touches of spice in the top notes, including cinnamon and coriander and fills out the heart notes with sweetness and floral blossoms, such as rose and ylang-ylang with a nutty scent of dates. The base is simple labdanum and vanilla that usher in amber as the central performer in all its glory.

items.title: Commandante — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Commandante by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: An aromatic fruity fragrance for women, Commandante is very long-lasting with an enormous sillage. Part of the 10-fragrance Club Collection, it represents the club of fine cigar lovers. This aromatic blend features cedar, honey, labdanum, leather, patchouli, tobacco, vanilla, and spicy, floral and fruity notes.

items.title: Ambra Nobile — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ambra Nobile by Nobile 1942 Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Warm amber and balsam merge with lovely elements of aromatic spice and precious wood in Ambra Nobile, an alluring modern oriental scent first released by Nobile 1942 in 2010. Magnetic amber and lovely, bright bergamot open, wreathed in lush floral tones of African orange blossom. Green nuances of galbanum, embracing labdanum and earthy-sweet patchouli emerge at the heart.

items.title: Old School Bench — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Old School Bench by Min New York Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2014, Old School Bench is part of the exclusive Scent Stories Collection from American perfume house MiN New York. This unique scent brings together dark and fresh elements for an aromatic trip down memory lane. The top notes of lemon, bergamot, and angelica root make a clean introduction.

items.title: Il Sentiero Degli Dei — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Il Sentiero Degli Dei by Nobile 1942 Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally launched by Nobile 1942 in 2018, Il Sentiero Degli Dei is an entrancing floral and herbal aromatic scent brightened by tart-sweet citrus and precious wood. Sparkling lemon and blended fruits open the scent, harmonized with fresh nuances of green foliage. Heart notes are lush and floral, merging shimmering earthy iris and jasmine with lovely rose and luxuriant African orange blossom.

items.title: In the Mood for Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: In the Mood for Oud by Juliette Has a Gun Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Who isn't In the Mood for Oud? French fragrance brand Juliette Has a Gun launched this endearing perfume in 2019. Its lone top note of crisp bergamot descends into its sweet and spicy lingering heart of oud, papyrus, raspberry and saffron.

items.title: BDK Tubereuse Imperiale — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: BDK Tubereuse Imperiale by BDK Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A velvety yet profoundly embracing floral woody scent first released in 2016, Bdk Tubereuse Imperiale by Bdk Parfums combines shimmering, sensual white and yellow florals with powdery woods, balsam and smoke. The scent opens bright and fresh, merging fireweed and geranium with earthy, ethereal iris. Heart notes are redolent with seductive florals: a heady fusion of tuberose, ylang ylang and Egyptian jasmine sambac.

items.title: Bouquet De Hongrie — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Bouquet De Hongrie by BDK Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fruity sweet and sparkling, Bouquet De Hongrie by the French fragrance house Bdk Parfums layers the tart and tantalizing over serene florals, warm wood and enveloping musk. Opening tones are a crisp and juicy blend of ripest strawberry, crisp pear and lovely green cassis. Fresh, clean Turkish rose and shimmering jasmine bloom at the heart, followed by a sensual and tranquil, feminine finish of cedar, musk and alluring amber.

items.title: Roja Elixir — Extrait de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Roja Elixir by Roja Parfums Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: A gorgeous oriental floral perfume released in 2019, Roja Elixir opens with a lone note of bergamot. This clean, crisp introduction leads you into the sumptuous fruity-floral heart notes of geranium, heliotrope, jasmine, lily of the valley, peach, raspberry, rose de Mai, violet and ylang-ylang. These rich, rounded scents soon settle into the sweet, spicy and creamy base notes of ambrette, Cashmere wood, cedar, cinnamon, musk, orris, vanilla, violet leaf and sandalwood.

items.title: Cafe Chantant Exceptional Edition — Extrait de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cafe Chantant Exceptional Edition by Nobile 1942 Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Cafe Chantant Exceptional Edition by Nobile 1942 captures the spirit of unconventional women who don’t mind being a showstopper. Released in 2015, this innovative perfume features complex and unique notes that come together to create something new, intriguing and utterly irresistible. The first spritz unleashes the delicious and juicy sweetness of black cherry and laurel with the distinctive aroma of aniseed.

items.title: Dr Teal's Gentle Exfoliant With Pure Epson Salt — Aceite de perfume 177 ml (6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Dr Teal's Gentle Exfoliant With Pure Epson Salt by Dr Teal's Gentle Exfoliant with Pure Epsom Salt Softening Remedy with Aloe & Coconut Oil (Unisex) 6 oz for Women
items.description_en: The secret to petal-soft skin is Dr Teal's Gentle Exfoliant With Pure Epson Salt. Formulated with coconut oil and aloe vera, this exfoliant strips away dead skin cells while nourishing skin to leave it softer and smoother. It is gentle enough for daily use on all skin types and, in true Dr Teal's fashion, helps you relax after soaking away the stress of the day.

items.title: Lunar Vetiver — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lunar Vetiver  by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed by perfumer Jerome Di Marino to evoke images of a warm sunset, Lunar Vetiver was launched by Amouroud in 2018. A bright and spicy layer of bergamot, pink peppercorn and pimento forms the opening of the fragrance. The heart is sweet and floral with notes of cactus flower, sage and vanilla.

items.title: White Hinoki — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: White Hinoki by Amouroud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by the Japanese tree, White Hinoki was launched by Amouroud in 2018. It was designed by perfumer Angelique Nadau and can be worn by both women and men. Blood orange provides a bright opening that is warmed by spicy ginger and white pepper top notes.

items.title: Molecule 05 — Eau de Toilette en spray 104 ml (3.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Molecule 05 by Escentric Molecules Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: The aptly named Molecule 05 features the lone ingredient of the molecule Cashmeran. German fragrance house Escentric Molecules launched the scent in 2020. The brand 'celebrates perfumery as the art of chemistry' and pays tribute to the complicated character of Cashmeran with this intriguing fragrance.

items.title: This Is Not A Blue Bottle 1.3 — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: This Is Not A Blue Bottle 1.3 by Histoires De Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Debuting in 2017, This Is Not a Blue Bottle 1.3 is a unisex leather fragrance enhanced by floral, incense, citrus and spicy accords. Crafted by Julien Rasquinet for Histoires De Parfums, this scent features a single opening note of tart, sweet and juicy blood orange.

items.title: Banana Republic Dark Cherry & Amber — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Dark Cherry & Amber by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Add some sparkle to your day with the bright and fruity scent of Banana Republic Dark Cherry & Amber perfume for women. Banana Republic released this fragrance in 2019. It opens with top notes of pink freesia and sour cherry before drying down to a heart of praline and cherry blossom.

items.title: Banana Republic Gardenia & Cardamom — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Gardenia & Cardamom by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2019, Banana Republic Gardenia & Cardamom is a modern fragrance composed of classic scent profiles that's sure to stand the test of time with its inviting simplicity. Sweet flowers and rich spice combine to form the alluring aroma of the unisex fragrance from the fashion brand of Banana Republic. The top notes of the fragrance are comprised of juicy mandarin orange and intoxicating gardenia.

items.title: Banana Republic Tobacco & Tonka Bean — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Tobacco & Tonka Bean by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Rich everyday luxuries are the name of the game when it comes to the scent profile featured in Banana Republic Tobacco & Tonka Bean. Launched in 2019, the unisex fragrance by Banana Republic combines elements from some of the richest and decadent fruits and other luxe fragrance profiles to create an aroma simple enough to become your daily signature scent while also conveying a sense of opulence. The scent gains a fresh start from top notes of lush anjou pear and fantastically sweet mirabelle plum.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Borea — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Borea by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A luminous fruity floral scent enhanced by gourmand nuances, Tiziana Terenzi Borea was first released by the niche Italian label in 2019. The opening is effusive and delicately lush, mingling accords of ripe plum and crisp pear with coconut and toasted almond. Luxuriant white flowers shimmer in the heart notes, merging lovely jasmine and sensual tuberose with freesia and damask rose.

items.title: Gentle Fluidity Silver — Eau de Parfum en spray 200 ml (6.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Gentle Fluidity Silver by Maison Francis Kurkdjian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 6.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: An aromatic spicy fragrance for women and men, Gentle Fluidity Silver weaves its woody, musky and powdery magic around you. Designed to offer distinct silhouettes for him and for her, the long-lasting scent with its moderate sillage features the following ingredients: amber, coriander, juniper berries, musk, nutmeg, vanilla and assorted woods. These warm, spicy and comforting ingredients create an aromatic finish of natural sophistication and attraction.

items.title: Mirabile — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mirabile by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Beautifully creamy yet unexpectedly fresh, Mirabile V is a sweet aromatic gourmand that suits cool-weather wear. The opening is an embracing, inviting effusion of vanilla pod, malt and sweetly balsamic opoponax. A boozy yet bright accord of rum emerges at the heart, merged with lovely rose absolute, milk and aromatic tones of Bourbon geranium, lavender and buchu oil.

items.title: Lucrethia V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lucrethia V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by luxe label Canto V in 2016, Lucrethia V is an embracing, warm white floral enhanced by sweet spice and vanilla. The scent opens with light, uplifting tones of linden blossom and pear mingled with pink pepper, petitgrain and laurel leaf. Heady, enveloping jasmine encircles the heart, beautifully harmonized with accords of coffee, cocoa, amber and clove.

items.title: Mandragola V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mandragola V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally introduced by V Canto in 2016, Mandragola V is an entrancing woody and floral oriental scent enhanced by citrus and aromatic spice. The opening is a captivating effusion of absinthe infused with lime, bergamot and saffron. Heart notes bloom with Bulgarian rose and jasmine: heady florals intermingled with subtly animalic musk, guaiac wood and soft petitgrain.

items.title: Stricnina V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Stricnina V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fruity sweet, tropical and fresh, Stricnina V by niche Italian design house V Canto was first introduced in 2017. The opening is a bright cocktail of passionfruit and blackcurrant mingled with citrusy nuances of bergamot and lemon. Lush ylang ylang and magnolia absolute bloom at the heart, harmonized with honeyed raspberry, creamy-green fig leaf and Ceylon cinnamon.

items.title: Stramonio V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Stramonio V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Serene florals, warm spice and precious wood are beautifully intermingled in Stramonio V, a woody and subtly animalic scent that allures and entrances. The opening is a fresh floral effusion of carnation, shimmering orchid and jasmine blossom mingled with intimate hints of soft saffron. Mesmerizing musk rose blooms next, harmonized with undertones of vanilla bean and ambergris.

items.title: Arsenico V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Arsenico V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A fresh and serene scent for any season, Arsenico V is an airy woody green fragrance enhanced by fruit, florals and musk. Lovely Calabrian bergamot opens the scent, mingled with bright tones of apple, red currant and tart-sweet, tantalizing pineapple. Sensual jasmine blooms delicately at the heart, accompanied by earthy-sweet and woody accords of red patchouli, birch, tonka bean and Lebanon cedar.

items.title: Cianuro V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cianuro V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally launched in 2018 by luxe Italian design house Canto, Cianuro V is a fruity chypre scent that’s sweetly seductive. Paradise fruits open, fusing fragrant passion fruit, papaya and mango with bright hints of pineapple and lovely neroli. Subtly aqueous, shimmering florals embrace the heart, a sensual yet serene garden of narcissus, lily, lotus and damask rose.

items.title: Curaro V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Curaro V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Originally introduced in 2018 by Italian label V Canto, Curaro V is a woody oriental fragrance that mingles shimmering florals, rich oud, caramel and sweet spice. Powdery, delicately earthy floral accords open, intermingling jasmine, lush magnolia and iris with embracing patchouli and rose absolute. Deeper tones of Cambodian and Indian oud emerge at the heart alongside vetiver, tonka bean, sandalwood and cinnamon.

items.title: Sigismondo V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sigismondo V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: First introduced by Paolo Terenzi’s niche label V Canto in 2020, Sigismondo V is a deeply satisfying spicy oriental fragrance that uplifts and embraces. Soft accords of Italian saffron and Ceylon cinnamon open the scent with graceful effusion. Heart notes are rich and enveloping, merging Bulgarian rose and cypriol oil with earthy-sweet red patchouli and smooth Cambodian oud.

items.title: Isotta V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Isotta V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by luxe label Canto in 2020, Isotta V is a sensual yet sophisticated fragrance that layers bright citrus and green nuances over a smooth woody leather base. The opening notes are a sparkling blend of Italian lemon and grapefruit harmonized with nuances of shiso leaf and eucalyptus. The heart is floral and aromatic, merging embracing Bulgarian rose and jasmine absolute with piquant hints of African geranium.

items.title: Pandolfo V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Pandolfo V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A serene yet fresh, embracing woody floral oriental fragrance, Pandolfo V was first launched by niche designer V Canto in 2020. Opening notes are a floral and herbal balsamic effusion of musk rose mingled with smooth, enveloping Moroccan lentisque and green, piquant nuances of crisp Greek sage. Warm aromatic woods encircle the heart, blending rich, sensual Indian oud and gurjum balsam with spiced sandalwood and earthy cypriol oil.

items.title: Fili V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Fili V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fili V is a woody citrus fragrance enhanced by accords of spice, leather and alluring amber. The fragrance begins tart-sweet and tantalizing with tones of grapefruit, bergamot and blackcurrant leaf. Heart notes become warmer, merging supple leather and cypriol oil with spice nuances of cinnamon and cardamom.

items.title: Posi V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Posi V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: First introduced in 2019, Posi V is a bright and inviting chypre fragrance that intermingles accords of flowers, citrus and spiced wood. The opening is soft and uplifting, fusing rose and saffron with sparkling hints of lemon and bergamot. Lovely exotic ylang ylang and peppery geranium emerge next, wreathed in serene tones of cypriol oil and amber.

items.title: Psiche V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Psiche V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Shake things up with the unmistakable scent of Psiche V by Canto. Released in 2020, this fragrance is reminiscent of a sharp cocktail. It opens with the rich soothing scents of lavender and a hint of citrus.

items.title: Temptatio V — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Temptatio V by V Canto Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Powdery florals, bright fruit and soft wood are beautifully harmonized in Temptatio V, a quietly stunning composition first launched by V Canto in 2020. The opening is a luminous citrus floral expression of Italian lemon and mandarin merged with ylang ylang and Bulgarian rose. Fruits and flowers deepen and soften as the scent develops, mingling iris, jasmine and violet with spiced peach, passion fruit and just a hint of tangy black currant.

items.title: Kohl Al Ayoun — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kohl Al Ayoun by Sawalef Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: An enchanting blend of floral and fruity accords with a smoky undertone, Kohl Al Ayoun is a bright, intoxicating fragrance that is perfect for both casual and formal wear in the spring. It features a sweet, floral top note of iris mixed with juicy apple and black currant. Middle notes of sensual oud, romantic jasmine and delicate rose give the perfume a sweet anchor while base notes of amber, sandalwood and musk ground the fragrance with an earthy accord.

items.title: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Futura — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Futura by Acqua Di Parma Eau De Cologne Spray (unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2020, Acqua Di Parma Colonia Futura by Acqua Di Parma is an aromatic perfume with a rich, and lively opening that softens into sheer seduction. The first spritz is an intense and delectable blend of bergamot, grapefruit, lemon and pink pepper. The spicy and citrus aroma tapers as an intoxicating heart of clary sage and lavender take hold, emitting an earthy and floral composition that captures the attention of everyone around.

items.title: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Futura — Eau de Cologne en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Futura by Acqua Di Parma Eau De Cologne Spray (unisex) 1.7 oz for Women

items.title: White Rose No 1 — Aceite de perfume 95 ml (3.21 oz) unisex

items.description_en: Exude elegance and confidence with a spritz of White Rose No 1 by Swiss Arabian. This mesmerizing perfume blends an array of notes around a distinct and timeless heart of rose. The vivid and seductive aroma of rose starts the fragrance and is enhanced with aldehydes.

items.title: 4711 Acqua Colonia Lychee & White Mint — Eau de Cologne en spray 169 ml (5.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 4711 Acqua Colonia Lychee & White Mint by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (unisex) 5.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Juicy sweetness and rich greenery meet in an perfect dance with 4711 Acqua Colonia Lychee & White Mint. Although the notes are simple, lychee, mint and a touch of mossy undertones, the unique blend of these enthusiastic elements create a passionate fragrance that can't be forgotten. Coming from the classic 4711 brand, naturally the finest ingredients and most well-honed techniques are used to place each drop into the beautiful cut crystal bottle.

items.title: Chopard Amber Malaki — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Chopard Amber Malaki by Chopard Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Ideal for men and women, Chopard Amber Malaki s a complex unisex fragrance released in 2015. From Swiss luxury goods designer Chopard, this scent takes its inspiration from the designer's jewelry line. The top notes of incense and orange blossom create a bold introduction, while the heart notes of amber and papyrus wood give way to the richness of history.

items.title_en: Replica Coffee Break by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2019, Replica Coffee Break is a unisex fragrance inspired by the comfort you feel with a warm cup of coffee in your hand. From French perfume house Maison Margiela, this cozy scent opens with top notes of orange flower petals, earthy patchouli, and pepper essence for a spicy introduction. At the heart are notes of cypriol, tonka bean, and benzoin, which add depth.

items.title: Replica Sailing Day — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica Sailing Day by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Replica Sailing Days Perfume by Maison Margiela.  This unisex fragrance was released in 2017.  A memorable fresh aquatic scent that both men and women will enjoy wearing.

items.title: Kenneth Cole Intensity — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kenneth Cole Intensity by Kenneth Cole Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Kenneth Cole Intensity is well-named. This unisex fragrance is seductively spicy and alluring, making it a memorable scent for evenings and special occasions. The scent opens with top notes of spicy cardamom, pink pepper, and white leather.

items.title: Ana Assali — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ana Assali by Rihanah Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Ana Assali Cologne by Rihanah

items.title: Kenneth Cole Serenity — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kenneth Cole Serenity by Kenneth Cole Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: An oriental woody fragrance suitable for both men and women, Kenneth Cole Serenity was launched by Kenneth Cole in 2018. This fragrance is great for daily use throughout the year and opens with an intriguing blend of whiskey and white pepper top notes. A warm heart moves forward as the fragrance transitions, bringing middle notes of sandalwood and cashmere wood into focus.

items.title: Ajwaa Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Ajwaa Oud by Nusuk Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A woody fragrance from Rihanah, Ajwaa Oud is a unisex perfume that is suitable for both men and women. The fragrance is dark and earthy, making it a great choice for use during the cooler months of the year. Boswellia provides an herbal note that blends beautifully with woody oud.

items.title: Byredo Slow Dance — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Byredo Slow Dance by Byredo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: Byredo Slow Dance is a complex, intriguing women's fragrance that was introduced in 2019. From Swedish perfumier Byredo, this feminine scent features accords that evoke a romantic awakening, much like a slow dance itself. It opens with top notes of opopanax and cognac for a rich introduction.

items.title: Mancera Crazy for Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Mancera Crazy for Oud by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Mancera Crazy for Oud by Mancera, launched in 2019, is a lavish perfume that intoxicates the senses with an array of desire-inducing notes. Floral and powdery, it opens with the rich, vibrant and luxurious aroma of Laos oud melded with citrusy bergamot and seductive leather. The heart continues revving up the passion as Bulgarian rose, white magnolia, violet, tiramisu notes and patchouli are unleashed.

items.title: Floris A Rose For — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Floris A Rose For by Floris Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A contemporary smoky floral scent released in 2016, Floris A Rose For...

items.title: Sophie La Girafe Eau de Soin Parfumee — Fragancia 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sophie La Girafe Eau de Soin Parfumee by Sophie La Girafe Eau De Soin Parfumee (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The perfect fragrance for restful naps and wholesome adventures, Sophie La Girafe Eau de Soin Parfumee is made with natural ingredients safe for use around even the most delicate of little people. It opens with soft notes of peach, lemon and freesia. Light fruity and florals scents join in the heart along with ozone and heliotrope before a cozy base of vanilla, orange blossom, jasmine and musk take over for an ideal finish.

items.title: Banana Republic Grassland — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Grassland by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: A deliciously fresh and uplifting spicy green aromatic scent, Grassland fuses elements of tart-sweet citrus, aromatic herbs, peppery florals and clean woods. Top notes mingle fruity bergamot and crisp apple with sparkling pomelo fruit and hints of crushed mint leaf. Herbal tones of geranium and lavender emerge at the heart, accompanied by an energizing accord of ozone just softened by woody petitgrain.

items.title: Banana Republic Metal Rain — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Banana Republic Metal Rain by Banana Republic Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: A fresh and airy green aromatic scent launched by Banana Republic in 2020, Metal rain combines harmonizing elements of green herbs, bright fruit, aromatic woods and undertones of warm, animalic amber. Top notes are an energetic, effervescent effusion of tart-sweet lemon and black currant mingled with crisp green nuances of violet leaf and aromatic basil. Green tea, galbanum and clean, uplifting lavender merge with ozonic notes at the heart.

items.title: Baikal Leather Intense — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Baikal Leather Intense by Nicolai Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Warm and dark, Baikal Leather Intense is a great fragrance for cool autumn and winter days. It was launched by Nicolai in 2019 and can be worn by both men and women. The fragrance opens with a unique combination of yuzu, pepper and saffron top notes.

items.title: Cap Neroli — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cap Neroli by Nicolai Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by Nicolai in 2018, Cap Neroli is a floral perfume that is suitable for both women and men. As the fragrance opens, you are met with a fresh blend of citrus and herbal top notes. Mandarin orange, bergamot and orange mix with mint, rosemary and petitgrain.

items.title: Nicolai Incense Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Nicolai Incense Oud by Nicolai Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Nicolai Incense Oud is an oriental fragrance that can be worn by both women and men. It was launched by Nicolai in 2016. Artemisia and ambrette top notes form the opening layer of the perfume.

items.title: The Majestic Vanilla — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: The Majestic Vanilla by Alexandre J Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The Majestic Vanilla by Alexandre J is a sweet yet masculine perfume perfect for any woman who wants to exude bold confidence and is not afraid to be herself. Released in 2020, this Oriental fragrance instantly invigorates the senses with a fresh burst of cinnamon, mandarin orange and bergamot. The sweet and spicy mix soon welcomes a seductive heart of peach, galbanum and tonka bean.

items.title: The Majestic Amber — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: The Majestic Amber by Alexandre J Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2020, The Majestic Amber by Alexandre J is an intoxicating perfume reminiscent of the roaring 20s full of decadence, fun and style. Bold, feminine and sultry, it opens with a fresh burst of peach and grapefruit. The liveliness leads to a seductive heart of velvety rose and fruity and herbal davana.

items.title: The Majestic Vetiver — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: The Majestic Vetiver by Alexandre J Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Calm, soothing and inspiring, The Majestic Vetiver by Alexandre J is a delectable fragrance that brings to life a carefree day enjoying the sights and smells on the French Riviera. Designed to bring to life a time of creativity and romance, it opens with a mesmerizing blend of grapefruit, basil and cardamom. The freshness continues with a heart of sweet floral liatris and warm coriander.

items.title: Replica Jazz Club — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica Jazz Club by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Replica Jazz Club is a men's fragrance launched in 2013 by French fashion label Maison Margiela. This sophisticated scent opens with top notes of Primofiore lemon with rosy pink pepper and neroli oil, a citrus blossom with a creamy aroma. The heart blends the earthy tones of clary sage with rum absolute before adding Javanese vetiver’s dry, bitter and lightly smoky facets.

items.title: Replica Springtime In A Park — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica Springtime In A Park by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fresh and light like a garden breeze, Replica Springtime in a Park is aptly named. Introduced in 2019 by French perfumier Maison Margiela, this feminine fragrance is like a bouquet of flowers. The top notes of pear, bergamot, and black currant create a sweet introduction, while the heart notes of lily-of-the-valley, jasmine, and Turkish rose bloom into play.

items.title: Replica Under The Lemon Trees — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica Under The Lemon Trees by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2018, Replica Under the Lemon Trees is all about a simple aesthetic, from the minimalist bottle to the fresh fragrance inside. From French perfume house Maison Margiela, this bright scent is appropriate for both men and women. It opens with top notes of lemon, lime, petitgrain, and exotic cardamom.

items.title: Replica — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica By The Fireplace by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2015, Replica By the Fireplace is like a warm embrace, full of comforting, cozy elements. This unisex fragrance is from Maison Margiela, a perfume house based in Paris. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, orange blossom, and clove for a bright and bold beginning.

items.title: Trojan For All — Eau de Toilette en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Trojan For All by Trojan Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: A reliable scent perfect for adding intrigue to casual days out or sensual nights in, Trojan for All is a 2020 fragrance that anyone can feel comfortable wearing. It opens with zesty notes of orange, lemon and lime followed by the warm green tones of violet leaves, rosemary and geranium. The smoky base begins with a layer of tobacco and tucks in notes of sandalwood, amber and patchouli for ambiance.

items.title_en: Trojan For All by Trojan Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men

items.title: Xerjoff Accento — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Accento by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Xerjoff Accento by Xerjoff, released in 2011, complements the complexity of the modern world while incorporating aromas that harken back to simpler times. This unisex fragrance opens with a tantalizing burst of pineapple, hyacinth and citrus notes. The seductive zestiness continues with an enticing heart of iris, jasmine and pink pepper.

items.title: Xerjoff Accento — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Accento by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Xerjoff Accento by Xerjoff, released in 2011, complements the complexity of the modern world while incorporating aromas that harken back to simpler times. This unisex fragrance opens with a tantalizing burst of pineapple, hyacinth and citrus notes. The seductive zestiness continues with an enticing heart of iris, jasmine and pink pepper.

items.title: Xerjoff Accento Overdose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Accento Overdose by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Overdose on uplifting feelings of wonder, happiness and delight with Accento Overdose by Xerjoff. Released in 2019, this heady, airy perfume features lush floral elements and refreshing aldehyde nuances to brighten the spirit and lift moods. The scent embraces the best aromas and comfort nature can offer with top notes of aldehydes, fresh green accords and delectable fruity notes.

items.title: Xerjoff Comandante! — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Comandante! by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
