items.description_en: The first burst of Xerjoff Comandante! by Xerjoff creates a smoky, sultry aura that is irresistible. Launched in 2012, this perfume evokes a sense of exclusiveness that makes those around desire to be part of the club.

items.title: Shooting Stars Allende — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Shooting Stars Allende by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Created for Xerjoff by perfumer Chris Maurice, Shooting Stars Allende is a sweet and subtly spicy floral gourmand fragrance that beautifully mingles elements of ethereal Magnolia, rich yet refined vanilla and a hint of amber. The opening fuses a soft, citrusy effusion of shimmering magnolia petals with alluring Madagascar vanilla. The vanilla accord deepens as the scent warms, merging with rich cacao, amber and creamy nuances of coconut to leave a smooth, comforting trail.

items.title: Join the Club Fatal Charme — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Join the Club Fatal Charme by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Step into the world of exclusive circles and find exactly where you belong with Join the Club Fatal Charme from Xerjoff. Centering around glamourous fashion and easy elegance, this scent is one of 10 featured in the Join the Club perfume collection. Each offering provides an exclusive and mysterious scent profile dedicated to capturing the essence of different secret social circles and interests.

items.title: Shooting Stars Apollonia — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Shooting Stars Apollonia by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Dedicated to the 1969 moon landing of the Apollo 11 space shuttle, Shooting Stars Apollonia is a simple yet strikingly sophisticated powdery floral fragrance enhanced by elements of white flowers, earthy orris and sheer musk. The opening is an alluring and luminous effusion of ethereal white blossoms, followed closely by a lightly enveloping accord of earthy, powdery orris butter. The finish is a cashmere embrace of white musk that leaves a clean, elegant trail.

items.title: XJ 1861 Renaissance — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: XJ 1861 Renaissance by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: First released by niche label Xerjoff in 2011, Xj 1861 Renaissance is a green and fresh citrus aromatic fragrance. The opening is radiant and expressive, mingling tart-sweet tangerine, Calabrian bergamot and Amalfi lemon with soft woody nuances of petitgrain. Freshest rose and clean, enveloping lily of the valley emerge at the heart, harmonized with crisp, cool tones of crushed mint.

items.title: Join the Club Don — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Join the Club Don by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2013, Join the Club Don by Xerjoff is a unisex scent that is not for the faint of heart. Sultry, smoky and reminiscent of olden days in a tavern, it exudes excitement and a wildness that intoxicates the senses. As the scent unfolds, the senses are taken on a Wild West journey where the only thing that can be expected is the unexpected.

items.title: 17/17 Stone Label Richwood — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 17/17 Stone Label Richwood by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: 17/17 Stone Label Richwood is a woody fragrance that can be worn by both men and women. It was launched by Xerjoff in 2010. A blend of citrus forms the top layer of the composition with bright grapefruit, tangerine and bergamot notes.

items.title: Xj 1861 Zefiro — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xj 1861 Zefiro by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2015, Xj 1861 Zefiro is inspired by the passion and creativity of the Italian Renaissance. This spicy, exotic fragrance is from Italian luxury perfumier Xerjoff. It opens with top notes of elemi resin, white wine, bergamot, and artemisia.

items.title: Xerjoff Soprano — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Soprano by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Just as sweet as perfectly hitting the highest note, Xerjoff Soprano entrances with gourmand delights. The floral unisex fragrance from Xerjoff enjoys a cross with scrumptious fruits and exotic aromatic details. Released in 2019, the perfume produces a scent that is equal measures dreamy innocence and rich luxury.

items.title: Xerjoff Amabile — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Amabile by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by Xerjoff in 2020, Xerjoff Amabile is a warm and spicy woody aromatic scent enhanced by elements of fresh citrus, sheer florals and powdery musk. Opening notes are bright and breathless, a radiant blend of Amalfi lemon, Calabrian bergamot and tart-sweet green apple mingled with lush hints of orange blossom. Jasmine blooms heady at the heart, spiced with subtle nuances of cardamom and soft pink pepper.

items.title: Xerjoff Amabile — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Amabile by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: First released by Xerjoff in 2020, Xerjoff Amabile is a warm and spicy woody aromatic scent enhanced by elements of fresh citrus, sheer florals and powdery musk. Opening notes are bright and breathless, a radiant blend of Amalfi lemon, Calabrian bergamot and tart-sweet green apple mingled with lush hints of orange blossom. Jasmine blooms heady at the heart, spiced with subtle nuances of cardamom and soft pink pepper.

items.title: Shooting Stars Uden Overdose — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Shooting Stars Uden Overdose by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: With plenty of citrus and a touch of warm spice, Shooting Stars Uden Overdose stands up to any scrutiny. Since it's Xerjoff, you know it's made with the highest-quality ingredients including freshly-squeezed lemon and juicy bergamot in the opening notes. Crisp ginger and bright tobacco blossoms fill in the middle notes.

items.title: Shooting Stars Oesel — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Shooting Stars Oesel by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Shooting Stars Oesel is a serene and captivating floral oriental composition first released by niche label Xerjoff in 2010. The opening notes are a lush yet light, sparkling effusion of Amalfi lemon infused with fragrant African orange flower and woody nuances of petitgrain. At the heart blooms a heady white floral garden, rich and radiant with mingled tones of jasmine, rose and a sweet, hazy whisper of lovely mimosa.

items.title: Shooting Stars La Capitale — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Shooting Stars La Capitale by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Xerjoff in 2019, Shooting Stars La Capitale is a warm oriental fragrance. It was designed by perfumer Chris Maurice and can be worn by both men and women. Fruity notes of peach and strawberry open the fragrance, sweetened by caramel and softened by labdanum.

items.title: Join the Club Shunkoin — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Join the Club Shunkoin by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: If you've ever wanted to join a meditation club, Join the Club Shunkoin is just the right fragrance to prepare for olfactory mindfulness. This 2012 fragrance opens with powdery notes and a touch of cherry blossom. Flickers of tea leaves and olibanum tiptoe through the heart before the peaceful warmth of vanilla mixes with the orris and sandalwood of the base for a nearly supernatural experience.

items.title: Oud Stars Ceylon — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Oud Stars Ceylon by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed for both women and men by perfumer Chris Maurice, Oud Stars Ceylon is a woody and floral fragrance. It was launched by Xerjoff in 2017. The top layer of the perfume is bright and sweet, as Calabrian bergamot, honey and jasmine sambac pull you into the fragrance.

items.title: Coffee Break Golden Dallah — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Coffee Break Golden Dallah by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Coffee Break Golden Dallah is a unisex fragrance inspired by the aromatic and exotic world of international coffee trade. From Italian luxury perfume brand Xerjoff, this scent opens with top notes of fresh spices. The heart notes bring in elements of coffee, oud, rose, incense, and amber.

items.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille by Franck Olivier Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: French designer Franck Olivier released a men's fragrance with a modern feel that works for day or evening wear. Introduced in 2017, Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is strong and masculine. It opens with top notes of caramel, orange, and raspberry for a sweet beginning.

items.title: Poggia — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Poggia by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: A bright, fresh fragrance that can be worn by both women and men, Poggia was launched by Tiziana Terenzi in 2020. A gorgeous combination of fruits provides an energizing air in the top layer where peach, orange, lemon and bergamot blend together. Fruity notes make their way into the heart as well.

items.title: Cubia — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cubia by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2020, Cubia is an enigmatic fragrance full of contrasts, light and dark, masculine and feminine. This unisex scent is from Italian luxury perfumier Tiziana Terenzi. It opens with fruity top notes of bergamot, lemon, and orange.

items.title: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide — Extrait de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.38 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2020, Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide invites you to embrace the unexpected and dreamy as you relish in the pleasure of delectable fruits and lush florals. One-of-a-kind opulence is on full display beginning with the dazzling packaging complete with a gold-plated sea star sitting on top. The unisex perfume is featured in the Tiziana Terenzi Sea Stars collection and features scent notes of green-tinged tuberose, heady narcissus, zesty Calabrian bergamot, exotic passionfruit and romantic rose.

items.title: Kilian Rolling In Love — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kilian Rolling In Love by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: A simply scrumptious, sensual floral oriental gourmand, Rolling in Love by Kilian was first released in 2019. Opening notes are a creamy and intimate, alluring blend of almond milk and soft, delicately musky ambrette seed absolute. Carnal, seductive tuberose blooms at the heart, mingled with powdery orris and shimmering freesia.

items.title: 1888 Casamorati — Eau de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 1888 Casamorati by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: 1888 Casamorati is an oriental fragrance designed for both women and men. It was launched by Xerjoff in 2013. It's great for autumn and winter and transitions well from day to night.

items.title: Sillage Oros — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sillage Oros by Riiffs Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Sillage Oros, a long-lasting fragrance for men, opens with fruity-floral top notes of Amalfi lemon, neroli and raspberry. From the moment you apply it to your freshly shaved or washed skin, you'll revel in its freshness. The heart notes of African orange flower, gardenia and jasmine create a romantic effect, and the base notes of amber, honey and patchouli provide a sweet, resinous finish spiked with grassy hints.

items.title: Chopard Black Incense Malaki — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Chopard Black Incense Malaki by Chopard Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Deeply exotic, Chopard Black Incense Malaki was introduced in 2020. This unisex fragrance is from Swiss luxury goods designer Chopard, and it allows the wearer to create a raw sense of mystery. It opens with spicy top notes of cardamom, cinnamon, and French lavender before revealing the heart notes of frankincense swirled with smokey accords.

items.title: Not A Perfume Superdose — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Not A Perfume Superdose by Juliette Has A Gun Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Not A Perfume Superdose from Juliette Has A Gun is a single note fragrance featuring Cetalox, otherwise known as Ambroxan. This note was created years ago as a complement to other accords. Its main role is to enhance natural scents.

items.title: Xerjoff Erba Pura — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Erba Pura by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by luxe Italian label in 2019, Xerjoff Erba Pura is a fruity sweet citrus oriental fragrance enhanced by elements of powdery musk, vanilla and clean spice. The scent opens breathless and uplifting, mingling Calabrian bergamot with tart-sweet tones of Sicilian lemon and mandarin. Tantalizing citrus mellows to a blended fruit expression at the heart, followed by a sensual and serene finish of amber, irresistible Madagascar vanilla and shimmering white musk.

items.title: Xerjoff Erba Pura — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Erba Pura by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched by luxe Italian label in 2019, Xerjoff Erba Pura is a fruity sweet citrus oriental fragrance enhanced by elements of powdery musk, vanilla and clean spice. The scent opens breathless and uplifting, mingling Calabrian bergamot with tart-sweet tones of Sicilian lemon and mandarin. Tantalizing citrus mellows to a blended fruit expression at the heart, followed by a sensual and serene finish of amber, irresistible Madagascar vanilla and shimmering white musk.

items.title: Clive Christian Crab Apple Blossom — Fragancia en spray 50 ml (1.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clive Christian Crab Apple Blossom by Clive Christian Perfume Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
items.description_en: Introduced in 2020, Clive Christian Crab Apple Blossom is a unisex fragrance full of freshness and vitality. From British perfume house Clive Christian, this scent opens with top notes of bergamot, marine notes, and apple blossom for a breezy beginning. At the heart are notes of tart rhubarb and a minty, sugary hint of mojito.

items.title: EGE Ailaio — Extrait de Parfum 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: EGE Ailaio by Nishane Extrait de Parfum (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Turkish niche fragrance brand Nishane debuted Ege Ailaio in 2020. The aromatic, fresh spicy and green fragrance for men and women makes its introduction with anise, violet leaves and yuzu, a herbal-floral-citrus blend that captivates. The heart notes of basil, cardamom and mint further the herbal theme, contributing freshness and spiciness.

items.title: Nanshe — Extrait de Parfum 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Nanshe by Nishane Extrait de Parfum (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Nanshe is an oriental floral fragrance that can be worn by both women and men. It was launched by Nishane in 2020 and was designed by perfumer Cecile Zarokian. Fruit and spice come together in the opening layer formed by top notes of yuzu, bergamot, cardamom and carrot seeds.

items.title: Fiddah — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Fiddah by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Designed for both women and men by perfumer Christian Carbonnel, Fiddah was launched by Kajal in 2017. The fragrance begins with top notes of bergamot and anise balanced with additional fruit and flower notes. The top layer is followed by a warm, dark heart that features notes of leather and tobacco.

items.title: Lamar — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lamar by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Kajal in 2020, Lamar is an oriental floral fragrance for both men and women. Top notes of apple, pineapple and red berries form a bright opening that is warmed by spicy notes of coriander and cardamom. A floral heart provides a sweet softness with notes of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, magnolia and jasmine sambac.

items.title: Warek — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Warek by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Kajal in 2017, Warek is an oriental fragrance suited for use by both men and women. An aromatic and earthy combination of incense and saffron forms the top layer. Patchouli, guaiac wood and amber enhance the earthy element in the heart, softened by floral rose notes.

items.title: Sareef — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sareef by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Sareef is an aromatic fragrance from Kajal that was launched in 2017. It was designed by perfumer Christian Carbonnel and can be worn by both men and women. A fresh, bright combination of Calabrian bergamot and various flower notes forms the opening layer.

items.title: Alujain — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Alujain by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Featuring a single top note of rose that creates a soft and delicate opening layer, Alujain is an oriental woody fragrance perfect for both men and women. An earthy heart layer follows, pulling you in with dark notes of guaiac wood, vetiver and sandalwood. The fragrance becomes warmer as it continues to transition and base notes of agarwood, musk and vanilla become more prominent.

items.title: Sawlaj — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sawlaj by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A unisex fragrance from Kajal, Sawlaj was designed by perfumer Christian Carbonnel and launched in 2017. Delicate florals blend with earthy elements in this warm fragrance that opens with bergamot, lemon and labdanum top notes. The heart is a beautiful balance of leather and patchouli softened by notes of jasmine, rose and carnation.

items.title: Cannabis Fruttata — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Cannabis Fruttata by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Italian perfume house Bois 1920 has released a modern, herbal scent for men and women. Cannabis Fruttata launched in 2019, and its fresh take on fragrant blends is a welcome change from traditional scents. It opens with top notes of oregano, rosemary, and fig leaf for a green introduction.

items.title: Rodin Olio Lusso 3 — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Rodin Olio Lusso 3 by Rodin Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: From fragrance newcomer Rodin, a designer based in the Us, is a floral fragrance that sets your imagination on fire. Rodin Olio Lusso 3 seems simple, yet its blend of flowery aromas with earthier, woody accords makes it a nostalgic stroll through a garden in bloom. The top note features geranium before the heart notes of ylang-ylang, jasmine sambac, and orris bloom into play.

items.title: Moresque Seta Secret Collection — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Moresque Seta Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Moresque Seta Secret Collection is a complex men's fragrance that transports you back in time from the trade markets of the Silk Road to the canals of Venice. From Italian perfumier Moresque, this masculine fragrance introduces itself with top notes of saffron, lemon, and bergamot. At the heart are notes of floral ylang-ylang and myrrh to continue the exotic journey.

items.title: Moresque Ubar 1992 Secret Collection — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Moresque Ubar 1992 Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Travel back in time to a lost Arabian city on the fragrant profile of Moresque Ubar 1992 Secret Collection. This unisex scent was launched in 2018 by Italian perfume house Moresque as part of a special collection. It opens with top notes of cypress and bergamot before the heart notes of clary sage, black pepper, and incense come into play.

items.title: Moresque Alma Pure Secret Collection — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Moresque Alma Pure Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Moresque Alma Pure Secret Collection debuted in 2018, presenting its floral fruity scent profile in a beautiful golden bottle. This women’s fragrance from Moresque opens with top notes of cassis and blackberry, giving it an unmistakable tangy and tart introduction. Next come middle notes of May rose, champagne and linden tree blossoms, known by their distinctive grassy, sweet and bitter aroma.

items.title: Moresque Jasminisha Secret Collection — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Moresque Jasminisha Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Moresque Jasminisha Secret Collection is a 2018 amber floral unisex fragrance designed by Andrea Casotti. Part of Moresque’s Gold collection, this scent starts with refreshing top notes of spicy hot ginger and sweet, succulent mandarin. Next follows a heart of ginger flower paired with fragrant orange blossom and creamy jasmine, the star player in this scent blend.

items.title: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia — Eau de Cologne en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The 4711 brand describes this 2020 women’s floral fragrance as “seductive, feminine and elegant.” 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia features a balanced aromatic profile with several classic fragrance notes. Sweet mandarin, succulent orange and bright pink pepper create a refreshing opening.

items.title: Demeter Ambergris — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Ambergris by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Composed of few notes, Demeter Ambergris gives off a bounty of aromatic accords. Ambergris, musk, vanilla, and earthy and spicy notes mingle to produce amber, musky, animalic, balsamic, powdery and sweet accords. The moderately long-lasting fragrance has a moderate sillage and is suitable for daytime and evening wear year-round.

items.title: Demeter Beetroot — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Beetroot by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Demeter Beetroot is part of the Pennsylvania brand's Classic Collection. Focused on the sole note of beetroot, the unisex fragrance gives off accords of fresh earth and slightly spicy beet flesh. With its weak longevity and intimate sillage, the scent pairs perfectly with daytime wear in the spring and summer months.

items.title: Demeter Clove — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Clove by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Although it has a simple composition with just one scent note, Demeter Clove is an enchanting fragrance that is both herbal and earthy. Infused with the scent of fresh cloves, this aroma is both sweet and spicy, making it ideal for everyday wear in the fall and winter. This cologne is part of the simple fragrance line Demeter is known for.

items.title: Demeter Blood Lime — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Blood Lime by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A bold citrus fragrance for women and men, Demeter Blood Lime is created from the juicy fruits blood orange and lime. This dynamic duo produces a quintessential citrus accord that is bright, tangy and energizing. The fragrance is moderately long-lasting with an enormous sillage, thanks to its citrusy scent superpower.

items.title: Demeter Caipirinha — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Caipirinha by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Inspired by the Brazilian liquor Cacaca, Demeter Caipirinha is a fun, refreshing fragrance for men. It blends the scent of the liquor with notes of juicy lime and warm sugar, resulting in a gourmand fragrance that is bright and inviting. This aroma is great for both casual and formal events and wears well at any time of the year.

items.title: Demeter Condensed Milk — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Condensed Milk by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: If you enjoy baking, you are probably familiar with the sweet, gourmand scent of condensed milk. If you want to carry that delightful fragrance with you, spritz on Demeter Condensed Milk. As part of the simple fragrance line Demeter is known for, this aroma features simple scent notes of rich milk and warm sugar for a delicious, gourmand fragrance that is great for everyday wear.

items.title: Demeter Clover — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Clover by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: From the Pennsylvania Demeter Fragrance Library, which specializes in fragrances featuring nature's diverse and distinctive aromas and scents, comes Demeter Clover. Built on its single note of clover, the fragrance features floral, green and sweet accords. A moderately long-lasting scent with a moderate sillage, it's ideal for daytime use in the spring and summer months.

items.title: Demeter Cherry Cream — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Cherry Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Deliciously sweet and gourmand, Demeter Cherry Cream is a delectable aroma that features scent notes of fresh cherries and creamy vanilla. It is a simple fragrance that is soft and light, so it is ideal for everyday wear in the spring. If you love the juicy scent of fresh cherries, you'll love this tantalizing aroma.

items.title: Demeter Coconut — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Coconut by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: While composed of a single note of coconut, Demeter Coconut for women gives off a collection of accords: lactonic, nutty, sweet, tropical and vanilla. Its wide-ranging aromatic experience produces a moderately long-lasting fragrance with a moderate sillage. The floral-fruity perfume is especially well-suited to daytime wear in the summer, the season popularly associated with coconut aromas and flavors and trips to the beach or tropical locations.

items.title: Demeter Churros — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Churros by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Churros are a beloved Mexican food, and the new aroma by Demeter allows you to carry the tantalizingly delicious scent of your favorite food everywhere you go. Demeter Churros is a gourmand fragrance that blends the irresistible scent of tender, flaky dough with warm cinnamon and sugar for a tantalizing scent that is great for casual wear. Wear it to enjoy the scent of your favorite treat, but beware because it may start a craving for churros!

items.title: Demeter Argan — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Argan by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: An aromatic fragrance for women and men, Demeter Argan features notes from the titular Moroccan tree and its fruits. Its aromatic, earthy and woody accords give it moderate longevity and sillage that lend it well to daytime and evening wear throughout the year. It's also appropriate for everyday, casual and formal occasions.

items.title: Demeter Basil — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Basil by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Demeter Basil fairly bursts with its enticing accords: aromatic, fresh spicy, green and herbal. This powerful unisex perfume unleashes the bounty of its signature herb on the world. Demeter produced the fragrance with weak longevity and a moderate sillage so that it's ideal for daytime and evening wear throughout the year.

items.title: Demeter Black Pepper — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Black Pepper by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Inherently spicy and masculine, Demeter Black Pepper is a mysterious fragrance that is infused with peppercorn. This rich, masculine scent is also infused with volatile oils that deepen the spicy accord and make this aroma ideal for a romantic night out on the town with your significant other. Although this fragrance has a simple composition, it is rich and sophisticated enough for formal wear.

items.title: Demeter Black Bamboo — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Black Bamboo by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: If you're looking for an earthy, unisex perfume to add to your fragrance collection, Demeter Black Bamboo fits the bill. This herbal aroma features scent notes of tender bamboo shoots, aromatic greens and hints of spicy ginger. Bright and refreshing, this fragrance is ideal for casual wear in the spring and summer.

items.title: Demeter Bird of Paradise — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Bird of Paradise by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Named for the striking tropical flower, Demeter Bird of Paradise is a floral fragrance for women of all ages. Its lone note of Bird of Paradise or Strelitzia has a slightly tropical and herbal aroma, also known as a 'fantasy note' in perfumery. As you might expect, the fragrance is a favorite among its fans for daytime wear in the spring and summer months.

items.title: Demeter Creme Anglaise — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Creme Anglaise by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Demeter Creme Anglaise pick-me-up cologne spray for men may just become your go-to fragrance. Composed of the single note of custard, also known as English cream, the fragrance produces sweet and lactonic or milky accords that are comforting and creamy. Fans of the scent recommend it for wear in the fall, the time of year that the English often add custard to hearty puddings.

items.title: Jo Malone Poppy & Barley — Eau de Cologne en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Jo Malone Poppy & Barley by Jo Malone Cologne Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2019, Jo Malone Poppy & Barley by Jo Malone, is a vibrant floral scent that hones in on the essence of its three main notes. Lively, fresh and inviting, the top note of blackcurrant bursts from the first spritz like a welcoming juicy embrace. As the sweet crispness tames, the green yet flowery aroma of poppy invigorates the senses.

items.title: Initio Rehab — Extrait de Parfum 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Rehab by Initio Parfums Prives Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Rev up the seduction factor with a smoky and tantalizing spritz of Initio Rehab by Initio Parfums Prives. Launched in 2018, this woody and sweet cologne exudes sophisticated refinement and masculinity. It opens with a tantalizing and vibrant mix of lavender and bergamot.

items.title: Initio Mystic Experience — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Mystic Experience by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: For men who desire to exude sophisticated refinement and a gentleman’s spirit, look no further than Initio Mystic Experience by Initio Parfums Prives. Launched in 2015, this bold and captivating cologne blends a simple array of notes that conjures up pleasant memories and a warmness that is hard to resist. Designed to take the senses on an uninhibited journey, it carefully balances bitter and aromatic coffee, animalic and magnetic musk, sweet vanilla, and seductive patchouli.

items.title: Initio Magnetic Blend 7 — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Magnetic Blend 7 by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Science and nature powerfully collide to create the ultimate in seduction with Initio Magnetic Blend 7. This innovative cologne, released by Initio Parfums Prives in 2015, takes the irresistible pheromone of musk to a staggeringly sexy new level. Mysterious and magnetic, it is composed of molecules that capture the invisible captivation and urge to get closer.

items.title: Initio Atomic Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Atomic Rose by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Initio Parfums Prives debuted Initio Atomic Rose in 2019. This unisex amber floral fragrance is part of the brand’s Carnal Blends collection. Soft pink pepper and spicy bergamot start off this fragrance.

items.title: Initio Blessed Baraka — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Blessed Baraka by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Initio Blessed Baraka is a 2015 unisex amber fragrance created by Alberto Morillas. Initio Parfums Prives describes it as a “solar fragrance” featuring musk, amber and sandalwood as its chief scent molecules. These three classic notes bring together a variety of accords and textures: soft, milky, earthy, woody, leathery and balsamic tones.

items.title: Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac is a 2015 unisex amber spicy fragrance by Initio Parfums Prives, designed by Alexandra Kosinski. Scent molecules of musk and castoreum create a potency center, combining animalistic, warm and leathery tones. Amber doubles down on the warmth in this fragrance while adding powdery and sweet facets.

items.title: Initio Addictive Vibration — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Addictive Vibration by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: From French perfume house Initio Parfums Prives is a wild ride of a scent to tap into your animalistic nature. Launched in 2016, Initio Addictive Vibration is complex and unforgettable. It opens innocently enough with notes of apple and orange blossom.

items.title: Initio Side Effect — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Side Effect by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2016, Initio Side Effect by Initio Parfums Prives is a simple yet intoxicating and vibrant cologne. Infused with spice and warm notes that seduce the senses, it evokes a sense of magnetism that is undeniably strong. This smooth aroma fuses the enticing aroma of cinnamon with rum and vanilla that makes one yearn for more.

items.title: Initio Psychedelic Love — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Psychedelic Love by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Show off your groove and entice onlookers with a spritz of Initio Psychedelic Love. Launched by Initio Parfums Prives in 2017, this intoxicating fragrance delights the senses and envelopes the wearer in a mesmerizing and seductive aura. This unisex scent opens with a delectable and eye-opening burst of ylang-ylang and bergamot.

items.title: Initio High Frequency — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio High Frequency by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Initio High Frequency is a 2016 unisex floral fragrance from Initio Parfums Prives, a French niche perfume label. Its scent profile comes from an effortless balance of floral, nutty, fruity, fresh and green accords. Magnolia and almond bring in their nutty, bitter, honeyed and lemony tones.

items.title: Initio Oud For Greatness — Eau de Parfum en spray 90 ml (3.04 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Initio Oud For Greatness by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
items.description_en: Ancient and mesmerizing notes are given a modern spin with Initio Oud For Greatness by Initio Parfums Prives. Oud is at the heart of this rich and vibrant cologne, which was released in 2018. Powerful, sensual and aromatic, this rare ingredient subtly lingers.

items.title: Woodysandal — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Woodysandal by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Woodysandal is a 2020 unisex woody fruity fragrance from the French perfume brand Hermetica. Designed by Hungarian perfumer Aliénor Massenet, it features a rich center with sandalwood essence, tonka bean oil and a blackcurrant molecule. These three notes weave milky and woody tones with sweet, tobacco-like and tangy accords.

items.title: Sandalsun — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Sandalsun by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Sandalsun is a unisex woody gourmand fragrance released in 2018 by the French niche perfume label Hermetica. Calling it “delicious” would be an understatement – a core of vanilla, hazelnut and sandalwood infuses it with a rich, creamy and nutty decadence. The brand’s Source1 fragrance also features in this scent as a base for its three core ingredients, lending its warmth and depth.

items.title: Vaninight — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Vaninight by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Vaninight is an amber vanilla fragrance launched by Hermetica in 2018. This unisex scent was designed by Philippe Paparella-Paris, the perfumer who crafted most of the brand’s offerings. Vanilla absolute, almond oil and an amber molecule combine their balsamic, nutty, creamy and dark sugary accords.

items.title: Kanon Nordic Elements Water — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kanon Nordic Elements Water by Kanon Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Kanon Nordic Elements Water is a men's fragrance from Kanon featuring floral, fruity, balsamic, green and woody accords. Top notes of lavender, eucalyptus, aldehydes and apple create a lively opening with resinous, camphorous, waxy, herbal and delicate sweet tones. Middle notes of geranium and water lily lend aquatic, rosy and green accords.

items.title: Jo Milano Levante Blue Noir — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Jo Milano Levante Blue Noir by Jo Milano Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Jo Milano Levante Blue Noir is a masculine fragrance from Jo Milano. Its sweet scent makes it a great choice for daily wear all year long. A duo of fruity top notes opens the fragrance with lemon and apple, complemented by refreshing mint.

items.title: Arabian Soiree — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Arabian Soiree by Fanette Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Hot Arabian nights beg for a bold, masculine fragrance like this one from French perfume house Fanette. Introduced in 2016, Arabian Soiree has a rugged, sensual aroma that awakens your senses. The top notes of rose and Arabian spices capture your attention, while the heart notes of leather and patchouli lend a more relaxed, earthy feel.

items.title: Epic Oud — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Epic Oud by Fanette Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: The scent of oud is enigmatic, making it an intriguing focus for this masculine scent from French designer Fanette. Launched in 2016, Epic Oud has a light, fruity introduction, thanks to top notes of bergamot and juicy strawberry. At the heart are notes of delicate lily-of-the-valley and cedar.

items.title: The Fatale Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: The Fatale Rose by Fanette Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Fresh yet soft, sensual, The Fatale Rose is an irresistible floral woody musk that suits any season. The scent opens with a crisp, uplifting effusion of crushed mandarin leaves, delicately green with a hint of citrus sweetness. Lush orange blossom and seductive jasmine in the heart provide a beautiful backdrop for inimitable French rose, velvety and alluring.

items.title: Lemon Island — Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lemon Island by Atelier Cologne Pure Perfume Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Lemon Island Cologne by Atelier Cologne

items.title: Demeter Saffron — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Saffron by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Indulge the senses with the rich and sophisticated scent of Demeter Saffron by Demeter. Seductive, enticing and mysterious, its warmth envelopes the body in decadence. Crafted to replica the warm and spicy aroma of this highly sought-after spice, it has hints of leather and tobacco that give it an exotic and irresistible edge.

items.title: Demeter Tea Olive — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Tea Olive by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Also known as osmanthus or false holly, tea olive is a sweet floral scent with naturally occuring touches of peach and apricot. Although the fragrance oil is commonly used as a perfume ingredient, Demeter Tea Olive takes a moment to appreciate the flower for what it is in its truest form, undiluted and only enhanced to bring out the natural notes. This Demeter scent was first released in 2018 as part of the brand's collection of natural flower scents.

items.title: Demeter To Yo Ran Orchid — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter To Yo Ran Orchid by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Designed for both men and women, Demeter To Yo Ran Orchid is a fresh fragrance that works particularly well during the spring and summer seasons. Delicate notes of white orchid provide a floral base that is balanced by a variety of green notes. Citrusy lemon adds a light, refreshing element to complete the fragrance.

items.title: Demeter Saltwater Taffy — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Saltwater Taffy by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A fragrance that brings to mind boardwalks and beaches, Demeter Saltwater Taffy is a sweet and nostalgic perfume for both men and women. It was launched by Demeter in 2013 and is the perfect fragrance for sunny summer days. Notes of caramel and sugar create the perfect sweetness, warmed and softened by notes of vanilla.

items.title: Demeter Spacewalk — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Spacewalk by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Once again taking something that no one knew could become a perfume and capturing it in a bottle, Demeter released Spacewalk in 2019. This unique scent is difficult to describe, but most refer to it as sweetly metallic. Demeter Spacewalk was inspired by the scent of the international space station and the interior of a rocket.

items.title: Demeter Puppy's Breath — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Puppy's Breath by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Animal lovers can experience the first time of seeing that adorable pup every day with Demeter Puppy's Breath by Demeter. This warm and sweet fragrance floods the mind with cherished memories of getting the first kiss from a fuzzy bundle of joy. Vibrant, youthful and revitalizing, it exudes a sense of happiness that will make others take note.

items.title: Demeter Privet — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Privet by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Take the senses on a journey through a shrub maze and welcome the delightful freshness and intrigue with a spritz of Demeter Privet by Demeter. This unisex fragrance has a green, floral and slightly spicy aroma that is mysterious yet inviting. One can envision exploring the unknown, delightfully navigating evergreens and bushes with delectable flowers.

items.title: Demeter Kelp — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Kelp by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2019, Demeter Kelp by Demeter craftily blends the clean, green and savory smell of kelp with salty sea air. It makes one envision trapesing along an oceanside path, feeling the gentle breeze and inhaling the delightful aromas that Mother Nature has to offer. It tickles the nose with hints of sweetness, which subtly mix with earthy accords.

items.title: Demeter Pomander — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Pomander by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Enjoy the aroma of the holiday all year long with Demeter Pomander by Demeter. Launched in 2018, this delightfully fruity and spicy fragrance captures the warmth, excitement and comfortableness of sitting around with friends and family as the snow gently falls outside the window. As the aroma swirls, the senses are tantalized with an array of scents, including a hint of clove, amber, cinnamon and apple.

items.title: Demeter Mildew — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Mildew by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: When you want a unique scent that captures a single essence of nature, Demeter has established itself as a go-to perfumer. Demeter Mildew is a surprisingly delightful unisex fragrance that is sure to bring back memories. Earthy and slightly sweet, it conjures up memories of turning on the air conditioner, playing with an old toy that has been socked away or dewy moss as you explore the garden.

items.title: Demeter Punch — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Punch by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: From high school dances to family gatherings, one whiff of Demeter Punch by Demeter will bring your memories alive. This delectable fragrance harnesses a blend of scents and accords to masterfully bring a favorite drink to life. Its sweet and fruity aroma will make you thirsty for more and surprise you with a few mysterious aromas.

items.title: Demeter Yuzu Marmalade — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Yuzu Marmalade by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Inspired by a gift of sweet South Korean preserves, Demeter Yuzu Marmalade is a deliciously refreshing fragrance that can be worn by both women and men. Bright, citrusy yuzu notes are the focus of this perfume, making it a perfect option for sunny summer days. It is lovely and light, great for daily wear.

items.title: Demeter Spicy Pineapple Salsa — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Spicy Pineapple Salsa by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Just like your favorite chip dip, Demeter Spicy Pineapple Salsa blends sweetness and spice for an unforgettable crispy snack sensation. The fragrance opens wth the toasty scents of jalapeno and paprika which are balanced by the juicy sweetness of pineapple and mango for a mouthwatering blend that brings back memories of family gatherings and warm summer sunsets. Mix it with a few of your favorite green or aromatic Demeter scents to create the right flavor smorgasbord for your next evening out.

items.title: Demeter Vanilla Cookie Dough — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Vanilla Cookie Dough by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: On days when you are feeling particularly sweet, Demeter Vanilla Cookie Dough from Demeter is the perfect fragrance. This perfume is great for both women and men, and its warmth makes it just right for cool autumn and winter days. With prominent notes of vanilla and sugar, it leaves you smelling just like a dessert.

items.title: Demeter Sugar Plum — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Sugar Plum by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched by Demeter in 2012, Demeter Sugar Plum is the perfect autumn and winter fragrance. Suitable for both men and women, this perfume easily gets you into the holiday spirit. Notes of dried plum are enhanced by a blend of additional dried fruit and sweetened with warm honey notes.

items.title: Demeter Glue — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Glue by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Be prepared for a wave of memories to be unleashed when wearing Demeter Glue by Demeter. While you may not want to sniff the original, this balanced aromatic replica is something you will want to smell all day. Subtle yet distinct, it takes one back to childhood memories, from assembling models to letting your creative side out in art class.

items.title: Demeter Turpentine — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Turpentine by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Known for its innovative fragrance line, Demeter doesn’t hold back in creating unique, imaginative scents that capture what the real world has to offer. Demeter Turpentine does just that in a surprisingly delightful way. Crafted to evoke experiences, this scent easily whisks one away to art class or staining wood.

items.title: Demeter Turmeric — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Turmeric by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Since 600 Bc, aromatic turmeric has been sought after for medicinal purposes, flavoring and dyeing. Brilliantly yellow and slightly pungent, it continues to be cherished around the world. Demeter Turmeric by Demeter, released in 2019, captures the unique aroma that emits hints of ginger and orange.

items.title: Demeter Mushroom — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Mushroom by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: When your inner soul loves all that nature has to offer, exude your true earthiness with Demeter Mushroom by Demeter. This unique aroma has a twang of pungency that is calmed with a mysterious sweetness. Like being whisked away to a magical forest, hints of fruity and woodiness envelope the senses as you hunt for the delectable treats that are hidden within.

items.title: Demeter White Sangria — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter White Sangria by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2013, Demeter White Sangria by Demeter will intoxicate the senses and make you yearn for warm-weather days having a refreshing drink in a tropical locale. Sophisticated and seductive, this boozy fragrance will delight those with a palate for wine. Along with a mix of red and white wine, a hint of sweet brandy.

items.title: Demeter Prune — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Prune by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Intense and seductive, Demeter Prune by Demeter is a sweet and fruity fragrance for men and women. Carefully crafted to mimic that natural, concentrated dried fruit, it conjures up ancient times while still exuding a modern, contemporary flair. Although not juicy, it still melts in your mouth, delivering a delectable taste that no other fruit can deliver.

items.title: Demeter Saguaro Cactus — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Saguaro Cactus by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: While the desert may conjure up images of sand and little habitat, hidden within is lush greenery that is undeniably attractive. Demeter Saguaro Cactus, released by Demeter in 2009, captures the essence that lively freshness. Warm, energizing and irresistible, it reawakens the spirit and boosts one’s appreciation of the complex beauty of Mother Nature.

items.title: Demeter Sweet Cilantro — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Sweet Cilantro by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2009, Demeter Sweet Cilantro by Demeter is a mesmerizing scent that instantly invigorates the senses. Clean, fresh and fragrant, captures the essence of charisma and being true to your inner self. It tingles the senses with its vivid burst of cilantro and coriander leaves, which gives it a soapy yet green aura that will be irresistible to those who love the complex herb.

items.title: Demeter Mountain Laurel — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Mountain Laurel by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Take a deep breath and let the light, warm fragrance of Demeter Mountain Laurel perfume lift your spirits. This cheerful white floral scent draws its inspiration from a breathtaking mountain hike and features a single note of California bay laurel. A splash of this perfume lets you welcome the glorious days of spring and reminisce about your most uplifting outdoor excursions.

items.title: Demeter Mistletoe — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter, launched in 2011, delicately captures the fragrant scent of mistletoe and the memories associated with it. The first spritz whisks one away to a wintery night filled with anticipation and longing. As a potential lover steps under the fresh, spicy and green decoration, the opportunity to steal a kiss is irresistible.

items.title: Demeter Tarnish — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Tarnish by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Relive cherished memories of shining up the silver with Demeter Tarnish by Demeter. This unique and innovative aroma evokes a sense of warmth and longing for simpler times. Carefully crafted with minimal, simple notes to capture the tangy essence of tarnish, it exudes a metallic and mineral vibe that is welcoming but also full of intrigue and mystery.

items.title: Demeter Macadamia Nut — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Macadamia Nut by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Take your senses on a warm, buttery journey with a spritz of Demeter Macadamia Nut by Demeter. This delectable fragrance exudes a tropical air without being saturated with fruity and floral scents. Earthy and natural, the aroma makes it easy to envision exploring Hawaii and taking in the breathtaking sights, from waves gently splashing to a lumbering volcano in the distance.

items.title: Demeter Scottish Shortbread — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Scottish Shortbread by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Tasty enough to eat, Demeter Scottish Shortbread is a sweet bakery scent perfect for winter evenings. It was first released in 2000 and features the reliable scents of sugar and wheat that combine to make a light biscuit scent. Like many Demeter fragrances, this one is startlingly realistic, bringing back memories of festive parties and afternoon tea.

items.title: Demeter Yellow Iris — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Yellow Iris by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Feel like every day is the first day of spring with Demeter Yellow Iris by Demeter. Released in 2017, this delightful fragrance takes your senses on an olfactory journey through blooming flowers as the gentle sun rays warm the skin, evoking a sense of youthfulness and excitement. This light perfume is infused with earthy and powdery accords that a hint of spiciness while still exuding a delicate innocence.

items.title: Demeter Cattleya Orchid — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Cattleya Orchid by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Unleash your inner queen with Demeter Cattleya Orchid. Launched by Demeter in 2015, this mesmerizing perfume is simple yet complex, making it a complementary fragrance for the bold modern woman. Creamy, sweet and citrusy, the orchid scent is masterfully blended with patchouli and citrus notes, which rev up its sophistication and seductiveness.

items.title: Kian Glad — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kian Glad by Kian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Kian Glad Perfume by Kian

items.title: Zaien Intensive — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Zaien Intensive by Zaien Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Zaien Intensive Cologne by Zaien

items.title: Kian Ameeri — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Kian Ameeri by Kian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Kian Ameeri Cologne by Kian

items.title: Clean Reserve Solar Bloom — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clean Reserve Solar Bloom by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Released in 2019, Clean Reserve Solar Bloom is a deliciously fresh floral fragrance enhanced by unexpected elements of coal, coconut milk and vetiver. The scent opens with an uplifting citrus expression of tart-sweet mandarin orange and fruity-aromatic bergamot. Creamy, enveloping white florals bloom next, mingling jasmine, freesia and lushly fragrant orange blossom with velvety coconut.

items.title: Demeter Molasses — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Molasses by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Ooze irresistible charm and sweetness with a spritz of Demeter Molasses. Launched in 2013 by Demeter, this mesmerizing perfume captures the delectableness of molasses. With all its sticky sweetness, it exudes a hint of the exotic and a touch of fruitiness.

items.title: Demeter Rye Bread — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Rye Bread by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Rye Bread by Demeter lets you take a journey to a classic New York City delicatessen without leaving home. This warm and welcoming fragrance makes your mouth water in anticipation of the first delectable bite. As you take a deep inhale, you can almost smell the bread being baked.

items.title: Demeter Mandarin Orange — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Mandarin Orange by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Mandarin Orange features only its titular scent note. Yet Demeter Fragrance Library lets its lively accords shine in this 2017 unisex citrus scent. Mandarin is a heritage citrus fruit whose cultivation began in China centuries ago.

items.title: Demeter Lobster — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Lobster by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Your favorite sailor will be unable to leave your side when wearing a spritz of Demeter Lobster by Demeter. As the scent unfolds, it whisks one away to the seaside. The gentle breeze and warm sunshine make the skin pleasantly tingle while the vast ocean and all its life evoke a sense of vitality.

items.title: Demeter Raspberry Jam — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Raspberry Jam by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Imagine a slice of hearty bread, crisp and fresh from the toaster. Your favorite jam is the perfect topping to create true mealtime deliciousness. If your jelly of choice is packed with tart and juicy raspberries then Demeter has concocted an irresistible fragrance in the form of Demeter Raspberry Jam.

items.title: Demeter Petrichor — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Petrichor by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: If the smell of fresh rain captivates you, Demeter Petrichor is the ideal fragrance to add to your collection. In true Demeter fashion, this enchanting aroma uses a simple combination of dry soil and rainwater scent notes to create a long-lasting fragrance that is suitable for any occasion and can be worn throughout the year. Demeter is an American fragrance company that specializes in developing nostalgic scents.

items.title: Demeter Musk #9 — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Musk #9 by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2014, Demeter Musk #9 by Demeter is a mesmerizing unisex fragrance that exudes an exotic seductiveness. Reminiscent of ancient times while still being modern and fresh, it captivates the senses with its powder, musky and citrusy aura. This scent starts with a burst of spirited lime and bergamot.

items.title: Demeter Lychee — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Lychee by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Let others know that you are one of a kind wearing Demeter Lychee by Demeter. This tantalizingly sweet perfume has a tropical, exotic aura that captures the essence of this ancient delectable fruit that is synonymous with love and royalty. While the luscious sweetness mesmerizes, a touch of fresh fruitiness gives it a little edge that makes it even more captivating.

items.title: Demeter Gold — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Gold by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: The historical allure and fantasies that come with riches are brought to life by Demeter Gold. Launched in 2019 by Demeter, the perfumer went less literal with this mesmerizing scent, although it still has a seductive metallic spark that is sure to allure. Surprisingly warm and inviting, this form of gold takes one to a place where exotic spices fill the air as the gentle breeze brings in hints of the woods off in the distance.

items.title: Demeter Hyacinth — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Hyacinth by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Hyacinth is a 2018 unisex floral fragrance produced by the Demeter Fragrance Library. This fragrance note comes from the well-known spring perennial that blooms clusters of tiny pink, white, violet and blue flowers. Hyacinth takes its name from Greek mythology – a Spartan hero whom the Olympian god Apollo loved dearly.

items.title: Demeter Nitro Coffee — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Nitro Coffee by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: There's no better way to start the morning than with a bold cup of coffee. With Demeter Nitro Coffee, you can keep that energizing scent with you all day long. This aromatic fragrance features a single note of coffee and is a great choice for both women and men.

items.title: Demeter Myrhh — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Myrhh by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Demeter Myrhh takes a timeless perfume note and displays the full spectrum of its beauty. This 2015 unisex fragrance from Demeter Fragrance Library features myrrh as its single note. This aromatic gum resin comes from the myrrh trees of Arabia and North Africa.

items.title: Demeter Fresh Brewed Coffee — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Fresh Brewed Coffee by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: When there is nary a steaming cup of Joe within sight but the perk of a java jolt is much needed, Demeter Fresh Brewed Coffee is just the thing to energize your spirit and senses any time of day. Launched in 2017, the unisex perfume from Demeter relies on the simple, singular note of coffee to uplift. As comforting and familiar as that first strong and steaming cup of coffee enjoyed first thing in the morning, the fragrance envelops you in the warm and spicy aroma of a favorite brew.

items.title: Demeter Earthworm — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Earthworm by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: While the name may make one take a step back, the aroma of Demeter Earthworm by Demeter is much deeper and enchanting than its namesake. This unique perfume instead is a figurative composition that captures the deep darkness of the rich soil below the ground. Earthy and aromatic, it conjures up exploring the woods while the dew is still moist with hints of decomposing leaves making the soil fertile while fresh leaves still shroud the path up above.

items.title: Demeter Frozen Pond — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Frozen Pond by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Breathe in the aroma of crisp, clean, cold air and be whisked away to unforgettable winter days exploring the icy elements with Demeter Frozen Pond by Demeter. This light and airy perfume brings to life the anticipation of strapping on ice skates to whirl around on frozen water knowing that warm, delectable hot cocoa will be your reward. Aquatic yet earthy, this fragrance has a unique charm that is even perfect for a hot summer day.

items.title: Demeter Magnolia — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Magnolia by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Take your senses on a springtime Southern journey with Demeter Magnolia by Demeter. This feminine perfume captures the unique and soothing charm of magnolia. Sophisticated and sensual, hints of exotic white flowers and deep woods add a welcoming mysteriousness that is enticing and irresistible.

items.title: Demeter Dust — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Dust by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: There is always a unique smell that makes a home your home. Demeter Dust by Demeter captures the essence of the minuscule particles that float around and create something that is only for you. Light and airy, this fragrance is a subtle mix of fabric lint, dirt and the scent of skin.

items.title: Demeter Licorice — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Licorice by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Soothing and unique, Demeter Licorice by Demeter is a familiar scent with a sophisticated and tantalizing twist. While it may evoke memories of being in a candy store and exploring all the possible delectable treats just an arm's reach away, its sweet spiciness has hints of botanicals and amber that are comforting and enticing. Bold yet not overbearing, a touch of vanilla tames the powerful scent of black licorice.

items.title: Demeter Egg Nog — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Egg Nog by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Easily get into the holiday spirit with Demeter Egg Nog from Demeter. This fragrance is great for Christmastime but is delicious enough to have you wearing it all winter and autumn long. Notes of rum and cognac provide warmth while mingling with notes of creamy milk.

items.title: Demeter Frangipani — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Frangipani by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Unleash your inner exotic seductress with Demeter Frangipani by Demeter. As you walk by, others will be instantly transfixed on the sweet, tropical aroma gently wafting by. Captivatingly mysterious, it captures the essence of the complex frangipani flower.

items.title: Demeter Iced Berries — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Iced Berries by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: A sweet and spicy fragrance from Demeter, Demeter Iced Berries is the perfect perfume for the holiday season but can easily be worn throughout the year. It can be used on its own or combined with other scents. A trio of berry notes is the focus of the composition with blueberry, blackberry and raspberry blending together to create a bright, fresh fragrance.

items.title: Demeter New Car — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter New Car by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Everybody loves the smell of a new car, but your vehicle won't keep that fresh scent forever. With Demeter New Car, you can keep that smell around. This fragrance was launched by Demeter in 2018 and is great for both women and men.

items.title: Demeter Jelly Doughnut — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Jelly Doughnut by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Transport yourself to your very favorite bakery, where you can bite into a fresh and scrumptious morning treat. Demeter Jelly Doughnut allows you to wear the scent of a delectable baked goodie right on your skin, where you can delight in the mouthwatering aroma all day long. The unisex fragrance features a simple collection of scent notes, including the classic, familiar sweetness of sticky grape jelly, delicious hints of fried dough and a tantalizing sprinkling of sugar crystals.

items.title: Demeter PB & J — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter PB & J by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Are you feeling nostalgic for a classic childhood food staple? Spritz on the unisex perfume of Demeter Pb & J and experience the happiness and comfort of biting into a favorite sandwich combination, even when there is not a single tub of nutty peanut butter in sight. The fragrance house of Demeter put in years of testing to create the perfect balance that captures the essence of this youthful culinary delight.

items.title: Demeter Exotic Tuberose — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Exotic Tuberose by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Soft, creamy and breathtakingly unforgettable, Demeter Exotic Tuberose by Demeter is a feminine perfume that exudes dreamy seduction. Launched in 2018, rich and slightly sweet, tuberose takes center stage with its unique and mesmerizing scent. It exudes a tropical flair while still permeating the senses with the intoxicating aroma of white florals.

items.title: Demeter Morocco — Eau de Cologne en spray 120 ml (4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Demeter Morocco by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Travel back in time to ancient markets filled with fragrances of yore with Demeter Morocco by Demeter. Launched in 2018, this warm and spicy perfume tantalizes the senses from the first spritz. The aroma quickly whisks one away to a spice shop filled with mystery, intrigue and seduction.

items.title: Radikal Iris — Extrait de Parfum 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Radikal Iris by Laurent Mazzone Extrait de Parfum (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: A sumptuous, sensual floral woody musk, Radikal Iris beautifully harmonizes rich, powdery orris with aromatic elements and a hint of vanilla sweetness. The fragrance opens with a captivating expression of iris and galbanum mingled with bright bergamot and soft pink pepper. Heart notes are a woody blend of cedar and embracing patchouli, followed by a smooth, seductive base of tonka bean, amber and musk.

items.title: Prada Olfactories Double Dare — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Prada Olfactories Double Dare by Prada Eau De Parfum Spray with Gift Pouch (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Powdery and fresh floral elements harmonize with accords of leather and spice in Prada Olfactories Double Dare, a warm and woody floral musk released in 2015. Top notes are an enigmatic, expressive blend of citrusy bergamot mingled with soft saffron, pink pepper and cardamom. Lovely rose and sensual jasmine join with resinous, earthy tones of orris and labdanum in the heart.

items.title: Nishane Nefs — Extrait de Parfum 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Nishane Nefs by Nishane Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: A complex unisex amber fragrance, Nishane Nefs is a new perfume from the Nefs perfume house. The top notes are honey, sage, fig, saffron, and violet. The heart features middle notes of rose, nutmeg, jasmine, osmanthus, and geranium.

items.title: Prada Olfactories Heat Wave — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Prada Olfactories Heat Wave by Prada Eau De Parfum Spray with Gift Pouch (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2015, Prada Olfactories Heat Wave is a sweet white and yellow floral fragrance enhanced by elements of aromatic herbs, creamy coconut and vanilla. Opening notes are an uplifting, citrusy-herbal blend of lemon, artemisia and davana. Shimmering jasmine, lush tuberose and sensual ylang ylang embrace the heart notes.

items.title: Juliette Has A Gun Pear Inc — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Juliette Has A Gun Pear Inc by Juliette Has A Gun Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Feel endlessly refreshed while you make the best of every bright summer day when you're wearing Juliette Has A Gun Pear Inc. with your attire. This invigorating 2021 fragrance combines fruity, airy and powdery accords for a sleek, charming aroma that's light as a feather yet powerful enough to turn heads.

items.title: Al Haramain Obsessive Oudh — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Obsessive Oudh by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Celebrate Arabic perfume traditions with the classic mystique of Al Haramain Obsessive Oudh fragrance for men. This full-bodied oudh opens with warm, sensual top notes of amber and musk. The amber carries through to the heart of the fragrance, where it mingles with deep, rich agarwood (oudh).

items.title: Al Haramain Amazing Mukhallath — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Amazing Mukhallath by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Al Haramain Amazing Mukhallath is an adventurous fragrance for men. This cologne opens with aromatic top notes of incense, juniper, and cardamom for a spicy and fresh balsamic aroma. The middle notes, comprised of orris, labdanum, and jasmine, add a powdery white floral tone that is earthy and fresh.

items.title: Al Haramain Haramain Treasure — Eau de Parfum en spray 71 ml (2.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Haramain Treasure by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Make a bold impression with the rich fragrance of Al Haramain Haramain Treasure perfume for men. Warm top notes of amber and musk provide an intoxicating opening. Musk lingers in the heart of the scent and is balanced by subtly sweet notes.

items.title: Al Haramain Portfolio Portrait Sandal — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Portfolio Portrait Sandal by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
items.description_en: Al Haramain Portfolio Portrait Sandal is an energetic and masculine leather-based cologne for confident men seeking a compelling, earthy fragrance. The top is refreshing and spicy with aromatic black pepper and sweet, citrus neroli oil. The heart is provocative and rugged with a dry, atmospheric leather note.

items.title: Al Haramain Portfolio Cupid's Rose — Eau de Parfum en spray 75 ml (2.5 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Portfolio Cupid's Rose by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
items.description_en: Al Haramain Portfolio Cupid's Rose, released in 2019 by Al Haramain, is a woodsy fragrance for women. This perfume opens with bold top notes of bergamot and rose for a bright citrusy and floral aroma. At the heart, notes of cedar, plum, and cinnamon add a spicy warmth that also has a slight touch of fruitiness.

items.title: Al Haramain Ode Of Oudh — Eau de Parfum en spray 71 ml (2.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Ode Of Oudh by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: With a surprising burst of aromatic leafy green notes, Al Haramain Ode Of Oudh cologne’s brilliant open is compelling and intensely herbal. Sweet basil is immediately present in the top, joined by a piquant blend of spicy aniseed extract, bitter artemisia and bright, sassy clove. The heart is wrapped around cheerful freesia while earthy cedar lends the fragrance a woody scent.

items.title: Al Haramain Rawaa — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Al Haramain Rawaa by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
