items.description_en: Al Haramain Rawaa, released in 2018 by Al Haramain, is an aromatic fragrance for women. Bold top notes of coffee and nutty almond open the perfume with a richness. At the heart, jasmine, orris, and tuberose add a soft and powdery white floral note that is delicately feminine and fresh.

items.title: Rihanah Malaki — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Rihanah Malaki by Rihanah Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Rihanah Malaki Cologne by Rihanah

items.title: Clean Simply Clean — Eau de Parfum en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clean Simply Clean by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: The creators of Clean Classic Simply Clean took their inspiration from crisp morning air and cotton sheets hung to dry in the sun. Bergamot, cardamom and lavender notes open the fragrance with their spicy-herbal blend. Aquatic blossom and mimosa notes with a fresh laundry accord form the floral-themed heart while fresh hinoki wood, heliotrope and white musk finish the fragrance.

items.title: Clean Simply Clean — Eau de Parfum en spray 60 ml (2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clean Simply Clean by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2 oz for Women
items.description_en: The creators of Clean Classic Simply Clean took their inspiration from crisp morning air and cotton sheets hung to dry in the sun. Bergamot, cardamom and lavender notes open the fragrance with their spicy-herbal blend. Aquatic blossom and mimosa notes with a fresh laundry accord form the floral-themed heart while fresh hinoki wood, heliotrope and white musk finish the fragrance.

items.title: Casamorati 1888 Italica — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Casamorati 1888 Italica by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Casamorati 1888 Italica is a unisex amber woody fragrance that was released by Xerjoff in 2016. Top notes of almond, saffron and milk form a delicious introduction with nutty, earthy, creamy and grassy tones. Toffee and vanilla form a decadent combination in the middle notes With their honey, cozy and caramel accords.

items.title: Xj 1861 Decas — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xj 1861 Decas by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Xerjoff, the Italian luxury company, is the creative force behind the exquisitely bottled Xj 1861 Decas. The brand launched it in 2021 as a celebration of the first fragrance in the Xj 1861 collection. Calabrian mandarin, tobacco and tuberose comprise the luxurious opening notes.

items.title: Club De Nuit Sillage — Eau de Parfum en spray 106 ml (3.6 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Club De Nuit Sillage by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.6 oz for Men
items.description_en: Club De Nuit Sillage by United Arab Emirates fragrance house Armaf is a floral woody musk scent for men and women. The brand launched it in 2020 and presented it in a striking silver and metallic blue squared flacon with a shattered glass design and a square silver cap studded with diamante accents. The fragrance opens with sumptuous notes of bergamot, black currant, ginger, lemon, lime and violet leaf.

items.title: Replica Bubble Bath — Eau de Toilette en spray 30 ml (1 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica Bubble Bath by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2020, Replica Bubble Bath captures a memory in scent. From French perfume house Maison Margiela, this feminine fragrance is soft and comforting. It opens with top notes of bergamot, pink pepper, and soap bubbles accord to set the tone.

items.title: Replica Bubble Bath — Eau de Toilette en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Replica Bubble Bath by Maison Margiela Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Launched in 2020, Replica Bubble Bath captures a memory in scent. From French perfume house Maison Margiela, this feminine fragrance is soft and comforting. It opens with top notes of bergamot, pink pepper, and soap bubbles accord to set the tone.

items.title: Clean Pure Soap — Eau de Parfum en spray 60 ml (2 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Clean Pure Soap by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2 oz for Men
items.description_en: A light, fresh fragrance from Clean, Clean Classic Pure Soap wears well throughout the year. It is suitable for both men and women and was launched in 2021. Energizing from the start, it opens with bright notes of mandarin orange complemented by aldehydes and various herbal notes.

items.title: Orientica Oud Saffron — Eau de Parfum en spray 80 ml (2.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Orientica Oud Saffron by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2020, Orientica Oud Saffron is a unisex woody-spicy fragrance produced by the United Arab Emirates Al Haramain perfume label. Starting with a vanilla top note paired with oriental notes, the blend delivers a deliciously cozy and dark sugary introduction before revealing its heart of smoky patchouli and earthy saffron. The incense-spice pair delights the senses before uncovering a dry-down of musk, guaiac wood and agarwood.

items.title: Xerjoff Ivory Route — Eau de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Xerjoff Ivory Route by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Like setting off for an adventure, Xerjoff Ivory Route gets the energy pumping as the excitement for what comes next build. Released by Xerjoff in 2012, this classic cologne exudes mystery and energy. The fresh and herbal opening of basil settles in as an exotic mix of spicy notes and allspice tantalize the senses.

items.title: Lengling Munich No 2 Skrik — Extrait de Parfum 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lengling Munich No 2 Skrik by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Like bottled artwork, Lengling Munich No 2 Skrik is a unique and inspiring aroma that makes others take note. Launched in 2015 by Lengling Munich, this cologne has a comforting yet seductive aroma. From the beginning, it tantalizes the senses with the green aroma of cedar and Iso E super.

items.title: Lengling Munich No 3 Acqua Tempesta — Extrait de Parfum 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lengling Munich No 3 Acqua Tempesta by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Exude a distinct aura of sophistication and masculinity wearing Lengling Munich No 3 Acqua Tempesta by Lengling Munich. Released in 2015, this cologne is a bold and aromatic scent that delivers a long-lasting and mesmerizing finish. A zesty opening of peppermint is tamed with hints of cannabis, seawater and fruity yet spice olibanum paves the way for a seductive heart of floral hedione.

items.title: Lengling Munich No 5 Eisbach — Extrait de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lengling Munich No 5 Eisbach by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Take on the day with an energetic and harmonious spritz of Lengling Munich No 5 Eisbach by Lengling Munich. Launched in 2015, this subtle yet flavorful cologne keeps you feeling fresh and lively all day. It opens with a delectable and fruity mingling of bergamot, melon, lemon and grapefruit.

items.title: Lengling Munich No 6 A La Carte — Extrait de Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lengling Munich No 6 A La Carte by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Launched in 2015, Lengling Munich No 6 A La Carte by Lengling Munich is a delectable and irresistible cologne with sensual undertones. Sweet, spicy and animalic, it takes hold of the senses from the first spritz. Pink pepper and green, woody and fruity olibanum create a fresh opening that revs up the desire.

items.title: Lengling Munich No 9 Wunderwind — Extrait de Parfum 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lengling Munich No 9 Wunderwind by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: Take a stroll through the pine forest and feel the power of nature wearing Lengling Munich No 9 Wunderwind by Lengling Munich. Released in 2018, this invigorating cologne has a calming effect while also upping your intrigue level. The fresh and lively opening of lemon and watermelon has a touch of sea notes that give it a citrusy and salty aroma.

items.title: Lengling Munich Figolo — Parfum en spray 50 ml (1.7 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Lengling Munich Figolo by Lengling Munich Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
items.description_en: For modern men who appreciate simplicity yet want to ensure they smell like they have taken all morning to get ready, Lengling Munich Figolo by Lengling Munich is a must-have cologne. This masculine scent packs a woody and earthy yet sweet, spicy and fresh punch. The first spray unleashes the animalic and tantalizing aroma of patchouli.

items.title: Arizona Rouge — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Arizona Rouge by Riiffs Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
items.description_en: Fruity, floral and woody, Arizona Rouge by Riiffs is a mesmerizing blend of complementary notes that come together to create a unique and tantalizing scent made for the modern woman. It opens with the airy and fresh scents of bergamot and mandarin essence. The mesmerizing floral aromas of orange blossom and gardenia quickly take hold, taking the feminine allure to new levels.

items.title: Atelier Des Ors Riviera Drive — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Atelier Des Ors Riviera Drive by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
items.description_en: Riviera Drive is a fragrance for both women and men designed by perfumer Marie Salamagne and launched by Atelier Des Ors in 2019. This aromatic perfume is a perfect choice for spring and summer days. The opening is fruity and herbal with notes of lemon, marjoram and rosemary.

items.title: Crepuscule Des Ames — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Crepuscule Des Ames by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: A warm, smoky and softly spicy aromatic fragrance enhanced by crisp herbal accords, Crepuscule Des Ames was created by perfumer Marie Salamagne and released by Atelier Des Ors in 2018. Opening notes are an effusive citrus-herbal blend of mandarin orange and crushed clary sage just softened by sweet hints of cardamom. Floral, mentholic hyssop and pimento in the heart notes merge with incense and earthy patchouli, followed by a subtly animalic finish of magnetic hyrax.

items.title: Bois Sikar — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.3 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Bois Sikar by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
items.description_en: Designed for both men and women by perfumer Marie Salamagne, Bois Sikar is a woody fragrance that is particularly suited for cool autumn and winter evenings. Notes of nutmeg and precious woods form the top layer. The heart of the composition features cedar, cedar needles, styrax and guaiac wood notes.

items.title: Fabulous Tian Shian — Eau de Parfum en spray 100 ml (3.4 oz) unisex
items.title_en: Fabulous Tian Shian by Dali Haute Parfumerie Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
items.description_en: Released in 2018, Fabulous Tian Shian takes you on a fantastic trip back in time to the exotic Tian Shian area of the Silk Road. From Spanish perfumier Dali Haute Parfumerie, this rich, exotic blend of elements makes a unique scent for men and women. It opens with top notes of woody juniper and bergamot.

items.title: Acqua Fiorentina — Fragancia 1 ml (.05 oz) (Mini) para mujer
items.title_en: Acqua Fiorentina by Creed Vial (sample) .05 oz for Women

The top notes are plum and greengage, Renaissance roses, pink carnations, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon evoke the artistic heart of the fragrance, while in the base, cedar wood and sandalwood add a sophisticated finish.

items.title: Cuba Brazil — Fragancia 5 ml (0.17 oz) (Mini) para hombre

Masculine and robust, this scent will keep you smelling fresh wherever life takes you, whether it be conquering Mount Everest or simply for a boost of confidence before an evening adventure with that special someone.

items.title: Dolce — Fragancia 1 ml (.05 oz) (Mini) para mujer

The top note of juicy raspberry engages your palate while the sweet floral heart note of orange blossom suggests romance. Patchouli, leather and tobacco are the spicy, animalic base notes that give the fragrance its luxurious, sensuous character.

items.title: Reminiscence Oud — Fragancia 1 ml (.04 oz) (Mini) para mujer
items.title_en: Reminiscence Oud by Reminiscence Vial (sample) .04 oz for Women
items.description_en: Agarwood is one of the most sought-after perfume notes in the world. Also called oud, it’s been the center of many Arabic fragrances for at least 3,000 years. One of the most expensive ingredients used by perfumers, it presents a changing face depending on the addition of other notes as well as the mood of the person experiencing it.

items.title: Reminiscence Dragee — Fragancia 1 ml (.04 oz) (Mini) para mujer
items.title_en: Reminiscence Dragee by Reminiscence Vial (sample) .04 oz for Women
items.description_en: In a fragrance that’s delightfully romantic and cheerful, Reminiscence Dragee was launched in 2012 and continues to be sought after for the wildly successful combination of gourmand and seductive notes. Italian mandarin opens the fragrance with a citrus burst. Fresh green Tunisian petitgrain and spicy Guatemala cardamom round out the top.

items.title: Boss No. 6 — Fragancia 5 ml (.17 oz) (Mini) para hombre

items.description_en: Lauched by the design house of Boss in 1999. It's fragrant nature explores essences of fern, bergamot and pineapple. Blended with notes of lavender,Â juniper and geranium, Boss # 6 is a casual type of fragrance.

items.title: Clean Rain & Pear — Fragancia 5 ml (.17 oz) (Mini) para mujer

The scent opens with uplifting, crisply elegant accords of fruity-aromatic bergamot and green foliage. Tropical nuances of creamy coconut and warm sand emerge at the heart, harmonized with ripest peach and shimmering blended florals.

items.description_en: Marc Jacobs Perfect by Marc Jacobs is a spirited perfume made with the modern woman in mind. Launched in 2020, it melds an array of fresh and soothing notes that come together in a calm, floral and flirty aroma that lingers. The first spritz entices the senses with a sunny blend of rhubarb and daffodil this subtly sweetened with a delectable heart of almond milk.

items.title: Swiss Arabian Secret Musk — Aceite de perfume 12 ml (.40 oz) (Mini) unisex
items.title_en: Swiss Arabian Secret Musk by Swiss Arabian Concentrated Perfume Oil (Unisex) .40 oz for Women

items.description_en: Yulali Perfume by Swiss Arabian.  This is an inspiring citrusy floral perfume for women.  It opens with citrus notes to revitalize your senses and set the stage for the stunning floral notes to blend it along with some fruit notes to keep things very interesting.

It rests upon a base of smoky amberwood, herbal frankincense and earthy patchouli with heart notes of fragrant rockrose, romantic jasmine and spicy nutmeg. The fragrance is completed with a juicy top note of mandarin laced with spicy peppermint and herbal green cardamom.

items.title: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning — Eau de Toilette en spray 10 ml (.33 oz) (Mini) para mujer
